# GTP Message Filter Configuration

## Description
Message filter for GTPv0/v1 messages.

## Configuration Commands

### Edit Command
To edit the message filter configuration, use the following command:

```plaintext
edit <name>
```

### Configuration Parameters
The following parameters can be configured:

| Parameter                          | Description                                           | Type   | Size | Default |
|------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------|--------|------|---------|
| create-mbms                        | GTPv1 create MBMS context (req 100, resp 101).      | option | -    | allow   |
| create-pdp                         |                                                       | option | -    | allow   |
| data-record                        |                                                       | option | -    | allow   |
| delete-aa-pdp                     |                                                       | option | -    | allow   |
| delete-mbms                        |                                                       | option | -    | allow   |
| delete-pdp                         |                                                       | option | -    | allow   |
| echo                               |                                                       | option | -    | allow   |
| end-marker                         |                                                       | option | -    | allow   |
| error-indication                   |                                                       | option | -    | allow   |
| failure-report                     |                                                       | option | -    | allow   |
| fwd-relocation                     |                                                       | option | -    | allow   |
| fwd-srns-context                   |                                                       | option | -    | allow   |
| gtp-pdu                            |                                                       | option | -    | allow   |
| identification                     |                                                       | option | -    | allow   |
| mbms-de-registration               |                                                       | option | -    | allow   |
| mbms-notification                  |                                                       | option | -    | allow   |
| mbms-registration                  |                                                       | option | -    | allow   |
| mbms-session-start                 |                                                       | option | -    | allow   |
| mbms-session-stop                  |                                                       | option | -    | allow   |

### Message Filter for GTPv2 Messages

```plaintext
config gtp message-filter-v2
Description: Message filter for GTPv2 messages.
edit <name>
set alert-mme-notif-ack [allow|deny]
set bearer-resource-cmd-fail [allow|deny]
set change-notification [allow|deny]
set configuration-transfer-tunnel [allow|deny]
set context-req-res-ack [allow|deny]
set create-bearer [allow|deny]
set create-forwarding-tunnel-req-resp [allow|deny]
set create-indirect-forwarding-tunnel-req-resp [allow|deny]
set create-session [allow|deny]
set cs-paging [allow|deny]
set delete-bearer-cmd-fail [allow|deny]
set delete-bearer-req-resp [allow|deny]
set delete-indirect-forwarding-tunnel-req-resp [allow|deny]
set delete-pdn-connection-set [allow|deny]
set delete-session [allow|deny]
set detach-notif-ack [allow|deny]
set dlink-data-notif-ack [allow|deny]
set dlink-notif-failure [allow|deny]
set echo [allow|deny]
set forward-access-notif-ack [allow|deny]
```

set forward-relocation-cmp-notif-ack [allow|deny]

set pgw-restart-notif-ack [allow|deny]
set ran-info-relay [allow|deny]
set release-access-bearer-req-resp [allow|deny]
set relocation-cancel-req-resp  [allow|deny]
set remote-ue-report-notif-ack  [allow|deny]
set reserved-for-earlier-version [allow|deny]
set resume  [allow|deny]
set stop-paging-indication [allow|deny]
set suspend [allow|deny]

### RAT Timeout Profile Configuration

```plaintext
config gtp rat-timeout-profile
Description: RAT timeout profile
edit <name>
set eutran-timeout {integer}
set gan-timeout    {integer}
set geran-timeout  {integer}
set hspa-timeout   {integer}
set ltem-timeout   {integer}
set nbiot-timeout  {integer}
set nr-timeout     {integer}
set utran-timeout  {integer}
set virtual-timeout {integer}
set wlan-timeout   {integer}
next
end
```

# FortiOS 7.4.5 CLI Reference

## GTP Tunnel Limit Configuration

The GTP tunnel limiter configuration allows you to set limits on the number of GTP tunnels.

### Configuration Command

```plaintext
config gtp tunnel-limit
Description: GTP tunnel limiter.
edit <name>
set tunnel-limit {integer}
next
end
```

### Parameters

| Parameter     | Description                                  | Type    | Size        | Default |
|---------------|----------------------------------------------|---------|-------------|---------|
| name          | Tunnel limiter name.                         | string  | Maximum length: 63 |         |
| tunnel-limit  | Tunnel limit [1, 16000000].                 | integer | Minimum value: 1 | Maximum value: 16000000 |
```

```markdown
# ICAP Configuration

This section includes syntax for the following commands:

- `config icap profile` on page 641
- `config icap server-group` on page 647
- `config icap server` on page 648

## Config ICAP Profile

Configure ICAP profiles.

### Command Syntax

```plaintext
config icap profile
```

#### Description

Configure ICAP profiles.

#### Parameters

- `edit <name>`
- `set 204-response [disable|enable]`
- `set 204-size-limit {integer}`
- `set chunk-encap [disable|enable]`
- `set comment {var-string}`
- `set extension-feature {option1}, {option2}, ...`
- `set file-transfer {option1}, {option2}, ...`
- `set file-transfer-failure [error|bypass]`
- `set file-transfer-path {string}`
- `set file-transfer-server {string}`
- `set icap-block-log [disable|enable]`

#### Config ICAP Headers

Configure ICAP forwarded request headers.

```plaintext
config icap-headers
```

##### Parameters

- `edit <id>`
- `set base64-encoding [disable|enable]`
- `set content {string}`
- `set name {string}`
- `next`
- `end`

- `set methods {option1}, {option2}, ...`
- `set preview [disable|enable]`
- `set preview-data-length {integer}`
- `set replacemsg-group {string}`
- `set request [disable|enable]`
- `set request-failure [error|bypass]`
- `set request-path {string}`
- `set request-server {string}`
- `set respmod-default-action [forward|bypass]`

#### Config Response Mode Forward Rules

ICAP response mode forward rules.

```plaintext
config respmod-forward-rules
```

##### Parameters

- `edit <name>`
- `set action [forward|bypass]`

#### Config Header Group

HTTP header group.

```plaintext
config header-group
```

##### Parameters

- `edit <id>`
- `set case-sensitivity [disable|enable]`
```

# FortiOS 7.4.5 CLI Reference

## ICAP Profile Configuration

### Parameters

| Parameter            | Description                                                        | Type        | Size     | Default  | |
|----------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------|----------|----------|---|
| 204-response          | Enable/disable allowance of 204 response from ICAP server.        | option      | -        | disable  | |
|                      | **Option**          | **Description**                                          |             |          |          |
|                      | disable             | Disable allowance of 204 response from ICAP server.    |             |          |          |
|                      | enable              | Enable allowance of 204 response from ICAP server.     |             |          |          |
| 204-size-limit       | 204 response size limit to be saved by ICAP client in megabytes. | integer     | Minimum value: 1 | Maximum value: 10 | |
| chunk-encap          | Enable/disable chunked encapsulation.                             | option      | -        | disable  | |
|                      | **Option**          | **Description**                                          |             |          |          |
|                      | disable             | Do not encapsulate chunked data.                          |             |          |          |
|                      | enable              | Encapsulate chunked data into a new chunk.               |             |          |          |
| comment              | Comment.                                                        | var-string  | Maximum length: 255 |          | |
| extension-feature     | Enable/disable ICAP extension features.                          | option      | -        |          | |
|                      | **Option**          | **Description**                                          |             |          |          |
|                      | scan-progress       | Support X-Scan-Progress-Interval ICAP header.            |             |          |          |

### Configuration Commands

```plaintext
set header {string}
set header-name {string}
next
end
set host {string}
set http-resp-status-code <code1>, <code2>, ...
next
end
set response [disable|enable]
set response-failure [error|bypass]
set response-path {string}
set response-req-hdr [disable|enable]
set response-server {string}
set scan-progress-interval {integer}
set streaming-content-bypass [disable|enable]
set timeout {integer}
next
end
```

## File Transfer Configuration

### Parameters

| Parameter                | Description                                                                 | Type   | Size            | Default  |

|                          | **Option**                     | **Description**                                                                 | | |
|                          | ssh                           | Forward file transfer with SSH protocol to ICAP server for further processing.  | | |
|                          | ftp                           | Forward file transfer with FTP protocol to ICAP server for further processing.  | | |
| file-transfer-failure    | Action to take if the ICAP server cannot be contacted when processing a file transfer. | option | -               | error    |
|                          | **Option**                     | **Description**                                                                 | | |
|                          | error                         | Error.                                                                         | | |
|                          | bypass                        | Bypass.                                                                       | | |
| file-transfer-path       | Path component of the ICAP URI that identifies the file transfer processing service. | string | Maximum length: 127 | -        |
| file-transfer-server      | ICAP server to use for a file transfer.                                   | string | Maximum length: 63  | -        |
| icap-block-log           | Enable/disable UTM log when infection found.                             | option | -               | disable  |
|                          | **Option**                     | **Description**                                                                 | | |
|                          | disable                       | Disable UTM log when infection found.                                         | | |
|                          | enable                        | Enable UTM log when infection found.                                          | | |
| methods                  | The allowed HTTP methods that will be sent to ICAP server for further processing. | option | -               | delete get |
|                          | **Option**                     | **Description**                                                                 | | |
|                          | delete                        | Forward HTTP request or response with DELETE method to ICAP server for further processing. | | |
|                          | get                           | Forward HTTP request or response with GET method to ICAP server for further processing. | | |
|                          | head                          | Forward HTTP request or response with HEAD method to ICAP server for further processing. | | |
|                          | options                       | Forward HTTP request or response with OPTIONS method to ICAP server for further processing. | | |
|                          | post                          | Forward HTTP request or response with POST method to ICAP server for further processing. | | |
|                          | put                           | Forward HTTP request or response with PUT method to ICAP server for further processing. | | |
|                          | trace                         | Forward HTTP request or response with TRACE method to ICAP server for further processing. | | |
|                          | connect                       | Forward HTTP request or response with CONNECT method to ICAP server for further processing. | | |
|                          | other                         | Forward HTTP request or response with OTHER method to ICAP server for further processing. | | |
```

```markdown
# FortiOS 7.4.5 CLI Reference

## Parameters

| Parameter          | Description                                                             | Type   | Size            | Default  |
|--------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------|-----------------|----------|
| error              | Error.                                                                  |        |                 |          |
| bypass             | Bypass.                                                                 |        |                 |          |
| request-path       | Path component of the ICAP URI that identifies the HTTP request processing service. | string | Maximum length: 127 |          |
| request-server     | ICAP server to use for an HTTP request.                                 | string | Maximum length: 63  |          |
| respmod-default-action | Default action to ICAP response modification (respmod) processing. | option | -               | forward   |

### Options for `respmod-default-action`

| Option   | Description                                                                 |
|----------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| forward  | Forward response to ICAP server unless a rule specifies not to.            |
| bypass   | Don't forward request to ICAP server unless a rule specifies to forward the request. |

| Parameter          | Description                                                             | Type   | Size            | Default  |
|--------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------|-----------------|----------|
| response           | Enable/disable whether an HTTP response is passed to an ICAP server.    | option | -               | disable   |

### Options for `response`

| Option   | Description                                                                 |
|----------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| disable  | Disable HTTP response passing to ICAP server.                               |
| enable   | Enable HTTP response passing to ICAP server.                                |

| Parameter          | Description                                                             | Type   | Size            | Default  |
|--------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------|-----------------|----------|

# ICAP Server Configuration

## Overview
Configure an ICAP server group consisting of multiple forward servers. This configuration supports failover and load balancing.

## Configuration Steps

### 1. Configure ICAP Server Group
To configure an ICAP server group, use the following command:

```plaintext
config icap server-group
```

#### Parameters
| Parameter     | Description                                                                 | Type    | Size                | Default  | |
|---------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|---------|---------------------|----------|---|
| ldb-method    | Load balance method.                                                        | option  | -                   | weighted  | |
|               | **Options**                                                                 |         |                     |          | |
|               | `weighted`         | Load balance traffic to forward servers based on assigned weights.  |         |                     |          |
|               | `least-session`    | Send new sessions to the server with the lowest session count.      |         |                     |          |
|               | `active-passive`   | Send new sessions to the active server with high weight.           |         |                     |          |
| name          | Configure an ICAP server group consisting of one or multiple forward servers. Supports failover and load balancing. | string  | Maximum length: 63  |          | |

### 2. Edit Server Group
To edit a specific server group, use the following command:

```plaintext
edit <name>
```

#### 2.1 Configure Load Balancing Method
Set the load balancing method with the following command:

```plaintext
set ldb-method [weighted|least-session|active-passive]
```

### 3. Configure Server List
To add ICAP servers to a list to form a server group, use the following command:

```plaintext
config server-list
```

#### Parameters
| Parameter     | Description                                                                 | Type    | Size                | Default  |
|---------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|---------|---------------------|----------|
| name          | ICAP server name.                                                          | string  | Maximum length: 63  |          |
| weight        | Optionally assign a weight of the forwarding server for weighted load balancing. | integer | Minimum value: 1    | Maximum value: 100 |

### 4. Edit Server
To configure ICAP servers, use the following command:

```plaintext
config icap server
```

#### 4.1 Edit Server
To edit a specific ICAP server, use the following command:

```plaintext
edit <name>
```

## Conclusion
This documentation provides the necessary commands and parameters to configure ICAP server groups and servers effectively. Ensure to follow the specified parameters for optimal configuration.

## config ips custom

Configure IPS custom signature.

```plaintext
config ips custom
```

### Description

Configure IPS custom signature.

#### Syntax

```plaintext
edit <tag>
set action   [pass|block]
set application    {user}
set comment {string}
set location   {user}
set log   [disable|enable]
set log-packet   [disable|enable]
set os {user}
set protocol   {user}
set rule-id {integer}
set severity   {user}
set signature {var-string}
set status   [disable|enable]
next
end
```

### Parameters

| Parameter   | Description                                         | Type    | Size | Default |
|-------------|-----------------------------------------------------|---------|------|---------|
| action      | Default action (pass or block) for this signature. | option  | -    | pass    |

#### Option Descriptions

| Option | Description                              |
|--------|------------------------------------------|
| pass   | Pass or allow matching traffic.          |
| block  | Block or drop matching traffic.          |

**FortiOS 7.4.5 CLI Reference**

|                  | **Option**            | **Description**                                          |         |         |             |
|                  | periodical           | After an anomaly is detected, allow the number of packets per second according to the anomaly configuration. | | | |
|                  | continuous           | Block packets once an anomaly is detected. Overrides individual anomaly settings. | | | |

| Parameter        | Description                                                  | Type    | Size    | Default     | |
|------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------|---------|---------|-------------|---|

| cp-accel-mode    | IPS Pattern matching acceleration/offloading to CPx processors. | option  | -       | advanced    | |
|                  | **Option**            | **Description**                                          |         |         |             |
|                  | none                | CPx acceleration/offloading disabled.                     | | | |
|                  | basic               | Offload basic pattern matching to CPx processors.        | | | |
|                  | advanced            | Offload more types of pattern matching resulting in higher throughput than basic mode. Requires two CP8s or one CP9. | | | |

| Parameter        | Description                                                  | Type    | Size    | Default     |
|------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------|---------|---------|-------------|
| database         | Regular or extended IPS database. Regular protects against the latest common and in-the-wild attacks. Extended includes protection from legacy attacks. | option  | -       | extended ** |

```plaintext
set action [pass|block|...]
set application {user}
set cve <cve-entry1>, <cve-entry2>, ...
set default-action [all|pass|...]
set default-status [all|enable|...]
```

### Config Exempt IP

Description: Traffic from selected source or destination IP addresses is exempt from this signature.

#### Edit `<id>`

```plaintext
set dst-ip {ipv4-classnet}
set src-ip {ipv4-classnet}
```

```plaintext
next
end

```markdown
# FortiOS 7.4.5 CLI Reference

## Configuration Entries

### Parameters

| Parameter         | Description                                               | Type   | Size          | Default   |
|-------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------|--------|---------------|-----------|
| **disable**       | Do not scan connections to botnet servers.                |        |               |           |
| **block**         | Block connections to botnet servers.                      |        |               |           |
| **monitor**       | Log connections to botnet servers.                        |        |               |           |

### Action

| Parameter         | Description                                               | Type   | Size          | Default   |
|-------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------|--------|---------------|-----------|
| **action**        | Action taken with traffic in which signatures are detected.| option | -             | default   |

#### Options

| Option            | Description                                               |
|-------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------|
| **pass**          | Pass or allow matching traffic.                           |
| **block**         | Block or drop matching traffic.                           |
| **reset**         | Reset sessions for matching traffic.                      |
| **default**       | Pass or drop matching traffic, depending on the default action of the signature. |

### Application

| Parameter         | Description                                               | Type   | Size          | Default   |
|-------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------|--------|---------------|-----------|
| **application**   | Operating systems to be protected. Use all for every application and other for unlisted application. | user   | Not Specified | all       |

### CVE Entry

| Parameter         | Description                                               | Type   | Size          | Default   |
|-------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------|--------|---------------|-----------|
| **cve <cve-entry>** | List of CVE IDs of the signatures to add to the sensor. | string | Maximum length: 19 |           |
|                   | CVE IDs or CVE wildcards.                                |        |               |           |

### Default Action

| Parameter         | Description                                               | Type   | Size          | Default   |
|-------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------|--------|---------------|-----------|
| **default-action**| Signature default action filter.                          | option | -             | all       |

#### Options

| Option            | Description                                               |
|-------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------|
| **all**           | Selects signatures with any default action.              |
| **pass**          | Selects signatures with default action 'pass'.           |
| **block**         | Selects signatures with default action 'block'.          |

### Default Status

| Parameter         | Description                                               | Type   | Size          | Default   |
|-------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------|--------|---------------|-----------|
| **default-status**| Signature default status filter.                          | option | -             | all       |

#### Options

| Option            | Description                                               |
|-------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------|
| **all**           | Selects signatures with any default status.              |
| **enable**        | Selects signatures enabled by default.                   |
| **disable**       | Selects signatures disabled by default.                  |

|                   |                                                                             |         | Maximum value: 8192 |         |
| packet-log-post-attack | Number of packets to log after the IPS signature is detected.          | integer | Minimum value: 0 | 0       |
|                   |                                                                             |         | Maximum value: 255 |         |
| proxy-inline-ips  | Enable/disable proxy-mode policy inline IPS support.                        | option  | -        | enable  |

|----------|--------------------------------------------------------------|

```markdown
# FortiOS 7.4.5 CLI Reference

## Azure Security Center Logging Configuration

### Configuration Parameters

| Parameter          | Description                                             | Type   | Size | Default   |
|--------------------|---------------------------------------------------------|--------|------|-----------|
| anomaly            | Enable/disable anomaly logging.                         | option | -    | enable    |
| forti-switch       | Enable/disable Forti-Switch logging.                    | option | -    | enable    |
| forward-traffic    | Enable/disable forward traffic logging.                 | option | -    | enable    |
| gtp                | Enable/disable GTP messages logging.                    | option | -    | enable    |
| local-traffic      | Enable/disable local in or out traffic logging.         | option | -    | enable    |
| multicast-traffic   | Enable/disable multicast traffic logging.               | option | -    | enable    |
| severity           | Lowest severity level to log.                           | option | -    | information |

### Option Descriptions

#### Anomaly Logging
- **enable**: Enable anomaly logging.
- **disable**: Disable anomaly logging.

#### Forti-Switch Logging
- **enable**: Enable Forti-Switch logging.
- **disable**: Disable Forti-Switch logging.

#### Forward Traffic Logging
- **enable**: Enable forward traffic logging.
- **disable**: Disable forward traffic logging.

#### GTP Messages Logging
- **enable**: Enable GTP messages logging.
- **disable**: Disable GTP messages logging.

#### Local Traffic Logging
- **enable**: Enable local in or out traffic logging.
- **disable**: Disable local in or out traffic logging.

#### Multicast Traffic Logging
- **enable**: Enable multicast traffic logging.
- **disable**: Disable multicast traffic logging.

#### Severity Level
- **information**: Lowest severity level to log.
```

## Config Log Disk Filter

Configure filters for local disk logging. Use these filters to determine the log messages to record according to severity and type.

### Configuration

```plaintext
config log disk filter
Description: Configure filters for local disk logging. Use these filters to determine the log messages to record according to severity and type.
set anomaly [enable|disable]
set dlp-archive [enable|disable]
set forti-switch [enable|disable]
set forward-traffic [enable|disable]
config free-style
Description: Free style filters.
edit <id>
set category [traffic|event|...]
set filter {string}
set filter-type [include|exclude]
next
end
set gtp [enable|disable]
set local-traffic [enable|disable]
set multicast-traffic [enable|disable]
set severity [emergency|alert|...]
set sniffer-traffic [enable|disable]
set voip [enable|disable]
set ztna-traffic [enable|disable]
end
```

### Parameters

| Parameter | Description                                 | Type   | Size | Default |
|-----------|---------------------------------------------|--------|------|---------|
| anomaly   | Enable/disable anomaly logging.             | option | -    | enable  |
```

- **Description**: Free style filter string.
- **Type**: string
- **Size**: Maximum length: 1023

### Filter Type

- **Description**: Include/exclude logs that match the filter.
- **Type**: option
- **Default**: include

| Option   | Description                                      |
|----------|--------------------------------------------------|
| include  | Include logs that match the filter.              |
| exclude  | Exclude logs that match the filter.              |

### ID

- **Description**: Entry ID.
- **Type**: integer
- **Size**:
- Minimum value: 0
- Maximum value: 4294967295

## Config Log Disk Setting

Settings for local disk logging.
```
---
# Config Log Disk Setting

## Description
Settings for local disk logging.

## Commands
```plaintext
set diskfull [overwrite|nolog]
set dlp-archive-quota {integer}
set full-final-warning-threshold {integer}
set full-first-warning-threshold {integer}
set full-second-warning-threshold {integer}
set interface {string}
set interface-select-method [auto|sdwan|...]
set ips-archive [enable|disable]
set log-quota {integer}
set max-log-file-size {integer}
set max-policy-packet-capture-size {integer}
set maximum-log-age {integer}
set report-quota {integer}
set roll-day {option1}, {option2}, ...
set roll-schedule [daily|weekly]
set roll-time {user}
set source-ip {ipv4-address}
set status [enable|disable]
set upload [enable|disable]
set upload-delete-files [enable|disable]
set upload-destination {option}
set upload-ssl-conn [default|high|...]
set uploaddir {string}
set uploadip {ipv4-address}
set uploadpass {password}
set uploadport {integer}
set uploadsched [disable|enable]
set uploadtime {user}
set uploadtype {option1}, {option2}, ...
set uploaduser {string}
end
```

## Parameters
| Parameter                     | Description                                                                 | Type     | Size     | Default    | |
|-------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------|----------|------------|---|
| diskfull                      | Action to take when disk is full. The system can overwrite the oldest log messages or stop logging when the disk is full. | option   | -        | overwrite  | |
|                               | **Option**       | **Description**                                           |            |          |            |
|                               | overwrite        | Overwrite the oldest logs when the log disk is full.   |            |          |            |
|                               | nolog           | Stop logging when the log disk is full.                 |            |          |            |
| dlp-archive-quota            | DLP archive quota (MB). Minimum value: 0, Maximum value: 4294967295.    | integer  | Minimum  | 0          | |
```

## Notes
- Ensure to replace placeholders (e.g., `{integer}`, `{string}`, `{ipv4-address}`, etc.) with actual values as per your configuration needs.
- The commands and parameters are specific to FortiOS 7.4.5 CLI Reference.

# FortiAnalyzer Cloud Override Filter Configuration

## Overview
Override filters for FortiAnalyzer Cloud.

## Configuration Command
```plaintext
config log fortianalyzer-cloud override-filter
```

### Parameters
- **anomaly**: Enable/disable anomaly logging.
- **dlp-archive**: Enable/disable DLP archive logging.
- **forti-switch**: Enable/disable Forti-Switch logging.
- **forward-traffic**: Enable/disable forwarding of traffic.
- **gtp**: Enable/disable GTP logging.
- **local-traffic**: Enable/disable local traffic logging.
- **multicast-traffic**: Enable/disable multicast traffic logging.
- **severity**: Set the severity level (emergency, alert, etc.).
- **sniffer-traffic**: Enable/disable sniffer traffic logging.
- **voip**: Enable/disable VoIP logging.
- **ztna-traffic**: Enable/disable ZTNA traffic logging.

### Free Style Filters
```plaintext
config free-style
```
#### Description
Free style filters.

#### Commands
```plaintext
edit <id>
set category [traffic|event|...]
set filter {string}
set filter-type [include|exclude]
next
end
```

# FortiAnalyzer Cloud Configuration

## Global FortiAnalyzer Cloud Settings

The following commands are used to configure global settings for FortiAnalyzer Cloud.

```plaintext
config log fortianalyzer-cloud setting
```

### Parameters

| Parameter                | Description                                                       | Type    | Size  | Default |
|--------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------|---------|-------|---------|
| access-config            | Enable/disable FortiAnalyzer access to configuration and data.   | option  | -     | enable  |
| certificate              | Certificate used to communicate with FortiAnalyzer.               | string  | Maximum length: 35 |         |
| certificate-verification  | Enable/disable identity verification of FortiAnalyzer by use of certificate. | option  | -     | enable  |
| conn-timeout            | Connection timeout in seconds.                                   | integer | -     |         |
| enc-algorithm           | Encryption algorithm to use.                                     | option  | -     |         |
| hmac-algorithm          | HMAC algorithm to use.                                          | option  | -     |         |
| interface               | Interface to use for communication.                              | string  | -     |         |
| interface-select-method  | Method to select the interface.                                  | option  | -     |         |
| ips-archive             | Enable/disable IPS archive.                                     | option  | -     |         |
| max-log-rate            | Maximum log rate.                                               | integer | -     |         |
| monitor-failure-retry-period | Period to retry on monitor failure.                          | integer | -     |         |
| monitor-keepalive-period | Period to keep the connection alive.                             | integer | -     |         |
| preshared-key           | Preshared key for authentication.                               | string  | -     |         |
| priority                | Priority level for the connection.                               | option  | -     | default |
| serial                  | Serial numbers for the devices.                                  | string  | -     |         |
| source-ip               | Source IP address for communication.                             | string  | -     |         |
| ssl-min-proto-version   | Minimum SSL protocol version to use.                             | option  | -     | default |
| status                  | Enable/disable the logging status.                               | option  | -     | enable  |
| upload-day              | Day of the week for uploads.                                    | user    | -     |         |
| upload-interval         | Frequency of uploads.                                           | option  | -     | daily   |
| upload-option           | Upload option to use.                                           | option  | -     | store-and-upload |
| upload-time             | Time of day for uploads.                                       | user    | -     |         |
```

### Option Descriptions

- **access-config**
- **enable**: Enable FortiAnalyzer access to configuration and data.
- **disable**: Disable FortiAnalyzer access to configuration and data.

- **certificate-verification**
- **enable**: Enable identity verification of FortiAnalyzer by use of certificate.
- **disable**: Disable identity verification of FortiAnalyzer by use of certificate.
```

set upload-time {user}
set use-management-vdom [enable|disable]
end
```

### Parameters

| Parameter            | Description                                               | Type     | Size         | Default |
|----------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------|----------|--------------|---------|
| access-config        | Enable/disable FortiAnalyzer access to configuration and data. | option   | -            | enable  |
| alt-server           | Alternate FortiAnalyzer.                                  | string   | Maximum length: 127 |         |
| certificate          | Certificate used to communicate with FortiAnalyzer.       | string   | Maximum length: 35  |         |
| certificate-verification | Enable/disable identity verification of FortiAnalyzer by use of certificate. | option   | -            | enable  |
| conn-timeout         | FortiAnalyzer connection time-out in seconds (for status and log buffer). | integer  | Minimum value: 1, Maximum value: 3600 | 10      |
| enc-algorithm        | Configure the level of SSL protection for secure communication with FortiAnalyzer. | option   | -            | high    |

#### Option Descriptions

- **access-config**
- **enable**: Enable FortiAnalyzer access to configuration and data.
- **disable**: Disable FortiAnalyzer access to configuration and data.

- **certificate-verification**
- **enable**: Enable identity verification of FortiAnalyzer by use of certificate.
- **disable**: Disable identity verification of FortiAnalyzer by use of certificate.

- **enc-algorithm**
- **high-medium**: Encrypt logs using high and medium encryption algorithms.

```markdown
# FortiAnalyzer Configuration

## Global FortiAnalyzer Settings

The following configuration options are available for the FortiAnalyzer settings:

### Parameters

| Parameter                | Description                                                                 | Type    | Size | Default  |
|--------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|---------|------|----------|
| access-config            | Enable/disable FortiAnalyzer access to configuration and data.             | option  | -    | enable   |
| alt-server               | Alternate server address.                                                  | string  | -    | -        |
| certificate              | Certificate for secure communication.                                      | string  | -    | -        |
| certificate-verification  | Enable/disable certificate verification.                                   | option  | -    | enable   |
| conn-timeout            | Connection timeout in seconds.                                             | integer | -    | 30       |
| enc-algorithm           | Encryption algorithm to use.                                               | option  | -    | high     |
| fallback-to-primary      | Enable/disable fallback to primary server.                                 | option  | -    | enable   |
| hmac-algorithm          | HMAC algorithm to use.                                                    | option  | -    | -        |
| interface               | Network interface to use for communication.                                | string  | -    | -        |
| interface-select-method  | Method for selecting the interface.                                        | option  | -    | auto     |
| ips-archive             | Enable/disable IPS archive.                                               | option  | -    | disable  |
| max-log-rate            | Maximum log rate in logs per second.                                       | integer | -    | 1000     |
| monitor-failure-retry-period | Period to retry monitoring failures in seconds.                       | integer | -    | 60       |
| monitor-keepalive-period | Keepalive period for monitoring in seconds.                               | integer | -    | 30       |
| preshared-key           | Preshared key for secure communication.                                    | string  | -    | -        |
| priority                | Priority level for log transmission.                                       | option  | -    | default  |
| reliable                | Enable/disable reliable log transmission.                                   | option  | -    | enable   |
| serial                  | Serial numbers for devices.                                                | string  | -    | -        |
| server                  | Primary server address.                                                    | string  | -    | -        |
| server-cert-ca          | Certificate authority for the server certificate.                          | string  | -    | -        |
| source-ip               | Source IP address for logs sent to FortiAnalyzer.                         | string  | -    | -        |
| ssl-min-proto-version    | Minimum SSL protocol version.                                             | option  | -    | default  |
| status                  | Enable/disable logging status.                                             | option  | -    | enable   |
| upload-day              | Day of the week for log uploads.                                          | user    | -    | -        |
| upload-interval         | Frequency of log uploads.                                                  | option  | -    | daily    |
| upload-option           | Upload option for logs.                                                    | option  | -    | store-and-upload |
| upload-time             | Time of day for log uploads.                                              | user    | -    | -        |

### Configuration Command

To configure the FortiAnalyzer settings, use the following command:

```bash
config log fortianalyzer2 setting
set access-config [enable|disable]
set alt-server {string}
set certificate {string}
set certificate-verification [enable|disable]
set conn-timeout {integer}
set enc-algorithm [high-medium|high|...]
set fallback-to-primary [enable|disable]
set hmac-algorithm {option}
set interface {string}
set interface-select-method [auto|sdwan|...]
set ips-archive [enable|disable]
set max-log-rate {integer}
set monitor-failure-retry-period {integer}
set monitor-keepalive-period {integer}
set preshared-key {string}
set priority [default|low]
set reliable [enable|disable]
set serial <name1>, <name2>, ...
set server {string}
set server-cert-ca {string}
set source-ip {string}
set ssl-min-proto-version [default|SSLv3|...]
set status [enable|disable]
set upload-day {user}
set upload-interval [daily|weekly|...]
set upload-option [store-and-upload|realtime|...]
set upload-time {user}
end
```
```

## FortiAnalyzer Filters

### Configuration Command

```plaintext
config log fortianalyzer3 filter
```

#### Description

Filters for FortiAnalyzer.

```plaintext
set anomaly [enable|disable]
set dlp-archive [enable|disable]
set forti-switch [enable|disable]
set forward-traffic [enable|disable]
```

### Free Style Filters

```plaintext
config free-style
```

#### Description

Free style filters.

```plaintext
edit <id>
set category [traffic|event|...]
set filter {string}
set filter-type [include|exclude]
next
end
```

### Additional Settings

```plaintext
set gtp [enable|disable]
set local-traffic [enable|disable]
set multicast-traffic [enable|disable]
set severity [emergency|alert|...]
set sniffer-traffic [enable|disable]
set voip [enable|disable]
set ztna-traffic [enable|disable]
end
```

# FortiAnalyzer Configuration

## Override Filters for FortiAnalyzer

The following configuration allows you to set override filters for FortiAnalyzer.

```plaintext
config log fortianalyzer3 override-filter
Description: Override filters for FortiAnalyzer.
set  anomaly [enable|disable]
set  dlp-archive [enable|disable]
set  forti-switch [enable|disable]
set  forward-traffic [enable|disable]
config free-style
Description: Free style filters.
edit <id>
set  category [traffic|event|...]
set  filter {string}
set  filter-type [include|exclude]
next
end
set  gtp [enable|disable]
set  local-traffic [enable|disable]
set  multicast-traffic [enable|disable]
set  severity [emergency|alert|...]
set  sniffer-traffic [enable|disable]
set  voip [enable|disable]
set  ztna-traffic [enable|disable]
end
```

|                | **Option**        | **Description**                       |        |      |         |
|                | enable          | Enable anomaly logging.              |        |      |         |
|                | disable         | Disable anomaly logging.             |        |      |         |
| dlp-archive    | Enable/disable DLP archive logging.        | option | -    | enable  | |

```markdown
# FortiOS 7.4.5 CLI Reference

## Configuration Commands

### Log FortiAnalyzer3 Override Setting

The following commands are used to configure the FortiAnalyzer3 override settings:

```plaintext
set reliable [enable|disable]
set serial <name1>, <name2>, ...
set server {string}
set server-cert-ca {string}
set source-ip {string}
set ssl-min-proto-version [default|SSLv3|...]
set status [enable|disable]
set upload-day {user}
set upload-interval [daily|weekly|...]
set upload-option [store-and-upload|realtime|...]
set upload-time {user}
set use-management-vdom [enable|disable]
end
```

### Parameters

| Parameter            | Description                                                       | Type     | Size         | Default |
|----------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------|----------|--------------|---------|
| access-config        | Enable/disable FortiAnalyzer access to configuration and data.   | option   | -            | enable  |
| alt-server           | Alternate FortiAnalyzer.                                          | string   | Maximum length: 127 |         |
| certificate          | Certificate used to communicate with FortiAnalyzer.               | string   | Maximum length: 35  |         |
| certificate-verification | Enable/disable identity verification of FortiAnalyzer by use of certificate. | option   | -            | enable  |
| conn-timeout         | FortiAnalyzer connection time-out in seconds (for status and log buffer). | integer  | Minimum value: 1, Maximum value: 3600 | 10      |
| enc-algorithm        | Configure the level of SSL protection for secure communication with FortiAnalyzer. | option   | -            | high    |

#### Option Descriptions

- **access-config**
- **enable**: Enable FortiAnalyzer access to configuration and data.
- **disable**: Disable FortiAnalyzer access to configuration and data.

- **certificate-verification**
- **enable**: Enable identity verification of FortiAnalyzer by use of certificate.
- **disable**: Disable identity verification of FortiAnalyzer by use of certificate.

- **enc-algorithm**
- **high-medium**: Encrypt logs using high and medium encryption algorithms.
```

```markdown
# FortiAnalyzer Configuration

## Global FortiAnalyzer Settings

The following configuration options are available for the FortiAnalyzer settings:

### Configuration Parameters

| Parameter                | Description                                                                 | Type    | Size | Default  |
|--------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|---------|------|----------|
| access-config            | Enable/disable FortiAnalyzer access to configuration and data.             | option  | -    | enable   |
| alt-server               | Alternate server address.                                                   | string  | -    | -        |
| certificate              | Certificate for secure communication.                                       | string  | -    | -        |
| certificate-verification  | Enable/disable certificate verification.                                   | option  | -    | enable   |
| conn-timeout            | Connection timeout in seconds.                                             | integer | -    | 30       |
| enc-algorithm           | Encryption algorithm to use.                                               | option  | -    | high     |
| fallback-to-primary      | Enable/disable fallback to primary server.                                 | option  | -    | enable   |
| hmac-algorithm          | HMAC algorithm to use.                                                    | option  | -    | -        |
| interface               | Network interface to use for communication.                                | string  | -    | -        |
| interface-select-method  | Method for selecting the interface.                                       | option  | -    | auto     |
| ips-archive             | Enable/disable IPS archive.                                               | option  | -    | disable  |
| max-log-rate            | Maximum log rate in logs per second.                                      | integer | -    | 1000     |
| monitor-failure-retry-period | Period to retry monitoring failures in seconds.                       | integer | -    | 60       |
| monitor-keepalive-period | Keepalive period for monitoring in seconds.                               | integer | -    | 30       |
| preshared-key           | Preshared key for secure communication.                                    | string  | -    | -        |
| priority                | Priority level for the connection.                                         | option  | -    | default  |
| reliable                | Enable/disable reliable connection.                                        | option  | -    | enable   |
| serial                  | Serial numbers for devices.                                                | <name1>, <name2>, ... | - | -        |
| server                  | Primary server address.                                                    | string  | -    | -        |
| server-cert-ca          | Certificate authority for the server certificate.                          | string  | -    | -        |
| source-ip               | Source IP address for logs sent to FortiAnalyzer.                         | string  | -    | -        |
| ssl-min-proto-version    | Minimum SSL protocol version.                                             | option  | -    | default  |
| status                  | Enable/disable the FortiAnalyzer logging.                                  | option  | -    | enable   |
| upload-day              | User-defined upload day.                                                  | user    | -    | -        |
| upload-interval         | Upload interval (daily, weekly, etc.).                                    | option  | -    | daily    |
| upload-option           | Upload option (store-and-upload, realtime, etc.).                         | option  | -    | store-and-upload |
| upload-time             | User-defined upload time.                                                 | user    | -    | -        |

### Configuration Command

To configure the FortiAnalyzer settings, use the following command:

```bash
config log fortianalyzer3 setting
set access-config [enable|disable]
set alt-server {string}
set certificate {string}
set certificate-verification [enable|disable]
set conn-timeout {integer}
set enc-algorithm [high-medium|high|...]
set fallback-to-primary [enable|disable]
set hmac-algorithm {option}
set interface {string}
set interface-select-method [auto|sdwan|...]
set ips-archive [enable|disable]
set max-log-rate {integer}
set monitor-failure-retry-period {integer}
set monitor-keepalive-period {integer}
set preshared-key {string}
set priority [default|low]
set reliable [enable|disable]
set serial <name1>, <name2>, ...
set server {string}
set server-cert-ca {string}
set source-ip {string}
set ssl-min-proto-version [default|SSLv3|...]
set status [enable|disable]
set upload-day {user}
set upload-interval [daily|weekly|...]
set upload-option [store-and-upload|realtime|...]
set upload-time {user}
end
```
```

next

# FortiAnalyzer Override Filter Configuration

## Overview
Override filters for FortiAnalyzer.

## Configuration Command
```plaintext
config log fortianalyzer override-filter
```

### Parameters
- **anomaly**: Enable/disable anomaly logging.
- **dlp-archive**: Enable/disable DLP archive logging.
- **forti-switch**: Enable/disable Forti-Switch logging.
- **forward-traffic**: Enable/disable forwarding of traffic.
- **gtp**: Enable/disable GTP logging.
- **local-traffic**: Enable/disable local traffic logging.
- **multicast-traffic**: Enable/disable multicast traffic logging.
- **severity**: Set the severity level (emergency, alert, etc.).
- **sniffer-traffic**: Enable/disable sniffer traffic logging.
- **voip**: Enable/disable VoIP logging.
- **ztna-traffic**: Enable/disable ZTNA traffic logging.

### Free Style Filters
```plaintext
config free-style
```
#### Description
Free style filters.

#### Edit Command
```plaintext
edit <id>
```
##### Parameters
- **category**: Set the category (traffic, event, etc.).
- **filter**: Set the filter string.
- **filter-type**: Set the filter type (include, exclude).

#### End Command
```plaintext
next
end
```

```markdown
# FortiOS 7.4.5 CLI Reference

## Configuration Commands

### Log FortiAnalyzer Override Setting

The following commands are used to configure the FortiAnalyzer override settings:

```plaintext
set reliable [enable|disable]
set serial <name1>, <name2>, ...
set server {string}
set server-cert-ca {string}
set source-ip {string}
set ssl-min-proto-version [default|SSLv3|...]
set status [enable|disable]
set upload-day {user}
set upload-interval [daily|weekly|...]
set upload-option [store-and-upload|realtime|...]
set upload-time {user}
set use-management-vdom [enable|disable]
end
```

### Parameters

| Parameter            | Description                                               | Type     | Size         | Default |
|----------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------|----------|--------------|---------|
| access-config        | Enable/disable FortiAnalyzer access to configuration and data. | option   | -            | enable  |
| alt-server           | Alternate FortiAnalyzer.                                  | string   | Maximum length: 127 |         |
| certificate          | Certificate used to communicate with FortiAnalyzer.       | string   | Maximum length: 35  |         |
| certificate-verification | Enable/disable identity verification of FortiAnalyzer by use of certificate. | option   | -            | enable  |
| conn-timeout         | FortiAnalyzer connection time-out in seconds (for status and log buffer). | integer  | Minimum value: 1 | 10      |
|                      |                                                       |          | Maximum value: 3600 |         |
| enc-algorithm        | Configure the level of SSL protection for secure communication with FortiAnalyzer. | option   | -            | high    |

#### Options for `access-config`
- **enable**: Enable FortiAnalyzer access to configuration and data.
- **disable**: Disable FortiAnalyzer access to configuration and data.

#### Options for `certificate-verification`
- **enable**: Enable identity verification of FortiAnalyzer by use of certificate.
- **disable**: Disable identity verification of FortiAnalyzer by use of certificate.

#### Options for `enc-algorithm`
- **high-medium**: Encrypt logs using high and medium encryption algorithms.
```

```markdown
# FortiAnalyzer Configuration

## Global FortiAnalyzer Settings

The following configuration options are available for setting up FortiAnalyzer.

### Configuration Parameters

| Parameter                | Description                                                                 | Type    | Size | Default  |
|--------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|---------|------|----------|
| access-config            | Enable/disable FortiAnalyzer access to configuration and data.             | option  | -    | enable   |
| alt-server               | Alternate server address for FortiAnalyzer.                                | string  | -    | -        |
| certificate              | Certificate for secure communication.                                       | string  | -    | -        |
| certificate-verification  | Enable/disable certificate verification.                                   | option  | -    | enable   |
| conn-timeout            | Connection timeout in seconds.                                             | integer | -    | 30       |
| enc-algorithm           | Encryption algorithm to use.                                               | option  | -    | high     |
| fallback-to-primary      | Enable/disable fallback to primary server.                                 | option  | -    | enable   |
| hmac-algorithm          | HMAC algorithm to use.                                                    | option  | -    | -        |
| interface               | Network interface to use for communication.                                | string  | -    | -        |
| interface-select-method  | Method for selecting the interface.                                       | option  | -    | auto     |
| ips-archive             | Enable/disable IPS archive.                                               | option  | -    | disable   |
| max-log-rate            | Maximum log rate in logs per second.                                      | integer | -    | 1000     |
| monitor-failure-retry-period | Period to retry monitoring failure in seconds.                        | integer | -    | 60       |
| monitor-keepalive-period | Keepalive period for monitoring in seconds.                               | integer | -    | 30       |
| preshared-key           | Preshared key for secure communication.                                    | string  | -    | -        |
| priority                | Priority level for the connection.                                         | option  | -    | default  |
| reliable                | Enable/disable reliable connection.                                        | option  | -    | enable   |
| serial                  | Serial numbers for devices.                                               | string  | -    | -        |
| server                  | Primary server address for FortiAnalyzer.                                  | string  | -    | -        |
| server-cert-ca          | Certificate authority for the server certificate.                          | string  | -    | -        |
| source-ip               | Source IP address for logs sent to FortiAnalyzer.                          | string  | -    | -        |
| ssl-min-proto-version    | Minimum SSL protocol version to use.                                      | option  | -    | default  |
| status                  | Enable/disable the FortiAnalyzer logging.                                  | option  | -    | enable   |
| upload-day              | Day of the week for log uploads.                                          | user    | -    | -        |
| upload-interval         | Frequency of log uploads.                                                  | option  | -    | daily    |
| upload-option           | Upload option for logs.                                                   | option  | -    | store-and-upload |
| upload-time             | Time of day for log uploads.                                              | user    | -    | -        |

### Configuration Command

To configure the FortiAnalyzer settings, use the following command structure:

```bash
config log fortianalyzer setting
set access-config [enable|disable]
set alt-server {string}
set certificate {string}
set certificate-verification [enable|disable]
set conn-timeout {integer}
set enc-algorithm [high-medium|high|...]
set fallback-to-primary [enable|disable]
set hmac-algorithm {option}
set interface {string}
set interface-select-method [auto|sdwan|...]
set ips-archive [enable|disable]
set max-log-rate {integer}
set monitor-failure-retry-period {integer}
set monitor-keepalive-period {integer}
set preshared-key {string}
set priority [default|low]
set reliable [enable|disable]
set serial <name1>, <name2>, ...
set server {string}
set server-cert-ca {string}
set source-ip {string}
set ssl-min-proto-version [default|SSLv3|...]
set status [enable|disable]
set upload-day {user}
set upload-interval [daily|weekly|...]
set upload-option [store-and-upload|realtime|...]
set upload-time {user}
end
```

| alt-server            | Alternate FortiAnalyzer.                                  | string  | Maximum length: 127 |          |
| certificate           | Certificate used to communicate with FortiAnalyzer.       | string  | Maximum length: 35  |          |
| conn-timeout          | FortiAnalyzer connection time-out in seconds (for status and log buffer). | integer | Minimum value: 10   |          |
| enc-algorithm         | Configure the level of SSL protection for secure communication with FortiAnalyzer. | option  | -                   | high     |
| fallback-to-primary    | Enable/disable this FortiGate unit to fallback to the primary FortiAnalyzer when it is available. | option  | -                   | enable   |
| hmac-algorithm        | OFTP login hash algorithm.                                | option  | -                   | sha256   |

### Option Descriptions

#### alt-server
- **enable**: Enable FortiAnalyzer access to configuration and data.
- **disable**: Disable FortiAnalyzer access to configuration and data.

#### certificate-verification
- **enable**: Enable identity verification of FortiAnalyzer by use of certificate.
- **disable**: Disable identity verification of FortiAnalyzer by use of certificate.

#### conn-timeout
- Minimum value: 1
- Maximum value: 3600

#### enc-algorithm
- **high-medium**: Encrypt logs using high and medium encryption algorithms.
- **high**: Encrypt logs using high encryption algorithms.
- **low**: Encrypt logs using all encryption algorithms.

#### fallback-to-primary
- **enable**: Enable this FortiGate unit to fallback to the primary FortiAnalyzer when it is available.
- **disable**: Disable this FortiGate unit to fallback to the primary FortiAnalyzer when it is available.
```

# FortiOS 7.4.5 CLI Reference

## Configuration of FortiGuard Override Settings

Override global FortiCloud logging settings for this VDOM.

### Command Structure

```plaintext
config log fortiguard override-setting
```

#### Description

Override global FortiCloud logging settings for this VDOM.

### Parameters

| Parameter        | Description                                                        | Type    | Size    | Default |
|------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------|---------|---------|---------|
| access-config     | Enable/disable FortiCloud access to configuration and data.       | option  | -       | enable  |
|                  | **Option**                | **Description**                                      | | |
|                  | enable                   | Enable FortiCloud access to configuration and data. | | |
|                  | disable                  | Disable FortiCloud access to configuration and data. | | |
| max-log-rate      | Maximum log rate.                                               | integer | Minimum | -       |
|                  | Minimum value: 0                                              |         |         |         |
|                  | Maximum value: 4294967295                                     |         |         |         |
| override          | Enable/disable override of global settings.                    | option  | -       | enable  |
| priority          | Set the priority level.                                        | option  | -       | default |
| status            | Enable/disable logging status.                                 | option  | -       | enable  |
| upload-day        | Specify the upload day.                                        | user    | -       | -       |
| upload-interval   | Set the upload interval.                                       | option  | -       | daily   |
|                  | **Option**                | **Description**                                      | | |
|                  | daily                    | Upload logs daily.                                   | | |
|                  | weekly                   | Upload logs weekly.                                  | | |
| upload-option     | Set the upload option.                                        | option  | -       | store-and-upload |
|                  | **Option**                | **Description**                                      | | |
|                  | store-and-upload         | Store logs and upload them.                          | | |
|                  | realtime                 | Upload logs in real-time.                            | | |
| upload-time       | Specify the upload time.                                      | user    | -       | -       |
```

### Example Command

```plaintext
config log fortiguard override-setting
set access-config enable
set max-log-rate 100
set override enable
set priority low
set status enable
set upload-day 1
set upload-interval daily
set upload-option realtime
set upload-time 12:00
end
```

```markdown
# FortiOS 7.4.5 CLI Reference

## Configuring Logging to FortiCloud

### Command Structure

To configure logging to FortiCloud, use the following command structure:

```plaintext
config log fortiguard setting
```

### Description

Configure logging to FortiCloud.

### Parameters

| Parameter          | Description                                                                 | Type     | Size     | Default  |
|--------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------|----------|----------|
| access-config      | Enable/disable FortiCloud access to configuration and data.                | option   | -        | enable   |
|                    | **Option**          | **Description**                                                  | | |
|                    | enable             | Enable FortiCloud access to configuration and data.            | | |
|                    | disable            | Disable FortiCloud access to configuration and data.           | | |
| conn-timeout       | FortiGate Cloud connection timeout in seconds.                           | integer  | Minimum  | 10       |
|                    |                    | Maximum value: 3600                                            | | |
| enc-algorithm      | Configure the level of SSL protection for secure communication with FortiCloud. | option   | -        | high     |
| interface          | Specify the interface to use for logging.                                | string   | -        | Not Specified |
| interface-select-method | Method to select the interface.                                   | option   | -        | auto     |
| max-log-rate       | Maximum log rate in logs per second.                                     | integer  | -        | Not Specified |
| priority           | Set the priority of the logs.                                            | option   | -        | default  |
| source-ip          | Specify the source IP address for logging.                               | ipv4-address | -    | Not Specified |
| ssl-min-proto-version | Minimum SSL protocol version to use.                                 | option   | -        | default  |
| status             | Enable or disable logging.                                               | option   | -        | enable   |
| upload-day         | Specify the day for log uploads.                                         | user     | -        | Not Specified |
| upload-interval    | Specify the upload interval.                                             | option   | -        | daily    |
| upload-option      | Specify the upload option.                                               | option   | -        | store-and-upload |
| upload-time        | Time of day to roll logs (hh:mm).                                       | user     | -        | Not Specified |

### Example Configuration

```plaintext
config log fortiguard setting
set access-config enable
set conn-timeout 30
set enc-algorithm high
set interface port1
set interface-select-method auto
set max-log-rate 100
set priority default
set source-ip 192.168.1.1
set ssl-min-proto-version SSLv3
set status enable
set upload-day Monday
set upload-interval daily
set upload-option store-and-upload
set upload-time 02:00
end
```
```

config log gui-display

end
```

## Configuration Commands

### Logging Configuration

To configure logging settings, use the following commands:

```plaintext
set voip [enable|disable]
set ztna-traffic [enable|disable]
end

### Log Memory Filter Configuration

The following parameters can be configured for log memory filtering:

| Parameter         | Description                                           | Type   | Size | Default |
|-------------------|-------------------------------------------------------|--------|------|---------|
| anomaly           | Enable/disable anomaly logging.                       | option | -    | enable  |
| forti-switch      | Enable/disable Forti-Switch logging.                 | option | -    | enable  |
| forward-traffic   | Enable/disable forward traffic logging.               | option | -    | enable  |
| gtp *             | Enable/disable GTP messages logging.                  | option | -    | enable  |
| local-traffic     | Enable/disable local in or out traffic logging.      | option | -    | enable ** |
| multicast-traffic | Enable/disable multicast traffic logging.             | option | -    | enable  |

#### Option Descriptions

- **anomaly**
- `enable`: Enable anomaly logging.
- `disable`: Disable anomaly logging.

- **forti-switch**
- `enable`: Enable Forti-Switch logging.
- `disable`: Disable Forti-Switch logging.

- **forward-traffic**
- `enable`: Enable forward traffic logging.
- `disable`: Disable forward traffic logging.

- **gtp**
- `enable`: Enable GTP messages logging.
- `disable`: Disable GTP messages logging.

- **local-traffic**
- `enable`: Enable local in or out traffic logging.
- `disable`: Disable local in or out traffic logging.

- **multicast-traffic**
- `enable`: Enable multicast traffic logging.
- `disable`: Disable multicast traffic logging.
```

## Configuring Log Memory Global Settings

### Description
Global settings for memory logging.

### Commands
```plaintext

| Parameter                     | Description                                               | Type     | Size          | Default          |
|-------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------|----------|---------------|------------------|

| full-first-warning-threshold   | Log full first warning threshold as a percent.           | integer  | Minimum value: 1  | 75               |
|                               |                                                           |          | Maximum value: 98  | |
| full-second-warning-threshold  | Log full second warning threshold as a percent.          | integer  | Minimum value: 2  | 90               |
|                               |                                                           |          | Maximum value: 99  | |
| max-size                      | Maximum amount of memory that can be used for memory logging in bytes. | integer  | Minimum value: 0  | 168439726 **     |
|                               |                                                           |          | Maximum value: 4294967295 | |

## Parameters

| Parameter                | Description                                            | Type   | Size | Default |
|--------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------|--------|------|---------|
| local-out-ioc-detection  | Enable/disable local-out traffic IoC detection.       | option | -    | enable  |
|                          | Requires local-out to be enabled.                      |        |      |         |
| log-policy-comment       | Enable/disable inserting policy comments into traffic logs. | option | -    | disable |
| log-user-in-upper        | Enable/disable logs with user-in-upper.               | option | -    | disable |
| long-live-session-stat   | Enable/disable long-live-session statistics logging.   | option | -    | enable  |
| neighbor-event           | Enable/disable neighbor event logging.                 | option | -    | disable |
| resolve-ip               | Enable/disable adding resolved domain names to traffic logs if possible. | option | -    | disable |

### Options

#### local-out-ioc-detection
- **enable**: Enable local-out traffic IoC detection. Requires local-out to be enabled.
- **disable**: Disable local-out traffic IoC detection.

#### log-policy-comment
- **enable**: Enable inserting policy comments into traffic logs.
- **disable**: Disable inserting policy comments into traffic logs.

#### log-user-in-upper
- **enable**: Enable logs with user-in-upper.
- **disable**: Disable logs with user-in-upper.

#### long-live-session-stat
- **enable**: Enable long-live-session statistics logging.
- **disable**: Disable long-live-session statistics logging.

#### neighbor-event
- **enable**: Enable neighbor event logging.
- **disable**: Disable neighbor event logging.

#### resolve-ip
- **enable**: Enable adding resolved domain names to traffic logs if possible.
- **disable**: Disable adding resolved domain names to traffic logs if possible.

```markdown
# FortiOS 7.4.5 CLI Reference

## Configuration Commands

### edit <id>
```plaintext
set custom {string}
set name {string}
next
end
```

### Parameters

#### set enc-algorithm
- **Description**: Enable/disable reliable syslogging with TLS encryption.
- **Options**:
- `high-medium`: SSL communication with high and medium encryption algorithms.
- `high`: SSL communication with high encryption algorithms.
- `low`: SSL communication with low encryption algorithms.
- `disable`: Disable SSL communication.

#### set facility
- **Description**: Remote syslog facility.
- **Options**:
- `kernel`: Kernel messages.
- `user`: Random user-level messages.
- `mail`: Mail system.
- `daemon`: System daemons.
- `auth`: Security/authorization messages.
- `syslog`: Messages generated internally by syslog.
- `lpr`: Line printer subsystem.

### Configuration Log Syslogd2 Override-Setting

| Parameter      | Description                                              | Type    | Size    | Default   |
|----------------|----------------------------------------------------------|---------|---------|-----------|
| certificate    | Certificate used to communicate with Syslog server.      | string  | Maximum length: 35 |           |
| enc-algorithm  | Enable/disable reliable syslogging with TLS encryption.  | option  | -       | disable   |
| facility       | Remote syslog facility.                                  | option  | -       | local7    |
```

### Options Description

- **anomaly**
- `enable`: Enable anomaly logging.
- `disable`: Disable anomaly logging.

- **forti-switch**
- `enable`: Enable Forti-Switch logging.
- `disable`: Disable Forti-Switch logging.

- **forward-traffic**
- `enable`: Enable forward traffic logging.
- `disable`: Disable forward traffic logging.

- **gtp**
- `enable`: Enable GTP messages logging.
- `disable`: Disable GTP messages logging.

- **local-traffic**
- `enable`: Enable local in or out traffic logging.
- `disable`: Disable local in or out traffic logging.

- **multicast-traffic**
- `enable`: Enable multicast traffic logging.
- `disable`: Disable multicast traffic logging.

- **severity**
- `information`: Set the lowest severity level to log.
