```markdown
# FortiOS 7.4.5 CLI Reference

## Configuring Syslogd3 Override Filter

The `config log syslogd3 override-filter` command is used to override filters for the remote system server.

```plaintext
config log syslogd3 override-filter
Description: Override filters for remote system server.
set  anomaly [enable|disable]
set  forti-switch [enable|disable]
set  forward-traffic [enable|disable]
config free-style
Description: Free style filters.
edit <id>
set     category [traffic|event|...]
set     filter {string}
set     filter-type [include|exclude]
next
end
set  gtp [enable|disable]
set  local-traffic [enable|disable]
set  multicast-traffic [enable|disable]
set  severity   [emergency|alert|...]
set  sniffer-traffic [enable|disable]
set  voip [enable|disable]
set  ztna-traffic [enable|disable]
end
```

### Parameters

| Parameter        | Description                              | Type   | Size | Default | |
|------------------|------------------------------------------|--------|------|---------|---|
| anomaly          | Enable/disable anomaly logging.          | option | -    | enable  | |
|                  | **Option**     | **Description**                     |        |      |         |
|                  | enable     | Enable anomaly logging.             |        |      |         |
|                  | disable    | Disable anomaly logging.            |        |      |         |
| forti-switch     | Enable/disable Forti-Switch logging.   | option | -    | enable  | |
|                  | **Option**     | **Description**                     |        |      |         |
|                  | enable     | Enable Forti-Switch logging.        |        |      |         |
|                  | disable    | Disable Forti-Switch logging.       |        |      |         |
| forward-traffic  | Enable/disable forward traffic logging. | option | -    | enable  | |
|                  | **Option**     | **Description**                     |        |      |         |
|                  | enable     | Enable forward traffic logging.      |        |      |         |
|                  | disable    | Disable forward traffic logging.     |        |      |         |
| gtp *            | Enable/disable GTP messages logging.    | option | -    | enable  | |
```

## Configuration

### Config Log Syslogd4 Filter

Filters for remote system server.

```plaintext
config log syslogd4 filter
Description: Filters for remote system server.
set  anomaly [enable|disable]
set  forti-switch [enable|disable]
set  forward-traffic [enable|disable]
config free-style
Description: Free style filters.
edit <id>
set  category [traffic|event|...]
set  filter {string}
set  filter-type [include|exclude]
next
end
set  gtp [enable|disable]
set  local-traffic [enable|disable]
set  multicast-traffic [enable|disable]
set  severity [emergency|alert|...]
set  sniffer-traffic [enable|disable]
set  voip [enable|disable]
set  ztna-traffic [enable|disable]
end
```

### Parameters for Syslogd4 Filter

| Parameter     | Description                                   | Type   | Size | Default | |
|---------------|-----------------------------------------------|--------|------|---------|---|
| anomaly       | Enable/disable anomaly logging.               | option | -    | enable  | |
|               |                                               |        |      |         | |
|               | Option        | Description                     |        |      |         |
|               | --------------|---------------------------------|--------|------|---------|
|               | enable        | Enable anomaly logging.        |        |      |         |
|               | disable       | Disable anomaly logging.       |        |      |         |
| forti-switch  | Enable/disable Forti-Switch logging.        | option | -    | enable  | |
```

This documentation provides a detailed reference for configuring the log syslogd4 filter in FortiOS 7.4.5, including parameter descriptions and configuration commands.

config log syslogd4 override-filter

# FortiOS 7.4.5 CLI Reference

## Configuration Commands

### Log Syslogd4 Override Filter

The following commands are used to configure the Syslogd4 override filter:

```plaintext
end
set gtp [enable|disable]
set local-traffic [enable|disable]
set multicast-traffic [enable|disable]
set severity [emergency|alert|...]
set sniffer-traffic [enable|disable]
set voip [enable|disable]
set ztna-traffic [enable|disable]
end
```

### Parameters

| Parameter          | Description                                           | Type   | Size | Default |
|--------------------|-------------------------------------------------------|--------|------|---------|
| anomaly            | Enable/disable anomaly logging.                       | option | -    | enable  |
| forti-switch       | Enable/disable Forti-Switch logging.                 | option | -    | enable  |
| forward-traffic    | Enable/disable forward traffic logging.               | option | -    | enable  |
| gtp *              | Enable/disable GTP messages logging.                  | option | -    | enable  |
| local-traffic      | Enable/disable local in or out traffic logging.      | option | -    | enable  |

### Option Descriptions

- **anomaly**
- **enable**: Enable anomaly logging.
- **disable**: Disable anomaly logging.

- **forti-switch**
- **enable**: Enable Forti-Switch logging.
- **disable**: Disable Forti-Switch logging.

- **forward-traffic**
- **enable**: Enable forward traffic logging.
- **disable**: Disable forward traffic logging.

- **gtp**
- **enable**: Enable GTP messages logging.
- **disable**: Disable GTP messages logging.

- **local-traffic**
- **enable**: Enable local in or out traffic logging.
- **disable**: Disable local in or out traffic logging.
```

# FortiOS 7.4.5 CLI Reference

## Config Log Syslogd4 Override-Setting

Override settings for remote syslog server.

### Command Structure

```plaintext
config log syslogd4 override-setting
```

#### Description

Override settings for remote syslog server.

### Parameters

- `set certificate {string}`
- `config custom-field-name`
- **Description**: Custom field name for CEF format logging.
- `edit <id>`
- `set custom {string}`
- `set name {string}`
- `next`
- `end`
- `set enc-algorithm [high-medium|high|...]`
- `set facility [kernel|user|...]`
- `set format [default|csv|...]`
- `set interface {string}`
- `set interface-select-method [auto|sdwan|...]`
- `set max-log-rate {integer}`
- `set mode [udp|legacy-reliable|...]`
- `set port {integer}`
- `set priority [default|low]`
- `set server {string}`
- `set source-ip {string}`
- `set ssl-min-proto-version [default|SSLv3|...]`
- `set status [enable|disable]`
- `end`

### Parameter Descriptions

| Parameter        | Description                                              | Type    | Size   | Default   |
|------------------|----------------------------------------------------------|---------|--------|-----------|
| certificate      | Certificate used to communicate with Syslog server.      | string  | Maximum length: 35 |           |
| enc-algorithm    | Enable/disable reliable syslogging with TLS encryption.  | option  | -      | disable   |
|                  | **Option**       | **Description**                                      | | |
|                  | high-medium      | SSL communication with high and medium encryption algorithms. | | |
|                  | high            | SSL communication with high encryption algorithms.   | | |
|                  | low             | SSL communication with low encryption algorithms.    | | |
|                  | disable         | Disable SSL communication.                           | | |
| facility         | Remote syslog facility.                                  | option  | -      | local7    |
|                  | **Option**       | **Description**                                      | | |
|                  | kernel          | Kernel messages.                                     | | |
```

## Parameters

| Parameter         | Description                                                | Type    | Size                | Default   | |
|-------------------|------------------------------------------------------------|---------|---------------------|-----------|---|
| **interface**     | Specify outgoing interface to reach server.                | string  | Maximum length: 15  |           | |
| **interface-select-method** | Specify how to select outgoing interface to reach server. | option  | -                   |           | |
|                   | **Option**          | **Description**                                      |         |                     |           |
|                   | rfc5424            | Syslog RFC5424 format.                              |         |                     |           |
|                   | json               | JSON (JavaScript Object Notation) format.          |         |                     |           |
|                   | **auto**           | Set outgoing interface automatically.                |         |                     |           |
|                   | **sdwan**          | Set outgoing interface by SD-WAN or policy routing rules. |         |                     |           |
|                   | **specify**       | Set outgoing interface manually.                     |         |                     |           |
| **max-log-rate**  | Syslog maximum log rate in MBps (0 = unlimited).       | integer | Minimum value: 0    | Maximum value: 100000 | |
| **mode**          | Remote syslog logging over UDP/Reliable TCP.            | option  | -                   | udp       | |
|                   | **Option**          | **Description**                                      |         |                     |           |
|                   | **udp**            | Enable syslogging over UDP.                          |         |                     |           |
|                   | **legacy-reliable** | Enable legacy reliable syslogging by RFC3195 (Reliable Delivery for Syslog). |         |                     |           |
|                   | **reliable**      | Enable reliable syslogging by RFC6587 (Transmission of Syslog Messages over TCP). |         |                     |           |
| **port**          | Server listen port.                                      | integer | Minimum value: 514  | Maximum value: 65535 | |
| **priority**      | Set log transmission priority.                           | option  | -                   | default   | |
|                   | **Option**          | **Description**                                      |         |                     |           |
|                   | **default**        | Set Syslog transmission priority to default.         |         |                     |           |
|                   | **low**           | Set Syslog transmission priority to low.             |         |                     |           |
| **server**        | Address of remote syslog server.                         | string  | Maximum length: 127 |           | |

# FortiOS 7.4.5 CLI Reference

## Syslog Configuration

To configure the syslog settings, use the following commands:

```plaintext
set custom {string}
set name {string}
next
end
set enc-algorithm [high-medium|high|...]
set facility [kernel|user|...]
set format [default|csv|...]
set interface {string}
set interface-select-method [auto|sdwan|...]
set max-log-rate {integer}
set mode [udp|legacy-reliable|...]
set port {integer}
set priority [default|low]
set server {string}
set source-ip {string}
set ssl-min-proto-version [default|SSLv3|...]
set status [enable|disable]
end
```

### Configuration Parameters

| Parameter      | Description                                              | Type    | Size    | Default   |
|----------------|----------------------------------------------------------|---------|---------|-----------|
| certificate    | Certificate used to communicate with Syslog server.      | string  | Maximum length: 35 |           |
| enc-algorithm  | Enable/disable reliable syslogging with TLS encryption.  | option  | -       | disable   |

#### enc-algorithm Options

| Option         | Description                                           |
|----------------|-------------------------------------------------------|
| high-medium    | SSL communication with high and medium encryption algorithms. |
| high           | SSL communication with high encryption algorithms.    |
| low            | SSL communication with low encryption algorithms.     |
| disable        | Disable SSL communication.                            |

| Parameter      | Description                                              | Type    | Size    | Default   |
|----------------|----------------------------------------------------------|---------|---------|-----------|
| facility       | Remote syslog facility.                                  | option  | -       | local7    |

#### facility Options

| Option         | Description                                           |
|----------------|-------------------------------------------------------|
| kernel         | Kernel messages.                                      |
| user           | Random user-level messages.                           |
| mail           | Mail system.                                         |
| daemon         | System daemons.                                      |
| auth           | Security/authorization messages.                      |
| syslog         | Messages generated internally by syslog.              |
| lpr            | Line printer subsystem.                               |
```

```markdown
# FortiOS 7.4.5 CLI Reference

## Configuration Commands

### Log Syslogd Filter

The following commands are used to configure the Syslogd filter settings:

```plaintext
set gtp [enable|disable]
set local-traffic [enable|disable]
set multicast-traffic [enable|disable]
set severity [emergency|alert|...]
set sniffer-traffic [enable|disable]
set voip [enable|disable]
set ztna-traffic [enable|disable]
end
```

### Parameters

| Parameter          | Description                                           | Type   | Size | Default |
|--------------------|-------------------------------------------------------|--------|------|---------|
| anomaly            | Enable/disable anomaly logging.                       | option | -    | enable  |
| forti-switch       | Enable/disable Forti-Switch logging.                 | option | -    | enable  |
| forward-traffic    | Enable/disable forward traffic logging.               | option | -    | enable  |
| gtp                | Enable/disable GTP messages logging.                  | option | -    | enable  |
| local-traffic      | Enable/disable local in or out traffic logging.      | option | -    | enable  |
| multicast-traffic  | Enable/disable multicast traffic logging.             | option | -    | enable  |

### Option Descriptions

- **anomaly**
- **enable**: Enable anomaly logging.
- **disable**: Disable anomaly logging.

- **forti-switch**
- **enable**: Enable Forti-Switch logging.
- **disable**: Disable Forti-Switch logging.

- **forward-traffic**
- **enable**: Enable forward traffic logging.
- **disable**: Disable forward traffic logging.

- **gtp**
- **enable**: Enable GTP messages logging.
- **disable**: Disable GTP messages logging.

- **local-traffic**
- **enable**: Enable local in or out traffic logging.
- **disable**: Disable local in or out traffic logging.

- **multicast-traffic**
- **enable**: Enable multicast traffic logging.
- **disable**: Disable multicast traffic logging.
```

|                    | **Option**         | **Description**                                   |         |               |         |
|                    | udp               | Enable syslogging over UDP.                        |         |               |         |
|                    | legacy-reliable   | Enable legacy reliable syslogging by RFC3195 (Reliable Delivery for Syslog). |         |               |         |

```markdown
# FortiOS 7.4.5 CLI Reference

## Logging Parameters

| Parameter         | Description                                               | Type   | Size | Default  |
|-------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------|--------|------|----------|
| gtp               | Enable/disable GTP messages logging.                      | option | -    | enable   |
| local-traffic     | Enable/disable local in or out traffic logging.          | option | -    | enable   |
| multicast-traffic | Enable/disable multicast traffic logging.                 | option | -    | enable   |
| severity          | Lowest severity level to log to WebTrends.               | option | -    | information |
| sniffer-traffic   | Enable/disable sniffer traffic logging.                   | option | -    | enable   |
| voip              | Enable/disable VoIP logging.                              | option | -    | enable   |

### gtp
- **Option**:
- `enable`: Enable GTP messages logging.
- `disable`: Disable GTP messages logging.

### local-traffic
- **Option**:
- `enable`: Enable local in or out traffic logging.
- `disable`: Disable local in or out traffic logging.

### multicast-traffic
- **Option**:
- `enable`: Enable multicast traffic logging.
- `disable`: Disable multicast traffic logging.

### severity
- **Option**:
- `emergency`: Emergency level.
- `alert`: Alert level.
- `critical`: Critical level.
- `error`: Error level.
- `warning`: Warning level.
- `notification`: Notification level.
- `information`: Information level.
- `debug`: Debug level.

### sniffer-traffic
- **Option**:
- `enable`: Enable sniffer traffic logging.
- `disable`: Disable sniffer traffic logging.

### voip
- **Option**:
- `enable`: Enable VoIP logging.
- `disable`: Disable VoIP logging.
```

# FortiOS 7.4.5 CLI Reference

## Configuring NPU-HPE Monitoring

### Command Syntax
```plaintext
config monitoring npu-hpe
Description: Configure npu-hpe status monitoring.
set interval {integer}
set multipliers {user}
set status [enable|disable]
end
```

### Parameters

| Parameter    | Description                                                                 | Type    | Size     | Default  |
|--------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|---------|----------|----------|
| interval     | HPE status check interval.                                                  | integer | Minimum  | 1        |
|              |                                                                             |         | value: 1 |          |
|              |                                                                             |         | Maximum  | 60       |
| multipliers  | HPE type interval multipliers. An event log is generated after every       | user    | Not      | Specified|
|              | (interval * multiplier) seconds as configured for any HPE type when drops  |         |          |          |
|              | occur for that HPE type. An attack log is generated after every (4 *      |         |          |          |
|              | multiplier) number of continuous event logs.                                |         |          |          |
| status       | Enable/disable HPE status monitoring.                                       | option  | -        | disable  |

#### Options

| Option  | Description         |
|---------|---------------------|
| enable  | Enable setting.     |
| disable | Disable setting.    |
```

set association-update [allow|deny]
set heartbeat [allow|deny]
set node-report [allow|deny]

```markdown
# FortiOS 7.4.5 CLI Reference

## PFCP Message Filter Configuration

### Configuration Commands

```plaintext
set session-report [allow|deny]
set session-set-deletion [allow|deny]
set unknown-message [allow|deny]
set unknown-message-allow-list <id1>, <id2>, ...
set version-not-support [allow|deny]
next
end
```

### PFCP Message Filter Parameters

| Parameter            | Description                                                                 | Type    | Size   | Default |
|----------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|---------|--------|---------|
| association-release   | Allow or deny PFCP association release request (9) and PFCP association release response (10). | option  | -      | allow   |
|                      | **Option**
**allow**: Allow message.
**deny**: Deny message.        |         |        |         | | |
| association-setup     | Allow or deny PFCP association setup request (5) and PFCP association setup response (6). | option  | -      | allow   |
|                      | **Option**
**allow**: Allow message.
**deny**: Deny message.        |         |        |         | | |
| association-update     | Allow or deny PFCP association update request (7) and PFCP association update response (8). | option  | -      | allow   |
|                      | **Option**
**allow**: Allow message.
**deny**: Deny message.        |         |        |         | | |
| heartbeat             | Allow or deny PFCP heartbeat request (1) and PFCP heartbeat response (2).  | option  | -      | allow   |
|                      | **Option**
**allow**: Allow message.
**deny**: Deny message.        |         |        |         | | |
| name                  | Message filter name.                                                        | string  | Maximum length: 63 |         |
| node-report           | Allow or deny PFCP node report request (12) and PFCP node report response (13). | option  | -      | allow   |

```

## Report Setting Configuration

```plaintext
config report setting
Description: Report setting configuration.
set fortiview [enable|disable]
set pdf-report [enable|disable]
set report-source {option1}, {option2}, ...
set top-n {integer}
set web-browsing-threshold {integer}
end
```

### Parameters

| Parameter                  | Description                                           | Type    | Size | Default |
|----------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------|---------|------|---------|
| fortiview                  | Enable/disable historical FortiView.                 | option  | -    | enable ** |

#### Options

| Option  | Description                          |
|---------|--------------------------------------|
| enable  | Enable historical FortiView.         |
| disable | Disable historical FortiView.        |

## Configuring Access Lists

### Command: `config router access-list`

Configure access lists.

```plaintext
config router access-list
Description: Configure access lists.
edit <name>
set comments {string}
config rule
Description: Rule.
edit <id>
set action [permit|deny]
```
---
```markdown
# FortiOS 7.4.5 CLI Reference

## Configuring Router Access Lists

### Access List Configuration

To configure an access list, use the following commands:

```plaintext
set exact-match    [enable|disable]
set prefix         {user}
set wildcard       {user}
next
end
```

### Parameters for Access List Configuration

| Parameter | Description                                                | Type     | Size          | Default |
|-----------|------------------------------------------------------------|----------|---------------|---------|
| comments  | Comment.                                                   | string   | Maximum length: 127 |         |
| name      | Name.                                                      | string   | Maximum length: 35  |         |

### Configuring Rules

To configure rules within the access list, use the following commands:

```plaintext
config rule
```

#### Parameters for Rule Configuration

| Parameter     | Description                                               | Type     | Size           | Default | |
|---------------|-----------------------------------------------------------|----------|----------------|---------|---|
| action        | Permit or deny this IP address and netmask prefix.       | option   | -              | permit  | |
|               | **Option**          | **Description**                               |          |                |         |
|               | permit             | Permit or allow this IP address and netmask prefix. |          |                |         |
|               | deny               | Deny this IP address and netmask prefix.          |          |                |         |
| exact-match   | Enable/disable exact match.                             | option   | -              | disable | |
|               | **Option**          | **Description**                               |          |                |         |
|               | enable             | Enable exact match.                             |          |                |         |
|               | disable            | Disable exact match.                            |          |                |         |
| id            | Rule ID.                                               | integer  | Minimum value: 0
Maximum value: 4294967295 |         | | | | |
| prefix        | IPv4 prefix to define regular filter criteria, such as "any" or subnets. | user     | Not Specified  |         |
| wildcard      | Wildcard to define Cisco-style wildcard filter criteria. | user     | Not Specified  |         |

## Configuring IPv6 Access Lists

To configure IPv6 access lists, use the following command:

```plaintext
config router access-list6
```

## Router Configuration

### AS Path List Configuration

Configure Autonomous System (AS) path lists.

```plaintext
config router aspath-list
```

#### Description

Configure Autonomous System (AS) path lists.

```plaintext
edit <name>
config rule
Description: AS path list rule.
edit <id>
set action [deny|permit]
set regexp {string}
next
end
next
end
```

### Parameters

| Parameter | Description                                                                 | Type     | Size                | Default |
|-----------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------|---------------------|---------|
| id        | Rule ID.                                                                    | integer  | Minimum value: 0    |         |
|           |                                                                             |          | Maximum value:      | 4294967295 |
| prefix6   | IPv6 prefix to define regular filter criteria, such as "any" or subnets.   | Not Specified |                     |         |

### AS Path List Parameters

| Parameter | Description                                                                 | Type     | Size                | Default |
|-----------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------|---------------------|---------|
| name      | AS path list name.                                                          | string   | Maximum length: 35  |         |

### Rule Configuration

```plaintext
config rule
```

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Description                                                                 | Type     | Size | Default |
|-----------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------|------|---------|
| action    | Permit or deny route-based operations, based on the route's AS_PATH attribute. | option   | -    |         |

##### Options

| Option | Description                          |
|--------|--------------------------------------|
| deny   | Deny route-based operations.         |
| permit | Permit route-based operations.       |

## Router Configuration

### Authentication-Based Routing

Configure authentication based routing.

```plaintext
config router auth-path
Description: Configure authentication based routing.
edit <name>
set device {string}
set gateway {ipv4-address}
next
end
```

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Description                                      | Type     | Size         | Default                |
|-----------|--------------------------------------------------|----------|--------------|------------------------|
| id        | ID.                                             | integer  | Minimum value: 0
Maximum value: 4294967295 |
| regexp    | Regular-expression to match the Border Gateway Protocol (BGP) AS paths. | string   | Maximum length: 63 |
| device    | Outgoing interface.                              | string   | Maximum length: 35 |
| gateway   | Gateway IP address.                              | ipv4-address | Not Specified
Default: 0.0.0.0 |
| name      | Name of the entry.                               | string   | Maximum length: 15 |

### BFD Configuration

Configure BFD.

```plaintext
config router bfd
Description: Configure BFD.
config multihop-template
Description: BFD multi-hop template table.
edit <id>
set auth-mode [none|md5]
set bfd-desired-min-tx {integer}
set bfd-detect-mult {integer}
set bfd-required-min-rx {integer}
set dst {ipv4-classnet}
set md5-key {password}
```

# FortiOS 7.4.5 CLI Reference

## BFD Configuration

### Configuring BFD Neighbor

| Parameter | Description                                         | Type   | Size     | Default   |
|-----------|-----------------------------------------------------|--------|----------|-----------|
| interface | Interface name.                                    | string | Maximum length: 15 |           |
| ip        | IPv4 address of the BFD neighbor.                  | ipv4-address | Not Specified | 0.0.0.0 |

### Configuring IPv6 BFD

To configure IPv6 BFD, use the following command:

```plaintext
config router bfd6
```

#### Description

Configure IPv6 BFD.

##### Config Multihop Template

To configure the BFD IPv6 multi-hop template table, use the following commands:

```plaintext
config multihop-template
edit <id>
set auth-mode [none|md5]
set bfd-desired-min-tx {integer}
set bfd-detect-mult {integer}
set bfd-required-min-rx {integer}
set dst {ipv6-network}
set md5-key {password}
set src {ipv6-network}
next
end
```

##### Config Neighbor

To configure the neighbor of IPv6 BFD, use the following commands:

```plaintext
config neighbor
edit <ip6-address>
set interface {string}
next
end
```

### Multihop Template Parameters

| Parameter            | Description                                                                 | Type   | Size      | Default | |
|----------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------|-----------|---------|---|
| auth-mode            | Authentication mode.                                                       | option | -         | none    | |
|                      | Option          | Description                                            |        |           |         |
|                      | none           | None.                                                 |        |           |         |
|                      | md5            | Meticulous MD5 mode.                                   |        |           |         |
| bfd-desired-min-tx  | BFD desired minimal transmit interval (milliseconds).                      | integer| Minimum value: 100 | 250     | |
|                      |                                                                             |        | Maximum value: 30000 |         | |
```

This documentation provides a structured overview of configuring BFD on FortiOS, including parameters and command syntax for both IPv4 and IPv6 configurations.

## Configuring Router BGP

### Command Overview

To configure BGP, use the following command:

```bash
config router bgp
```

### Description

Configure BGP with the following options:

```bash
set additional-path [enable|disable]
set additional-path-select {integer}
set additional-path-select-vpnv4 {integer}
set additional-path-select-vpnv6 {integer}
set additional-path-select6 {integer}
set additional-path-vpnv4 [enable|disable]
set additional-path-vpnv6 [enable|disable]
set additional-path6 [enable|disable]
```

### Configuring Administrative Distance

To modify administrative distance, use:

```bash
config admin-distance
edit <id>
```

## Router BGP Configuration

```plaintext
config router bgp
```

### Parameters

| Parameter          | Description                                      | Type     | Size     | Default  | |
|--------------------|--------------------------------------------------|----------|----------|----------|---|
| additional-path    | Enable/disable selection of BGP IPv4 additional paths. | option   | -        | disable  | |
|                    | Option       | Description                       |          |          |          |
|                    | enable       | Enable setting.                  |          |          |          |
|                    | disable      | Disable setting.                 |          |          |          |
| additional-path-select | Number of additional paths to be selected for each IPv4 NLRI. | integer  | Minimum value: 2 | Maximum value: 255 | |
```

```markdown
# FortiOS 7.4.5 CLI Reference

## Router Community List Configuration

### Overview
The `config router community-list` command is used to configure community lists.

### Command Structure
```plaintext
config router community-list
```

#### Description
Configure community lists.

### Edit Community List
```plaintext
edit <name>
```

#### Community List Rule Configuration
```plaintext
config rule
```

##### Description
Community list rule configuration.

###### Edit Rule
```plaintext
edit <id>
```

#### Rule Parameters
| Parameter | Description                                                                 | Type    | Size        | Default  |
|-----------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|---------|-------------|----------|
| action    | Permit or deny route-based operations, based on the route's COMMUNITY attribute. | option  | -           | -        |
|           | **Option**       | **Description**                                   | | |
|           | deny            | Deny route-based operations.                      | | |
|           | permit          | Permit or allow route-based operations.          | | |

### Community List Parameters
| Parameter | Description                                           | Type    | Size        | Default  |
|-----------|-------------------------------------------------------|---------|-------------|----------|
| name      | Community list name.                                 | string  | Maximum length: 35 | -        |
| type      | Community list type (standard or expanded).          | option  | -           | standard |

#### Type Options
| Option     | Description                                   |
|------------|-----------------------------------------------|
| standard   | Standard community list type.                 |
| expanded   | Expanded community list type.                 |

### End Configuration
```plaintext
next
end
```

### Next Rule
```plaintext
next
```

### End Community List
```plaintext
end
```
```
---
```markdown
# FortiOS 7.4.5 CLI Reference

## Extended Community Lists

### Parameters

| Parameter | Description                                                  | Type    | Size            | Default |
|-----------|--------------------------------------------------------------|---------|-----------------|---------|
| id        | ID.                                                          | integer | Minimum value: 0
Maximum value: 4294967295 | 0       | | | | |
| match     | Community specifications for matching a reserved community.  | string  | Maximum length: 255 |         |
| regexp    | Ordered list of COMMUNITY attributes as a regular expression. | string  | Maximum length: 255 |         |

### Configuration Command

To configure extended community lists, use the following command:

```plaintext
config router extcommunity-list
```

#### Description

Configure extended community lists.

#### Edit Command

To edit a specific extended community list, use:

```plaintext
edit <name>
```

##### Rule Configuration

To configure a rule within the extended community list, use:

```plaintext
config rule
```

###### Edit Rule

To edit a specific rule, use:

```plaintext
edit <id>
```

###### Set Commands

You can set the following parameters for the rule:

```plaintext
set action [deny|permit]
set match {string}
set regexp {string}
set type [rt|soo]
```

To finalize the rule configuration, use:

```plaintext
next
end
```

#### Set Type

To set the type of the extended community list, use:

```plaintext
set type [standard|expanded]
```

### Type Options

| Option    | Description                                         |
|-----------|-----------------------------------------------------|
| standard  | Standard extended community list type.              |
| expanded  | Expanded extended community list type.              |

```

```markdown
# FortiOS 7.4.5 CLI Reference

## Configuring Key-Chain

To configure a key-chain, use the following command:

```plaintext
config router key-chain
```

### Key-Chain Configuration

- **Description**: Configure key-chain.

#### Edit Key-Chain

To edit a key-chain, use the following command:

```plaintext
edit <name>
```

##### Key Configuration

To configure a key, use the following command:

```plaintext
config key
```

- **Description**: Configuration method to edit key settings.

###### Edit Key

To edit a specific key, use the following command:

```plaintext
edit <id>
```

###### Key Parameters

- **set accept-lifetime** `{user}`
- **set algorithm** `[md5|hmac-sha1|...]`
- **set key-string** `{password}`
- **set send-lifetime** `{user}`

To proceed to the next configuration, use:

```plaintext
next
```

To end the key configuration, use:

```plaintext
end
```

### Key-Chain Parameters

| Parameter | Description                                               | Type    | Size                | Default   |
|-----------|-----------------------------------------------------------|---------|---------------------|-----------|
| name      | Key-chain name.                                          | string  | Maximum length: 35  |           |

### Key Parameters

| Parameter      | Description                                                                 | Type      | Size                | Default       | |
|----------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------|---------------------|---------------|---|
| accept-lifetime | Lifetime of received authentication key (format: hh:mm:ss day month year). | user      | Not Specified       |               | |
| algorithm      | Cryptographic algorithm.                                                  | option    | -                   | md5           | |
|                | Option          | Description                                          |           |                     |               |
|                | md5             | MD5.                                               |           |                     |               |
|                | hmac-sha1       | HMAC-SHA1.                                        |           |                     |               |
|                | hmac-sha256     | HMAC-SHA256.                                      |           |                     |               |
|                | hmac-sha384     | HMAC-SHA384.                                      |           |                     |               |
|                | hmac-sha512     | HMAC-SHA512.                                      |           |                     |               |
|                | cmac-aes128     | CMAC-AES128.                                      |           |                     |               |
| id             | Key ID.                                                                   | string    | Maximum length: 10  |               | |
| key-string     | Password for the key (maximum = 64 characters).                          | password  | Not Specified       |               | |
```

## Multicast Flow Configuration

### Command: `config router multicast-flow`

Configure multicast-flow.

#### Syntax
```plaintext
config router multicast-flow
```

#### Description
Configure multicast-flow.

#### Subcommands

- **edit `<name>`**

Set the name of the multicast flow.

##### Parameters
| Parameter      | Description                                            | Type   | Size        | Default       |
|----------------|-------------------------------------------------------|--------|-------------|---------------|
| comments       | Comment.                                             | string | Maximum length: 127 |               |
| name           | Name.                                               | string | Maximum length: 35  |               |

##### Flows Configuration
```plaintext
config flows
```

##### Description
Multicast-flow entries.

###### Subcommand: `edit <id>`

Set the flow ID.

###### Parameters
| Parameter      | Description                                   | Type         | Size           | Default       |
|----------------|-----------------------------------------------|--------------|----------------|---------------|
| group-addr     | Multicast group IP address.                   | ipv4-address-any | Not Specified  | 0.0.0.0      |
| id             | Flow ID.                                      | integer      | Minimum value: 0
Maximum value: 4294967295 |               | | | | |
| source-addr    | Multicast source IP address.                  | ipv4-address-any | Not Specified  | 0.0.0.0      |

```plaintext
next
end
```

```plaintext
next
end
```

### Example
```plaintext
config router multicast-flow
edit "example-flow"
set comments "This is an example multicast flow"
config flows
edit 1
set group-addr 239.255.0.1
set source-addr 192.168.1.1
next
end
next
end
```
```

## Configuration Commands

### Multicast Configuration

The following commands are used to configure multicast settings:

```plaintext
set bsr-priority {integer}
set cisco-crp-prefix [enable|disable]
set cisco-ignore-rp-set-priority [enable|disable]
set cisco-register-checksum [enable|disable]
set cisco-register-checksum-group {string}
set join-prune-holdtime {integer}
set message-interval {integer}
set null-register-retries {integer}
set pim-use-sdwan [enable|disable]
set register-rate-limit {integer}
set register-rp-reachability [enable|disable]
set register-source [disable|interface|...]
set register-source-interface {string}
set register-source-ip {ipv4-address}
set register-supression {integer}
```

#### RP Address Configuration

To statically configure RP addresses, use the following commands:

```plaintext
config rp-address
Description: Statically configure RP addresses.
edit <id>
set group {string}
set ip-address {ipv4-address}
next
end
```

### Additional Multicast Settings

```plaintext
set rp-register-keepalive {integer}
set spt-threshold [enable|disable]
set spt-threshold-group {string}
set ssm [enable|disable]
set ssm-range {string}
end
set route-limit {integer}
set route-threshold {integer}
end
```

| Option   | Description                          |
|----------|--------------------------------------|
| enable   | Enable IP multicast routing.         |
| disable  | Disable IP multicast routing.        |

- **Maximum value**: 2147483647

```markdown
# FortiOS 7.4.5 CLI Reference

## Parameters

### Route Threshold
- **Description**: Generate warnings when the number of multicast routes exceeds this number, must not be greater than route-limit.
- **Type**: integer
- **Size**:
- Minimum value: 1
- Maximum value: 2147483647

### Config Interface

#### BFD
- **Description**: Enable/disable Protocol Independent Multicast (PIM) Bidirectional Forwarding Detection (BFD).
- **Type**: option
- **Size**: -
- **Default**: disable

| Option  | Description                                                                 |
|---------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| enable  | Enable Protocol Independent Multicast (PIM) Bidirectional Forwarding Detection (BFD). |
| disable | Disable Protocol Independent Multicast (PIM) Bidirectional Forwarding Detection (BFD). |

#### Cisco Exclude GenID
- **Description**: Exclude GenID from hello packets (compatibility with old Cisco IOS).
- **Type**: option
- **Size**: -
- **Default**: disable

| Option  | Description                                   |
|---------|-----------------------------------------------|
| enable  | Do not send GenID.                           |
| disable | Send GenID according to standard.            |

#### DR Priority
- **Description**: DR election priority.
- **Type**: integer
- **Size**:
- Minimum value: 1
- Maximum value: 4294967295

#### Hello Holdtime
- **Description**: Time before old neighbor information expires.
- **Type**: integer
- **Size**:
- Minimum value: 1
- Maximum value: 65535

#### Hello Interval
- **Description**: Interval between sending PIM hello messages.
- **Type**: integer
- **Size**:
- Minimum value: 1
- Maximum value: 65535

#### Multicast Flow
- **Description**: Acceptable source for multicast group.
- **Type**: string
- **Size**: Maximum length: 35

#### Name
- **Description**: Interface name.
- **Type**: string
- **Size**: Maximum length: 15
```

# FortiOS 7.4.5 CLI Reference

## Configuration Commands

### Authentication and Key Configuration
```plaintext
set authentication-key {password}
set dead-interval {integer}
set hello-interval {integer}
set keychain {string}
```

### MD5 Keys Configuration
```plaintext
config md5-keys
Description: MD5 key.
edit <id>
set key-string {password}
next
end
```

### Peer and Interval Settings
```plaintext
set peer {ipv4-address-any}
set retransmit-interval {integer}
set transmit-delay {integer}
```

### Auto Cost Reference Bandwidth
```plaintext
set auto-cost-ref-bandwidth {integer}
```

### BFD Configuration
```plaintext
set bfd [enable|disable]
```

### Database Overflow Settings
```plaintext
set database-overflow [enable|disable]
set database-overflow-max-lsas {integer}
set database-overflow-time-to-recover {integer}
```

### Default Information Settings
```plaintext
set default-information-metric {integer}
set default-information-metric-type [1|2]
set default-information-originate [enable|always|...]
set default-information-route-map {string}
set default-metric {integer}
```

### Distance Settings
```plaintext
set distance {integer}
set distance-external {integer}
set distance-inter-area {integer}
set distance-intra-area {integer}
```

### Distribute List Configuration
```plaintext
config distribute-list
Description: Distribute list configuration.
edit <id>
set access-list {string}
set protocol [connected|static|...]
next
end
```

### Distribute List and Route Map
```plaintext
set distribute-list-in {string}
set distribute-route-map-in {string}
```

### Log Neighbor Changes
```plaintext
set log-neighbour-changes [enable|disable]
```

### OSPF Neighbor Configuration
```plaintext
config neighbor
Description: OSPF neighbor configuration are used when OSPF runs on non-broadcast media.
edit <id>
set cost {integer}
set ip {ipv4-address}
set poll-interval {integer}
set priority {integer}
next
end
```

### OSPF Network Configuration
```plaintext
config network
Description: OSPF network configuration.
edit <id>
set area {ipv4-address-any}
set comments {var-string}
next
end
```
```

```markdown
# FortiOS 7.4.5 CLI Reference

## OSPF6 Configuration

### Configure IPv6 OSPF

To configure IPv6 OSPF, use the following command:

```plaintext
config router ospf6
```

#### Description

Configure IPv6 OSPF.

#### Commands

- `set abr-type [cisco|ibm|...]`

### OSPF6 Area Configuration

To configure an OSPF6 area, enter the following command:

```plaintext
config area
```

#### Description

OSPF6 area configuration.

#### Commands

- `edit <id>`
- `set authentication [none|ah|...]`
- `set default-cost {integer}`
- `set ipsec-auth-alg [md5|sha1|...]`
- `set ipsec-enc-alg [null|des|...]`

#### IPsec Keys Configuration

To configure IPsec authentication and encryption keys, use:

```plaintext
config ipsec-keys
```

##### Description

IPsec authentication and encryption keys.

###### Commands

- `edit <spi>`
- `set auth-key {password}`
- `set enc-key {password}`
- `next`
- `end`

#### Additional Area Configuration Commands

- `set key-rollover-interval {integer}`
- `set nssa-default-information-originate [enable|disable]`
- `set nssa-default-information-originate-metric {integer}`
- `set nssa-default-information-originate-metric-type [1|2]`
- `set nssa-redistribution [enable|disable]`
- `set nssa-translator-role [candidate|never|...]`

### OSPF6 Area Range Configuration

To configure an OSPF6 area range, use:

```plaintext
config range
```

#### Description

OSPF6 area range configuration.

##### Commands

- `edit <id>`
- `set advertise [disable|enable]`
- `set prefix6 {ipv6-network}`
- `next`
- `end`

#### Additional Area Configuration Commands

- `set stub-type [no-summary|summary]`
- `set type [regular|nssa|...]`

### OSPF6 Virtual Link Configuration

To configure an OSPF6 virtual link, use:

```plaintext
config virtual-link
```

#### Description

OSPF6 virtual link configuration.

##### Commands

- `edit <name>`
- `set authentication [none|ah|...]`
- `set dead-interval {integer}`
- `set hello-interval {integer}`
- `set ipsec-auth-alg [md5|sha1|...]`
- `set ipsec-enc-alg [null|des|...]`

#### IPsec Keys Configuration

To configure IPsec authentication and encryption keys for the virtual link, use:

```plaintext
config ipsec-keys
```

##### Description

IPsec authentication and encryption keys.

###### Commands

- `edit <spi>`
- `set auth-key {password}`
- `set enc-key {password}`
- `next`
- `end`

#### Additional Virtual Link Configuration Commands

- `set key-rollover-interval {integer}`
- `set peer {ipv4-address-any}`
- `set retransmit-interval {integer}`
- `set transmit-delay {integer}`
```

# FortiOS 7.4.5 CLI Reference

## Configuration Commands

### OSPF6 Configuration

To configure OSPF6, use the following commands:

```plaintext
set status [enable|disable]
next
end
set restart-mode [none|graceful-restart]
set restart-on-topology-change [enable|disable]
set restart-period {integer}
set router-id {ipv4-address-any}
set spf-timers {user}
```

#### Summary Address Configuration

To configure IPv6 address summary:

```plaintext
config summary-address
Description: IPv6 address summary configuration.
edit <id>
set advertise [disable|enable]
set prefix6 {ipv6-network}
set tag {integer}
next
end
```

### Router OSPF6 Parameters

To configure router OSPF6, use the following parameters:

| Parameter            | Description                                           | Type     | Size     | Default   | |
|----------------------|-------------------------------------------------------|----------|----------|-----------|---|
| abr-type             | Area border router type.                              | option   | -        | standard  | |
|                      | Option         | Description                          |          |          |           |
|                      | cisco          | Cisco.                               |          |          |           |
|                      | ibm            | IBM.                                 |          |          |           |
|                      | standard       | Standard.                            |          |          |           |
| auto-cost-ref-bandwidth | Reference bandwidth in terms of megabits per second. | integer  | Minimum  | 1000      | |
|                      |                | Maximum value: 1000000              |          |          |           |
| bfd                  | Enable/disable Bidirectional Forwarding Detection (BFD). | option   | -        | disable   | |
|                      | Option         | Description                          |          |          |           |
|                      | enable         | Enable Bidirectional Forwarding Detection (BFD). |          |          |           |
|                      | disable        | Disable Bidirectional Forwarding Detection (BFD). |          |          |           |
| default-information-metric | Default information metric.                     | integer  | Minimum  | 10        | |
|                      |                | Maximum value: 16777214              |          |          |           |
```

## Parameters

### restart-on-topology-change
- **Description**: Enable/disable continuing graceful restart upon topology change.
- **Type**: option
- **Size**: -
- **Default**: disable

#### Options
| Option  | Description                                               |
|---------|---------------------------------------------------------|
| enable  | Continue graceful restart upon topology change.         |
| disable | Exit graceful restart upon topology change.             |

### restart-period
- **Description**: Graceful restart period in seconds.
- **Type**: integer
- **Size**: Minimum value: 1, Maximum value: 3600
- **Default**: 120

### router-id
- **Description**: A.B.C.D, in IPv4 address format.
- **Type**: ipv4-address-any
- **Size**: Not Specified
- **Default**: 0.0.0.0

### spf-timers
- **Description**: SPF calculation frequency.
- **Type**: user
- **Size**: Not Specified

## Config Area

### authentication
- **Description**: Authentication mode.
- **Type**: option
- **Size**: -
- **Default**: none

#### Options
| Option | Description                     |
|--------|---------------------------------|
| none   | Disable authentication.         |
| ah     | Authentication Header.          |
| esp    | Encapsulating Security Payload. |

### default-cost
- **Description**: Summary default cost of stub or NSSA area.
- **Type**: integer
- **Size**: Minimum value: 0, Maximum value: 16777215
- **Default**: 10

### id
- **Description**: Area entry IP address.
- **Type**: ipv4-address-any
- **Size**: Not Specified
- **Default**: 0.0.0.0

### ipsec-auth-alg
- **Description**: Authentication algorithm.
- **Type**: option
- **Size**: -
- **Default**: md5

#### Options

|--------|-------------|
| md5    | MD5.       |

```markdown
# FortiOS 7.4.5 CLI Reference

## Configuring Router Policy

### Description
Configure IPv4 routing policies.

### Command Structure
```plaintext
config router policy
edit <seq-num>
set action [deny|permit]
set comments {var-string}
set dst <subnet1>, <subnet2>, ...
set dst-negate [enable|disable]
set dstaddr <name1>, <name2>, ...
set end-port {integer}
set end-source-port {integer}
set gateway {ipv4-address}
set input-device <name1>, <name2>, ...
set input-device-negate [enable|disable]
set internet-service-custom <name1>, <name2>, ...
set internet-service-id <id1>, <id2>, ...
set output-device {string}
set protocol {integer}
set src <subnet1>, <subnet2>, ...
set src-negate [enable|disable]
set srcaddr <name1>, <name2>, ...
set start-port {integer}
set start-source-port {integer}
set status [enable|disable]
set tos {user}
set tos-mask {user}
next
end
```

### Parameters
| Parameter      | Description                                         | Type        | Size  | Default | |
|----------------|-----------------------------------------------------|-------------|-------|---------|---|
| action         | Action of the policy route.                         | option      | -     | permit  | |
|                | Option         | Description                          |             |       |         |
|                | deny           | Do not search policy route table.   |             |       |         |
|                | permit         | Use this policy route for forwarding.|             |       |         |
| comments       | Optional comments.                                  | var-string  | Maximum length: 255 |         | |
| dst            | Destination IP and mask (x.x.x.x/x).              | string      | Maximum length: 79 |         | |
| dst-negate     | Enable/disable negating destination address match. | option      | -     | disable | |
|                | Option         | Description                          |             |       |         |
|                | enable         | Enable destination address negation. |             |       |         |
|                | disable        | Disable destination address negation.|             |       |         |
```

```markdown
# FortiOS 7.4.5 CLI Reference

## Parameters

| Parameter         | Description                                            | Type         | Size                | Default         |
|-------------------|-------------------------------------------------------|--------------|---------------------|------------------|
| gateway           | IPv6 address of the gateway.                          | ipv6-address | Not Specified       | ::               |
| input-device      | Incoming interface name.                              | string       | Maximum length: 79  |                  |
| <name>            | Interface name.                                       |              |                     |                  |
| input-device-negate | Enable/disable negation of input device match.      | option       | -                   | disable          |

### Options for `input-device-negate`

| Option  | Description                                      |
|---------|--------------------------------------------------|
| enable  | Enable negation of input device match.           |
| disable | Disable negation of input device match.          |

| Parameter         | Description                                            | Type         | Size                | Default         |
|-------------------|-------------------------------------------------------|--------------|---------------------|------------------|
| internet-service-custom | Custom Destination Internet Service name.       | string       | Maximum length: 79  |                  |
| <name>            | Custom Destination Internet Service name.            |              |                     |                  |
| internet-service-id | Destination Internet Service ID.                   | integer      | Minimum value: 0    | Maximum value: 4294967295 |

| Parameter         | Description                                            | Type         | Size                | Default         |
|-------------------|-------------------------------------------------------|--------------|---------------------|------------------|
| output-device      | Outgoing interface name.                             | string       | Maximum length: 35  |                  |
| protocol           | Protocol number.                                     | integer      | Minimum value: 0    | Maximum value: 255 |
| seq-num            | Sequence number.                                     | integer      | Minimum value: 0    | Maximum value: 65535 |
| src <addr6>       | Source IPv6 prefix.                                  | string       | Maximum length: 79  |                  |
| src-negate        | Enable/disable negating source address match.        | option       | -                   | disable          |

### Options for `src-negate`

| Option  | Description                                      |
|---------|--------------------------------------------------|
| enable  | Enable source address negation.                  |
| disable | Disable source address negation.                 |

| Parameter         | Description                                            | Type         | Size                | Default         |
|-------------------|-------------------------------------------------------|--------------|---------------------|------------------|
| srcaddr           | Source address name.                                  | string       | Maximum length: 79  |                  |
| <name>            | Address/group name.                                   |              |                     |                  |

# FortiOS 7.4.5 CLI Reference

## Parameters

|                  |                                                |         | Maximum    | 65535     |

|                  | Option                                         | Description                             | | |
|                  | enable                                         | Enable this policy route.               | | |
|                  | disable                                        | Disable this policy route.              | | |
| tos              | Type of service bit pattern.                   | user    | Not Specified | |
| tos-mask         | Type of service evaluated bits.                | user    | Not Specified | |

## Configuration Commands

### config router prefix-list

Configure IPv4 prefix lists.

```plaintext
config router prefix-list
Description: Configure IPv4 prefix lists.
edit <name>
set comments {string}
config rule
Description: IPv4 prefix list rule.
edit <id>
set action [permit|deny]
set ge {integer}
set le {integer}
set prefix {user}
next
end
next
end
```

### Parameters for Prefix List

| Parameter | Description                                     | Type    | Size       | Default   |
|-----------|-------------------------------------------------|---------|------------|-----------|
| comments  | Comment.                                        | string  | Maximum    | length: 127 |
| name      | Name.                                           | string  | Maximum    | length: 35 |
```

```markdown
# FortiOS 7.4.5 CLI Reference

## Configuring Rules

### Config Rule

| Parameter | Description                                             | Type    | Size   | Default  | |
|-----------|---------------------------------------------------------|---------|--------|----------|---|
| action    | Permit or deny this IP address and netmask prefix.     | option  | -      | permit   | |
|           | **Option**           | **Description**                                   |         |        |          |
|           | permit              | Allow or permit packets that match this rule.    |         |        |          |
|           | deny                | Deny packets that match this rule.                |         |        |          |
| ge        | Minimum prefix length to be matched.                   | integer | Minimum| value: 0 | |
|           |                                                         |         | Maximum| value: 32| |
| id        | Rule ID.                                               | integer | Minimum| value: 0 | |
|           |                                                         |         | Maximum| value: 4294967295 | |
| le        | Maximum prefix length to be matched.                   | integer | Minimum| value: 0 | |
|           |                                                         |         | Maximum| value: 32| |
| prefix    | IPv4 prefix to define regular filter criteria, such as "any" or subnets. | Not Specified | 0.0.0.0 | 0.0.0.0 | |

## Configuring IPv6 Prefix Lists

### Config Router Prefix-List6

Configure IPv6 prefix lists.

```plaintext
config router prefix-list6
Description: Configure IPv6 prefix lists.
edit <name>
set comments {string}
config rule
Description: IPv6 prefix list rule.
edit <id>
set action [permit|deny]
set flags {integer}
set ge {integer}
set le {integer}
set prefix6 {user}
next
end
next
end
```
```

|                | disable                 | Disable Bidirectional Forwarding Detection (BFD). |                |                 |

|                | disable                 | Disable black hole.  |                |                 |

```markdown
# FortiOS 7.4.5 CLI Reference

## Configuration Commands

### Switch Controller 802-1X Settings

The following parameters can be configured for 802-1X settings:

```plaintext
set mac-calling-station-delimiter [colon|hyphen|...]
set mac-case [lowercase|uppercase]
set mac-password-delimiter [colon|hyphen|...]
set mac-username-delimiter [colon|hyphen|...]
set max-reauth-attempt {integer}
set reauth-period {integer}
set tx-period {integer}
end
```

#### Parameters Description

| Parameter                     | Description                                                        | Type    | Size | Default      |
|-------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------|---------|------|--------------|
| link-down-auth                | Interface-reauthentication state to set if a link is down.        | option  | -    | set-unauth   |
| mab-reauth                    | Enable/disable MAB re-authentication.                              | option  | -    | disable      |
| mac-called-station-delimiter   | MAC called station delimiter.                                      | option  | -    | hyphen       |
| mac-calling-station-delimiter  | MAC calling station delimiter.                                     | option  | -    | hyphen       |

#### Option Descriptions

- **link-down-auth**
- `set-unauth`: Interface set to unauth when down. Reauthentication is needed.
- `no-action`: Interface reauthentication is not needed.

- **mab-reauth**
- `disable`: Disable MAB re-authentication.
- `enable`: Enable MAB re-authentication.

- **mac-called-station-delimiter**
- `colon`: Use colon as delimiter for called station.
- `hyphen`: Use hyphen as delimiter for called station.
- `none`: No delimiter for called station.
- `single-hyphen`: Use single hyphen as delimiter for called station.

- **mac-calling-station-delimiter**
- `colon`: Use colon as delimiter for calling station.
- `hyphen`: Use hyphen as delimiter for calling station.
```

### Policy Definitions

config switch-controller auto-config policy
Description: Policy definitions which can define the behavior on auto-configured interfaces.

set igmp-flood-traffic [enable|disable]

set storm-control-policy {string}
next
end
```

| Parameter              | Description                                          | Type   | Size | Default |
|-----------------------|------------------------------------------------------|--------|------|---------|
| igmp-flood-report     | Enable/disable IGMP flood report.                    | option | -    | disable |
```

### Description

```plaintext
edit <command-name>
set command {var-string}
set description {string}
next
end
```

### Parameters

### Description
Configure Dynamic port policy to be applied on the managed FortiSwitch ports through DPP device.

```plaintext
config switch-controller dynamic-port-policy
```

#### Configuration Steps
1. **Edit Dynamic Port Policy**
```plaintext
edit <name>
set description {string}
set fortilink {string}
config policy
```

2. **Port Policies with Matching Criteria and Actions**
```plaintext
edit <name>
set 802-1x {string}
set bounce-port-link [disable|enable]
set category [device|interface-tag]
set description {string}
set family {string}
set host {string}
set hw-vendor {string}
set interface-tags <tag-name1>, <tag-name2>, ...
set lldp-profile {string}
set mac {string}
set match-period {integer}
set match-type [dynamic|override]
set qos-policy {string}
set status [enable|disable]
```

# FortiOS 7.4.5 CLI Reference

## Dynamic Port Policy Configuration

To configure the dynamic port policy, use the following commands:

```plaintext
set type {string}
set vlan-policy {string}
next
end
```

### Configuration Parameters

#### config switch-controller dynamic-port-policy

| Parameter   | Description                                                                 | Type   | Size            | Default  |
|-------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------|-----------------|----------|
| description | Description for the Dynamic port policy.                                   | string | Maximum length: 63 | |
| fortilink   | FortiLink interface for which this Dynamic port policy belongs to.         | string | Maximum length: 15 | |
| name        | Dynamic port policy name.                                                  | string | Maximum length: 63 | |

#### config policy

| Parameter       | Description                                                                 | Type   | Size            | Default  |
|-----------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------|-----------------|----------|
| 802-1x          | 802.1x security policy to be applied when using this policy.               | string | Maximum length: 31 | |
| bounce-port-link| Enable/disable bouncing (administratively bring the link down, up) of a switch port where this policy is applied. Helps to clear and reassign VLAN from lldp-profile. | option | -               | enable   |
| category        | Category of Dynamic port policy.                                           | option | -               | device   |
| description     | Description for the policy.                                               | string | Maximum length: 63 | |
| family          | Match policy based on family.                                             | string | Maximum length: 31 | |

##### Bounce Port Link Options

| Option   | Description                                                                 |
|----------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| disable  | Disable bouncing (administratively bring the link down, up) of a switch port where this policy is applied. |
| enable   | Enable bouncing (administratively bring the link down, up) of a switch port where this policy is applied. |

##### Category Options

| Option          | Description               |
|-----------------|---------------------------|
| device          | Device category.         |
| interface-tag   | Interface Tag category.  |
```

# FortiOS 7.4.5 CLI Reference

## Parameters

| Parameter       | Description                                              | Type    | Size          | Default   |

| host             | Match policy based on host.                              | string  | Maximum length: 64 | |

Maximum value: 120 |

|                  | **Option**         | **Description**                                                                 |---|---|
|                  | dynamic            | Matched devices will be removed on dynamic events like link-down, device inactivity, switch-offline. | | |
|                  | override           | Matched devices will be retained until the match-period. | | |
| name             | Policy name.                                            | string  | Maximum length: 63 | |
| qos-policy       | QoS policy to be applied when using this policy.        | string  | Maximum length: 63 | |
| status           | Enable/disable policy.                                   | option  | -             | enable    |
|                  | **Option**         | **Description**                                                                 | | |
|                  | enable            | Enable policy.                                                               | | |
|                  | disable           | Disable policy.                                                              | | |
| type             | Match policy based on type.                              | string  | Maximum length: 15 | |
| vlan-policy      | VLAN policy to be applied when using this policy.       | string  | Maximum length: 63 | |

### Command Syntax

To configure FortiSwitch flow tracking and export via IPFIX/NetFlow, use the following command structure:

```bash
config switch-controller flow-tracking
Description: Configure FortiSwitch flow tracking and export via IPFIX/NetFlow.
config aggregates
Description: Configure aggregates in which all traffic sessions matching the IP Address will be grouped into the same flow.
edit <id>
set ip {ipv4-classnet}
next
end
config collectors
Description: Configure collectors for the flow.
edit <name>
set ip {ipv4-address-any}
set port {integer}
set transport [udp|tcp|...]
next
end
set format [netflow1|netflow5|...]
set level [vlan|ip|...]
set max-export-pkt-size {integer}
set sample-mode [local|perimeter|...]
set sample-rate {integer}
set template-export-period {integer}
```
```

## Configuration Commands

### Timeout Settings

set timeout-general {integer}

### Flow Tracking Configuration

```plaintext
config switch-controller flow-tracking
```

| Parameter        | Description                                   | Type   | Size | Default    | |
|------------------|-----------------------------------------------|--------|------|------------|---|
| format           | Configure flow tracking protocol.             | option | -    | netflow9   | |
|                  | Option             | Description            |        |      |            |
|                  | netflow1           | Netflow version 1 sampling. |        |      |            |
|                  | netflow5           | Netflow version 5 sampling. |        |      |            |
|                  | netflow9           | Netflow version 9 sampling. |        |      |            |
|                  | ipfix              | Ipfix sampling.          |        |      |            |
| level            | Configure flow tracking level.                | option | -    | ip         | |
|                  | Option             | Description            |        |      |            |
|                  | vlan               | Collects srcip/dstip/srcport/dstport/protocol/tos/vlan from the sample packet. |        |      |            |
|                  | ip                 | Collects srcip/dstip from the sample packet. |        |      |            |
|                  | port               | Collects srcip/dstip/srcport/dstport/protocol from the sample packet. |        |      |            |
|                  | proto              | Collects srcip/dstip/protocol from the sample packet. |        |      |            |
|                  | mac                | Collects smac/dmac from the sample packet. |        |      |            |
| max-export-pkt-size | Configure flow max export packet size.    | integer | Minimum value: 512 | 512 Maximum value: 9216 | |
| sample-mode      | Configure sample mode for the flow tracking. | option | -    | perimeter   | |
|                  | Option             | Description            |        |      |            |
|                  | local              | Set local mode which samples on the specific switch port. |        |      |            |
|                  | perimeter          | Set perimeter mode which samples on all switch fabric ports and fortilink port at the ingress. |        |      |            |
|                  | device-ingress     | Set device-ingress mode which samples across all switch ports at the ingress. |        |      |            |
| sample-rate      | Configure sample rate for the perimeter and device-ingress sampling. | integer | Minimum value: 0 | 0 Maximum value: 99999 | |
```

### Command Syntax

To configure integrated FortiLink settings for FortiSwitch, use the following command:

```bash
config switch-controller fortilink-settings
```

#### Description

Configure integrated FortiLink settings for FortiSwitch.

#### Command Structure

```bash
edit <name>
set access-vlan-mode [legacy|fail-open|...]
set fortilink {string}
set inactive-timer {integer}
set link-down-flush [disable|enable]
config nac-ports
Description: NAC specific configuration.
set lan-segment [enabled|disabled]
set member-change {integer}
set nac-lan-interface {string}
set nac-segment-vlans <vlan-name1>, <vlan-name2>, ...
set onboarding-vlan {string}
set parent-key {string}
end
next
end
```

# FortiOS 7.4.5 CLI Reference

## Configuration of Switch Controller FortiLink Settings

### Parameters

| Parameter        | Description                                                   | Type   | Size          | Default  |
|------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------|--------|---------------|----------|
| access-vlan-mode | Intra VLAN traffic behavior with loss of connection to the FortiGate. | option | -             | legacy   |
| fortilink        | FortiLink interface to which this fortilink-setting belongs. | string | Maximum length: 15 |          |
| inactive-timer   | Time interval (minutes) to be included in the inactive devices expiry calculation (mac age-out + inactive-time + periodic scan interval). | integer | Minimum value: 1, Maximum value: 1440 | 15       |
| link-down-flush  | Clear NAC and dynamic devices on switch ports on link down event. | option | -             | enable   |
| name             | FortiLink settings name.                                     | string | Maximum length: 35 |          |

### Access VLAN Mode Options

| Option   | Description                                                                 |
|----------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| legacy   | Backward compatible behavior.                                              |
| fail-open| When connection to FortiGate is lost, traffic on the VLAN may continue directly between end points. |
| fail-close| When connection to FortiGate is lost, traffic between endpoints on the VLAN is blocked. |

### Link Down Flush Options

| Option   | Description                                                                 |
|----------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| disable  | Disable clearing NAC and dynamic devices on a switch port when link down event happens. |
| enable   | Enable clearing NAC and dynamic devices on a switch port when link down event happens. |

## Configuration of NAC Ports

### Parameters

| Parameter        | Description                                                  | Type   | Size          | Default  |
|------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------|--------|---------------|----------|
| lan-segment      | Enable/disable LAN segment feature on the FortiLink interface. | option | -             | disabled  |

### LAN Segment Options

| Option   | Description                                                                 |
|----------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| enabled  | Enable lan-segment on this interface.                                     |
| disabled | Disable lan-segment on this interface.                                    |
```
