```markdown
# FortiSwitch Global Settings Configuration

## Command Overview

The following commands are used to configure FortiSwitch global settings.

### Configuration Command

```plaintext
config switch-controller global
```

#### Description
Configure FortiSwitch global settings.

### Commands

- `set bounce-quarantined-link [disable|enable]`

Enable/disable bouncing (administratively bring the link down, up) of a switch port where a quarantined device was seen last. Helps to re-initiate the DHCP process for a device.

| Option   | Description                                                                                       |
|----------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| disable  | Disable bouncing (administratively bring the link down, up) of a switch port where a quarantined device was seen last. |
| enable   | Enable bouncing (administratively bring the link down, up) of a switch port where a quarantined device was seen last.  |

- `config custom-command`

#### Description
List of custom commands to be pushed to all FortiSwitches in the VDOM.

```plaintext
edit <command-entry>
set command-name {string}
next
end
```

- `set default-virtual-switch-vlan {string}`
- `set dhcp-option82-circuit-id {option1}, {option2}, ...`
- `set dhcp-option82-format [ascii|legacy]`
- `set dhcp-option82-remote-id {option1}, {option2}, ...`
- `set dhcp-server-access-list [enable|disable]`
- `set dhcp-snoop-client-db-exp {integer}`
- `set dhcp-snoop-client-req [drop-untrusted|forward-untrusted]`
- `set dhcp-snoop-db-per-port-learn-limit {integer}`
- `set disable-discovery <name1>, <name2>, ...`
- `set fips-enforce [disable|enable]`
- `set firmware-provision-on-authorization [enable|disable]`
- `set https-image-push [enable|disable]`
- `set log-mac-limit-violations [enable|disable]`
- `set mac-aging-interval {integer}`
- `set mac-event-logging [enable|disable]`
- `set mac-retention-period {integer}`
- `set mac-violation-timer {integer}`
- `set quarantine-mode [by-vlan|by-redirect]`
- `set sn-dns-resolution [enable|disable]`
- `set update-user-device {option1}, {option2}, ...`
- `set vlan-all-mode [all|defined]`
- `set vlan-identity [description|name]`
- `set vlan-optimization [enable|disable]`

## End of Configuration

```plaintext
end
```
```

# FortiOS 7.4.5 CLI Reference

## Parameters

| Parameter                | Description                                                   | Type    | Size                | Default         | |
|--------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------|---------|---------------------|------------------|---|
| default-virtual-switch-vlan | Default VLAN for ports when added to the virtual-switch.   | string  | Maximum length: 15  |                  | |
| dhcp-option82-circuit-id | List the parameters to be included to inform about client identification. | option  | -                   | intfname vlan    | |
|                          | **Option**             | **Description**          |         |                     |                  |
|                          | intfname              | Interface name.         |         |                     |                  |
|                          | vlan                  | VLAN name.             |         |                     |                  |

|                          | mode                  | Mode.                  |         |                     |                  |
|                          | description           | Description.           |         |                     |                  |

|                          | **Option**             | **Description**          |         |                     |                  |
|                          | ascii                 | Allow user to choose values for circuit-id and remote-id. Format: `cid=[hostname,interface,mode,vlan,description] rid=[hostname,xx:xx:xx:xx:xx:xx,ip]` | | | |
|                          | legacy                | Generate predefined fixed format for circuit-id and remote. Format: `cid=hostname-[<vlan:16><mod:8>].32bit, rid=[mac(0.6)].48bit` | | | |
| dhcp-option82-remote-id  | List the parameters to be included to inform about client identification. | option  | -                   | mac              | |

|                          | mac                   | MAC address.           |         |                     |                  |
|                          | hostname              | Hostname.              |         |                     |                  |
|                          | ip                    | IP address.            |         |                     |                  |
| dhcp-server-access-list   | Enable/disable DHCP snooping server access list.           | option  | -                   | disable          | |
|                          | **Option**             | **Description**          |         |                     |                  |
|                          | enable                | Enable DHCP server access list. | | | |

### Command Description

Configure FortiSwitch IGMP snooping global settings.

```plaintext
config switch-controller igmp-snooping
```

### Parameters

| Parameter            | Description                                                                 | Type    | Size     | Default |
|----------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|---------|----------|---------|
| aging-time           | Maximum number of seconds to retain a multicast snooping entry for which no packets have been seen. | integer | Minimum: 15, Maximum: 3600 | 300     |
| flood-unknown-multicast | Enable/disable unknown multicast flooding.                                 | option  | -        | disable |

```plaintext
set aging-time {integer}
set flood-unknown-multicast [enable|disable]
set query-interval {integer}
end
```

# FortiOS 7.4.5 CLI Reference

## Parameter Descriptions

| Parameter         | Description                                           | Type    | Size     | Default |
|-------------------|-------------------------------------------------------|---------|----------|---------|
| enable            | Enable unknown multicast flooding.                    |         |          |         |

```markdown
# Configure FortiSwitch LLDP Profiles

## Command Structure

To configure FortiSwitch LLDP profiles, use the following command structure:

```plaintext
config switch-controller lldp-profile
```

### Description

Configure FortiSwitch LLDP profiles.

### Commands

- **edit `<name>`**

Configure a specific LLDP profile.

```plaintext
set 802 1-tlvs {option1}, {option2}, ...
set 802 3-tlvs {option1}, {option2}, ...
set auto-isl [disable|enable]
set auto-isl-auth [legacy|strict|...]
set auto-isl-auth-encrypt [none|mixed|...]
set auto-isl-auth-identity {string}
set auto-isl-auth-macsec-profile {string}
set auto-isl-auth-reauth {integer}
set auto-isl-auth-user {string}
set auto-isl-hello-timer {integer}
set auto-isl-port-group {integer}
set auto-isl-receive-timeout {integer}
set auto-mclag-icl [disable|enable]
```

#### Custom TLVs Configuration

To edit custom TLV entries, use the following commands:

```plaintext
config custom-tlvs
```

- **Description**: Configuration method to edit custom TLV entries.

```plaintext
edit <name>
set information-string {user}
set oui {user}
set subtype {integer}
next
end
```

#### MED Location Service Configuration

To edit Media Endpoint Discovery (MED) location service type-length-value (TLV) categories, use:

```plaintext
config med-location-service
```

- **Description**: Configuration method to edit MED location service TLV categories.

```plaintext
edit <name>
set status [disable|enable]
set sys-location-id {string}
next
end
```

#### MED Network Policy Configuration

To edit Media Endpoint Discovery (MED) network policy TLV categories, use:

```plaintext
config med-network-policy
```

- **Description**: Configuration method to edit MED network policy TLV categories.

```plaintext
edit <name>
set assign-vlan [disable|enable]
set dscp {integer}
set priority {integer}
set status [disable|enable]
set vlan-intf {string}
next
end
```

### Additional Settings

- **set med-tlvs**: `{option1}, {option2}, ...`

## Parameter Table

| Parameter   | Description                                   | Type    | Size | Default |
|-------------|-----------------------------------------------|---------|------|---------|
| 802 1-tlvs  | Transmitted IEEE 802.1 TLVs.                 | option  | -    |         |
```

# FortiOS 7.4.5 CLI Reference

## Configuration Commands

### switch-controller lldp-settings

The following parameters can be configured for LLDP settings:

| Parameter          | Description                                                             | Type   | Size   | Default  | |
|--------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------|--------|----------|---|
| device-detection    | Enable/disable dynamic detection of LLDP neighbor devices for VLAN assignment. | option | -      | enable   | |
|                    | **Option**            | **Description**                                          |        |        |          |
|                    | disable              | Disable dynamic detection of LLDP neighbor devices.    |        |        |          |
|                    | enable               | Enable dynamic detection of LLDP neighbor devices.     |        |        |          |
| fast-start-interval | Frequency of LLDP PDU transmission from FortiSwitch for the first 4 packets when the link is up. | integer | Minimum value: 0 | Maximum value: 255 | 2        |
| management-interface | Primary management interface to be advertised in LLDP and CDP PDUs. | option | -      | internal | |
|                    | **Option**            | **Description**                                          |        |        |          |
|                    | internal             | Use internal interface.                                 |        |        |          |
|                    | mgmt                 | Use management interface.                               |        |        |          |
| tx-hold            | Number of tx-intervals before local LLDP data expires. Packet TTL is tx-hold * tx-interval. | integer | Minimum value: 1 | Maximum value: 16 | 4        |
| tx-interval        | Frequency of LLDP PDU transmission from FortiSwitch. Packet TTL is tx-hold * tx-interval. | integer | Minimum value: 5 | Maximum value: 4095 | 30       |

### Command Syntax

```plaintext
set fast-start-interval {integer}
set management-interface [internal|mgmt]
set tx-hold {integer}
set tx-interval {integer}
end
```

### Command Syntax

To configure the MAC policy to be applied on the managed FortiSwitch devices through the NAC device, use the following command:

```plaintext
config switch-controller mac-policy
```

#### Description

Configure MAC policy to be applied on the managed FortiSwitch devices through NAC device.

#### Command Structure

```plaintext
edit <name>
set bounce-port-link [disable|enable]
set count [disable|enable]
set description {string}
set fortilink {string}
set traffic-policy {string}
set vlan {string}
next
end
```

### Parameters

| Parameter          | Description                                                                 | Type    | Size | Default |
|--------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|---------|------|---------|
| bounce-port-link   | Enable/disable bouncing (administratively bring the link down, up) of a switch port where this mac-policy is applied. | option  | -    | enable  |
```

config custom-command

# FortiOS 7.4.5 CLI Reference

## DHCP Snooping Static Clients Configuration

To configure FortiSwitch DHCP snooping static clients, use the following commands:

```plaintext
config dhcp-snooping-static-client
Description: Configure FortiSwitch DHCP snooping static clients.
edit <name>
set ip {ipv4-address}
set mac {mac-address}
set port {string}
set vlan {string}
next
end
```

## Additional DHCP Settings

- `set delayed-restart-trigger {integer}`
- `set description {string}`
- `set dhcp-server-access-list [global|enable|...]`
- `set directly-connected {integer}`
- `set dynamic-capability {user}`
- `set dynamically-discovered {integer}`
- `set firmware-provision [enable|disable]`
- `set firmware-provision-latest [disable|once]`
- `set firmware-provision-version {string}`
- `set flow-identity {user}`
- `set fsw-wan1-admin [discovered|disable|...]`
- `set fsw-wan1-peer {string}`

## IGMP Snooping Configuration

To configure FortiSwitch IGMP snooping global settings, use the following commands:

```plaintext
config igmp-snooping
Description: Configure FortiSwitch IGMP snooping global settings.
set aging-time {integer}
set flood-unknown-multicast [enable|disable]
set local-override [enable|disable]
config vlans
Description: Configure IGMP snooping VLAN.
edit <vlan-name>
set proxy [disable|enable|...]
set querier [disable|enable]
set querier-addr {ipv4-address}
set version {integer}
next
end
end
```

## IP Source Guard Configuration

To configure IP source guard, use the following commands:

```plaintext
config ip-source-guard
Description: IP source guard.
edit
config binding-entry
Description: IP and MAC address configuration.
edit <entry-name>
set ip {ipv4-address-any}
set mac {mac-address}
next
end
set description {string}
next
end
```

## Additional Settings

- `set l3-discovered {integer}`
- `set max-allowed-trunk-members {integer}`
- `set mclag-igmp-snooping-aware [enable|disable]`
- `set mgmt-mode {integer}`
- `config mirror`
```

# FortiOS 7.4.5 CLI Reference

## Configuration Commands

### STP Instance Configuration

The following commands are used to configure Spanning Tree Protocol (STP) instances:

```plaintext
set unknown-multicast [enable|disable]
set unknown-unicast [enable|disable]
end
```

#### Edit STP Instance

To edit a specific STP instance, use the following command:

```plaintext
config stp-instance
Description: Configuration method to edit Spanning Tree Protocol (STP) instances.
edit <id>
set priority [0|4096|...]
next
end
```

### STP Settings Configuration

The following commands are used to configure STP settings to prevent bridge loops:

```plaintext
config stp-settings
Description: Configuration method to edit Spanning Tree Protocol (STP) settings used to prevent bridge loops.
set forward-time {integer}
set hello-time {integer}
set local-override [enable|disable]
set max-age {integer}
set max-hops {integer}
set name {string}
set pending-timer {integer}
set revision {integer}
end
```

### Switch Configuration

The following commands are used for switch configuration:

```plaintext
set switch-device-tag {string}
set switch-dhcp_opt43_key {string}
```

#### Switch Log Configuration

To configure FortiSwitch logging settings (logs are transferred to and inserted into the FortiGate event log):

```plaintext
config switch-log
Description: Configuration method to edit FortiSwitch logging settings.
set local-override [enable|disable]
set severity [emergency|alert|...]
set status [enable|disable]
end
```

### Additional Switch Settings

```plaintext
set switch-profile {string}
set tdr-supported {string}
set tunnel-discovered {integer}
set type [virtual|physical]
set version {integer}
```

### VLAN Configuration

To configure VLAN assignment priority:

```plaintext
config vlan
Description: Configure VLAN assignment priority.
edit <vlan-name>
set assignment-priority {integer}
next
end
```

### Managed Switch Configuration

The following table describes parameters for configuring a managed switch:

| Parameter          | Description                          | Type   | Size                | Default |
|--------------------|--------------------------------------|--------|---------------------|---------|
| access-profile      | FortiSwitch access profile.         | string | Maximum length: 31  | default |

# FortiOS 7.4.5 CLI Reference

## Configure Network Monitor Settings

To configure network monitor settings, use the following command:

```plaintext
config switch-controller network-monitor-settings
```

### Description

Configure network monitor settings.

### Command

```plaintext
set network-monitoring [enable|disable]
```

### End Command

```plaintext
end
```

### Parameters

| Parameter         | Description                                                                 | Type    | Size | Default |
|-------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|---------|------|---------|
| network-monitoring| Enable/disable passive gathering of information by FortiSwitch units concerning other network devices. | option  | -    | disable |

### Options

| Option   | Description                                      |
|----------|--------------------------------------------------|
| enable   | Enable network monitoring on FortiSwitch.        |
| disable  | Disable network monitoring on FortiSwitch.       |

# FortiOS 7.4.5 CLI Reference

## PTP Interface-Policy Configuration

The following commands are used to configure the PTP interface-policy.

```plaintext
config switch-controller ptp interface-policy
Description: PTP interface-policy configuration.
edit <name>
set description {string}
set vlan {string}
set vlan-pri {integer}
next
end
```

### Parameters

| Parameter    | Description                                  | Type    | Size        | Default        |
|--------------|----------------------------------------------|---------|-------------|----------------|
| description  | Description.                                 | string  | Maximum length: 63 | |
| name         | Policy name.                                 | string  | Maximum length: 63 | |
| vlan         | PTP VLAN.                                    | string  | Maximum length: 15 | |
| vlan-pri     | Configure PTP VLAN priority.                 | integer | Minimum value: 0
Maximum value: 7 |
```

### Command Syntax

To configure FortiSwitch QoS 802.1p, use the following command:

```bash
config switch-controller qos dot1p-map
```

#### Parameters

- **Description**: Configure FortiSwitch QoS 802.1p.
- **edit `<name>`**: Specify the name of the QoS configuration.
- **set description `{string}`**: Set a description for the QoS configuration.
- **set egress-pri-tagging `[disable|enable]`**: Enable or disable egress priority tagging.
- **set priority-0 `[queue-0|queue-1|...]`**: Set the queue for priority 0.
- **set priority-1 `[queue-0|queue-1|...]`**: Set the queue for priority 1.
- **set priority-2 `[queue-0|queue-1|...]`**: Set the queue for priority 2.
- **set priority-3 `[queue-0|queue-1|...]`**: Set the queue for priority 3.
- **set priority-4 `[queue-0|queue-1|...]`**: Set the queue for priority 4.
- **set priority-5 `[queue-0|queue-1|...]`**: Set the queue for priority 5.
- **set priority-6 `[queue-0|queue-1|...]`**: Set the queue for priority 6.
- **set priority-7 `[queue-0|queue-1|...]`**: Set the queue for priority 7.

```bash
next
end
```

```markdown
# FortiOS 7.4.5 CLI Reference

## config switch-controller qos dot1p-map

### Parameters

| Parameter      | Description                                        | Type   | Size         | Default   |
|----------------|----------------------------------------------------|--------|--------------|-----------|
| description    | Description of the 802.1p name.                    | string | Maximum length: 63 |           |
| egress-pri-tagging | Enable/disable egress priority-tag frame.      | option | -            | disable   |
| name           | Dot1p map name.                                   | string | Maximum length: 63 |           |
| priority-0     | COS queue mapped to dot1p priority number.       | option | -            | queue-0   |
| priority-1     | COS queue mapped to dot1p priority number.       | option | -            | queue-0   |

### egress-pri-tagging Options

| Option  | Description                                   |
|---------|-----------------------------------------------|
| disable | Disable egress priority tagging.              |
| enable  | Enable egress priority tagging.               |

### priority-0 Options

| Option   | Description                          |
|----------|--------------------------------------|
| queue-0  | COS queue 0 (lowest priority).      |
| queue-1  | COS queue 1.                        |
| queue-2  | COS queue 2.                        |
| queue-3  | COS queue 3.                        |
| queue-4  | COS queue 4.                        |
| queue-5  | COS queue 5.                        |
| queue-6  | COS queue 6.                        |
| queue-7  | COS queue 7 (highest priority).     |

### priority-1 Options

| Option   | Description                          |
|----------|--------------------------------------|
| queue-0  | COS queue 0 (lowest priority).      |
| queue-1  | COS queue 1.                        |
| queue-2  | COS queue 2.                        |
| queue-3  | COS queue 3.                        |
| queue-4  | COS queue 4.                        |
| queue-5  | COS queue 5.                        |
| queue-6  | COS queue 6.                        |
| queue-7  | COS queue 7 (highest priority).     |
```

# FortiOS 7.4.5 CLI Reference

## Configuring Remote Logging for FortiSwitch

To configure logging by the FortiSwitch device to a remote syslog server, use the following command structure:

```plaintext
config switch-controller remote-log
Description: Configure logging by FortiSwitch device to a remote syslog server.
edit <name>
set csv [enable|disable]
set facility [kernel|user|...]
set port {integer}
set server {string}
set severity [emergency|alert|...]
set status [enable|disable]
next
end
```

### Parameters

| Parameter | Description                                          | Type   | Size | Default  |
|-----------|------------------------------------------------------|--------|------|----------|
| csv       | Enable/disable comma-separated value (CSV) strings. | option | -    | disable  |
| facility  | Facility to log to remote syslog server.            | option | -    | local7   |
| port      | Port number for the remote syslog server.           | option | -    | -        |
| server    | IP address or hostname of the remote syslog server. | string | -    | -        |
| severity  | Severity level of logs sent to the remote server.   | option | -    | -        |
| status    | Enable or disable logging to the remote server.     | option | -    | disable  |

### Option Descriptions

#### csv
- **enable**: Enable comma-separated value (CSV) strings.
- **disable**: Disable comma-separated value (CSV) strings.

#### facility
- **kernel**: Kernel messages.
- **user**: Random user-level messages.
- **mail**: Mail system.
- **daemon**: System daemons.
- **auth**: Security/authorization messages.
- **syslog**: Messages generated internally by syslogd.
- **lpr**: Line printer subsystem.
- **news**: Network news subsystem.
- **uucp**: UUCP server messages.
- **cron**: Clock daemon.
- **authpriv**: Security/authorization messages (private).
- **ftp**: FTP daemon.
- **ntp**: NTP daemon.
- **audit**: Log audit.
- **alert**: Log alert.
```

### Configure 802.1x MAC Authentication Bypass (MAB) Policies

```plaintext
config switch-controller security-policy 802-1X
Description: Configure 802.1x MAC Authentication Bypass (MAB) policies.
edit <name>
set auth-fail-vlan [disable|enable]
set auth-fail-vlan-id {string}
set authserver-timeout-period {integer}
set authserver-timeout-tagged [disable|lldp-voice|...]
set authserver-timeout-tagged-vlanid {string}
set authserver-timeout-vlan [disable|enable]
set authserver-timeout-vlanid {string}
set dacl [disable|enable]
set eap-auto-untagged-vlans [disable|enable]
set eap-passthru [disable|enable]
```

# FortiOS 7.4.5 CLI Reference

## Security Policy Configuration

### Commands

```plaintext
set framevid-apply [disable|enable]
set guest-auth-delay {integer}
set guest-vlan [disable|enable]
set guest-vlan-id {string}
set mac-auth-bypass [disable|enable]
set open-auth [disable|enable]
set policy-type {option}
set radius-timeout-overwrite [disable|enable]
set security-mode [802.1X|802.1X-mac-based]
set user-group <name1>, <name2>, ...
next
end
```

### Configuration for Switch Controller Security Policy 802-1X

| Parameter                | Description                                                                 | Type    | Size   | Default  |
|--------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|---------|--------|----------|
| auth-fail-vlan           | Enable to allow limited access to clients that cannot authenticate.         | option  | -      | disable  |
|                          | **Option**                                                                  |         |        |          |
|                          | disable: Disable authentication fail VLAN on this interface.                |         |        |          |
|                          | enable: Enable authentication fail VLAN on this interface.                  |         |        |          |
| auth-fail-vlan-id       | VLAN ID on which authentication failed.                                     | string  | Maximum length: 15 |          |
| authserver-timeout-period| Authentication server timeout period.                                       | integer | Minimum value: 3 | Maximum value: 15 |
| authserver-timeout-tagged| Configure timeout option for the tagged VLAN which allows limited access when the authentication server is unavailable. | option  | -      | disable  |
|                          | **Option**                                                                  |         |        |          |
|                          | disable: Disable authentication server timeout on this interface.           |         |        |          |
|                          | lldp-voice: LLDP voice timeout for the tagged VLAN on this interface.      |         |        |          |
|                          | static: Static timeout for the tagged VLAN on this interface.               |         |        |          |
| authserver-timeout-tagged-vlanid | Tagged VLAN name for which the timeout option is applied to (only one VLAN ID). | string  | Maximum length: 15 |          |
| authserver-timeout-vlan  | Enable/disable the authentication server timeout VLAN to allow limited access when RADIUS is unavailable. | option  | -      | disable  |
```

```markdown
# FortiOS 7.4.5 CLI Reference

## Parameters

| Parameter            | Description                                              | Type   | Size          | Default |
|----------------------|----------------------------------------------------------|--------|---------------|---------|
| authserver-timeout-vlanid | Authentication server timeout VLAN name.                 | string | Maximum length: 15 |         |
| dacl                 | Enable/disable dynamic access control list on this interface. | option | -             | disable |
| eap-auto-untagged-vlans | Enable/disable automatic inclusion of untagged VLANs.    | option | -             | enable  |
| eap-passthru         | Enable/disable EAP pass-through mode, allowing protocols (such as LLDP) to pass through ports for more flexible authentication. | option | -             | enable  |
| framevid-apply       | Enable/disable the capability to apply the EAP/MAB frame VLAN to the port native VLAN. | option | -             | enable  |

### Options for Parameters

#### dacl
| Option   | Description                                           |
|----------|-------------------------------------------------------|
| disable  | Disable dynamic access control list on this interface. |
| enable   | Enable dynamic access control on this interface.      |

#### eap-auto-untagged-vlans
| Option   | Description                                           |
|----------|-------------------------------------------------------|
| disable  | Disable automatic inclusion of untagged VLANs.       |
| enable   | Enable automatic inclusion of untagged VLANs.        |

#### eap-passthru
| Option   | Description                                           |
|----------|-------------------------------------------------------|
| disable  | Disable EAP pass-through mode on this interface.     |
| enable   | Enable EAP pass-through mode on this interface.      |

#### framevid-apply
| Option   | Description                                           |
|----------|-------------------------------------------------------|
| disable  | Disable the capability to apply the EAP/MAB frame VLAN to the port native VLAN. |
| enable   | Enable the capability to apply the EAP/MAB frame VLAN to the port native VLAN. |
```

# FortiSwitch SNMP Trap Threshold Configuration

## Overview
Configure FortiSwitch SNMP trap threshold values globally.

## Configuration Command
```plaintext
config switch-controller snmp-trap-threshold
```

### Description
Configure FortiSwitch SNMP trap threshold values globally.

### Parameters
| Parameter                  | Description                                   | Type    | Size      | Default |
|----------------------------|-----------------------------------------------|---------|-----------|---------|
| `trap-high-cpu-threshold`  | CPU usage when trap is sent.                 | integer | Minimum: 0 | 80      |
|                            |                                               |         | Maximum: 4294967295 |         |
| `trap-log-full-threshold`  | Log disk usage when trap is sent.            | integer | Minimum: 0 | 90      |
|                            |                                               |         | Maximum: 4294967295 |         |
| `trap-low-memory-threshold` | Memory usage when trap is sent.              | integer | Minimum: 0 | 80      |
|                            |                                               |         | Maximum: 4294967295 |         |

## End Configuration
```plaintext
end
```

- **set priv-proto**: [aes128|aes192|...]

- **set queries**: [disable|enable]
- **set query-port**: `{integer}`

```plaintext
next
end

|----------------|-------------------------------------------------------|---------|------|---------|
| auth-proto     | Authentication protocol.                              | option  | -    | sha256  |

# FortiOS 7.4.5 CLI Reference

## Parameters

| Parameter        | Description                                            | Type     | Size          | Default                | |
|------------------|-------------------------------------------------------|----------|---------------|------------------------|---|
| md5              | HMAC-MD5-96 authentication protocol.                 | option   |               |                        | |
| sha1             | HMAC-SHA-1 authentication protocol.                  | option   |               |                        | |
| sha224           | HMAC-SHA-224 authentication protocol.                | option   |               |                        | |
| sha256           | HMAC-SHA-256 authentication protocol.                | option   |               |                        | |
| sha384           | HMAC-SHA-384 authentication protocol.                | option   |               |                        | |
| sha512           | HMAC-SHA-512 authentication protocol.                | option   |               |                        | |
| auth-pwd         | Password for authentication protocol.                 | password | Not Specified |                        | |
| name             | SNMP user name.                                      | string   | Maximum length: 32 |                    | |
| priv-proto       | Privacy (encryption) protocol.                        | option   | -             | aes128                 | |
|                  | Option             | Description                     |          |               |                        |
|                  | aes128            | CFB128-AES-128 symmetric encryption protocol. |          |               |                        |
|                  | aes192            | CFB128-AES-192 symmetric encryption protocol. |          |               |                        |
|                  | aes192c           | CFB128-AES-192-C symmetric encryption protocol. |          |               |                        |
|                  | aes256           | CFB128-AES-256 symmetric encryption protocol. |          |               |                        |
|                  | aes256c          | CFB128-AES-256-C symmetric encryption protocol. |          |               |                        |
|                  | des              | CBC-DES symmetric encryption protocol. |          |               |                        |
| priv-pwd         | Password for privacy (encryption) protocol.         | password | Not Specified |                        | |
| queries          | Enable/disable SNMP queries for this user.          | option   | -             | enable                 | |
|                  | Option             | Description                     |          |               |                        |
|                  | disable           | Disable SNMP queries for this user. |          |               |                        |
|                  | enable            | Enable SNMP queries for this user. |          |               |                        |
| query-port       | SNMPv3 query port.                                  | integer  | Minimum value: 0 | Maximum value: 65535 | |
| security-level   | Security level for message authentication and encryption. | option | -             | no-auth-no-priv        | |

### Configuration Steps

To configure the FortiSwitch storm control policy to be applied on managed-switch ports, use the following commands:

```bash
config switch-controller storm-control-policy
edit <name>
set broadcast [enable|disable]
set description {string}
set rate {integer}
set storm-control-mode [global|override|...]
set unknown-multicast [enable|disable]
set unknown-unicast [enable|disable]
```

This command allows you to set various parameters for storm control on managed-switch ports.

```markdown
# FortiOS 7.4.5 CLI Reference

## Storm Control Configuration

### Command: `config switch-controller storm-control-policy`

| Parameter          | Description                                                              | Type    | Size           | Default   | |
|--------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------|---------|----------------|-----------|---|
| `broadcast`        | Enable/disable storm control to drop/allow broadcast traffic in override mode. | option  | -              | disable   | |
|                    | **Option**                    | **Description**                                                  |         |                |           |
|                    | `enable`                     | Enable storm control for broadcast traffic to drop packets which exceed configured rate limits. | | | |
|                    | `disable`                    | Disable storm control for broadcast traffic to allow all packets. | | | |

| Parameter          | Description                                                              | Type    | Size           | Default   | |
|--------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------|---------|----------------|-----------|---|
| `description`      | Description of the storm control policy.                                 | string  | Maximum length: 63 |           | |
| `name`             | Storm control policy name.                                               | string  | Maximum length: 63 |           | |
| `rate`             | Threshold rate in packets per second at which storm traffic is controlled in override mode. | integer | Minimum value: 0 | Maximum value: 10000000 | |
| `storm-control-mode` | Set Storm control mode.                                                | option  | -              | global    | |
|                    | **Option**                    | **Description**                                                  |         |                |           |
|                    | `global`                     | Apply Global or switch level storm control configuration.        | | | |
|                    | `override`                   | Override global and switch level storm control to use port level configuration. | | | |
|                    | `disabled`                   | Disable storm control on the port entirely overriding global and switch level storm control. | | | |

| Parameter          | Description                                                              | Type    | Size           | Default   | |
|--------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------|---------|----------------|-----------|---|
| `unknown-multicast` | Enable/disable storm control to drop/allow unknown multicast traffic in override mode. | option  | -              | disable   | |
|                    | **Option**                    | **Description**                                                  |         |                |           |
|                    | `enable`                     | Enable storm control for unknown multicast traffic to drop packets which exceed configured rate limits. | | | |
|                    | `disable`                    | Disable storm control for unknown multicast traffic to allow all packets. | | | |

| Parameter          | Description                                                              | Type    | Size           | Default   |
|--------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------|---------|----------------|-----------|
| `unknown-unicast`   | Enable/disable storm control to drop/allow unknown unicast traffic in override mode. | option  | -              | disable   |
```

### Command Syntax

To configure the FortiSwitch spanning tree protocol (STP), use the following command:

```plaintext
config switch-controller stp-settings
```

#### Parameters

| Parameter       | Description                                                | Type     | Size     | Default |
|------------------|------------------------------------------------------------|----------|----------|---------|
| forward-time     | Period of time a port is in listening and learning state. | integer  | Minimum  | 15      |
|                  |                                                            |          | value: 4 |         |
|                  |                                                            |          | Maximum  | 30      |
| hello-time       | Time interval between configuration messages.              | integer  |          | 2       |
| max-age          | Maximum age of received configuration messages.            | integer  |          | 20      |
| max-hops         | Maximum number of hops for a configuration message.       | integer  |          | 20      |
| name             | Name of the STP instance.                                  | string   |          |         |
| pending-timer    | Time to wait before processing pending messages.           | integer  |          | 60      |
| revision         | Revision number for the STP instance.                      | integer  |          | 0       |

```plaintext
set forward-time {integer}
set hello-time {integer}
set max-age {integer}
set max-hops {integer}
set name {string}
set pending-timer {integer}
set revision {integer}
end
```
---
```markdown
# FortiOS 7.4.5 CLI Reference

## Parameters

| Parameter        | Description                                                       | Type    | Size                     | Default                |
|------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------|---------|--------------------------|------------------------|
| hello-time       | Period of time between successive STP frame Bridge Protocol Data Units. | integer | Minimum value: 1        | 2                      |
|                  |                                                                   |         | Maximum value: 10       |                        |
| max-age          | Maximum time before a bridge port expires its configuration BPDU information. | integer | Minimum value: 6        | 20                     |
|                  |                                                                   |         | Maximum value: 40       |                        |
| max-hops         | Maximum number of hops between the root bridge and the furthest bridge. | integer | Minimum value: 1        | 20                     |
|                  |                                                                   |         | Maximum value: 40       |                        |
| name             | Name of global STP settings configuration.                        | string  | Maximum length: 31      |                        |
| pending-timer    | Pending time.                                                    | integer | Minimum value: 1        | 4                      |
|                  |                                                                   |         | Maximum value: 15       |                        |
| revision         | STP revision number.                                             | integer | Minimum value: 0        | 0                      |
|                  |                                                                   |         | Maximum value: 65535    |                        |
```

### Command Syntax

To configure the FortiSwitch switch profile, use the following command:

```plaintext
config switch-controller switch-profile
```

#### Description

Configure FortiSwitch switch profile.

#### Command Options

```plaintext
edit <name>
set login [enable|disable]
set login-passwd {password}
set login-passwd-override [enable|disable]
set revision-backup-on-logout [enable|disable]
set revision-backup-on-upgrade [enable|disable]
next
end
```

### Parameters

| Parameter                          | Description                                           | Type   | Size | Default |
|------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------|--------|------|---------|
| login                              | Enable/disable FortiSwitch serial console.           | option | -    | enable  |
```

### Command Syntax

To configure system-wide switch controller settings, use the following command:

```plaintext
config switch-controller system
```

### Parameters

- `set caputp-echo-interval {integer}`
- `set caputp-max-retransmit {integer}`
- `set data-sync-interval {integer}`
- `set dynamic-periodic-interval {integer}`
- `set iot-holdoff {integer}`
- `set iot-mac-idle {integer}`
- `set iot-scan-interval {integer}`
- `set iot-weight-threshold {integer}`
- `set nac-periodic-interval {integer}`
- `set parallel-process {integer}`
- `set parallel-process-override [disable|enable]`
- `set tunnel-mode [compatible|moderate|...]`

```plaintext
end
```

# FortiOS 7.4.5 CLI Reference

## Configuration: Switch Controller System

### Parameters

| Parameter            | Description                                                       | Type    | Size      | Default |
|----------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------|---------|-----------|---------|
| caputp-echo-interval | Echo interval for the caputp echo requests from swtp.           | integer | Minimum   | 30      |
|                      |                                                                   |         | value: 8  |         |
|                      |                                                                   |         | Maximum   |         |
|                      |                                                                   |         | value: 600|         |
| caputp-max-retransmit| Maximum retransmission count for the caputp tunnel packets.      | integer | Minimum   | 5       |
|                      |                                                                   |         | value: 0  |         |
|                      |                                                                   |         | Maximum   |         |
|                      |                                                                   |         | value: 64 |         |
| data-sync-interval   | Time interval between collection of switch data.                 | integer | Minimum   | 60      |
|                      |                                                                   |         | value: 30 |         |
|                      |                                                                   |         | Maximum   |         |
|                      |                                                                   |         | value: 1800|        |
| dynamic-periodic-interval | Periodic time interval to run Dynamic port policy engine.   | integer | Minimum   | 60      |
|                      |                                                                   |         | value: 5  |         |
|                      |                                                                   |         | Maximum   |         |
|                      |                                                                   |         | value: 180|         |
| iot-holdoff          | MAC entry's creation time. Time must be greater than this value for an entry to be created. | integer | Minimum   | 5       |
|                      |                                                                   |         | value: 0  |         |
|                      |                                                                   |         | Maximum   |         |
|                      |                                                                   |         | value: 10080|       |
| iot-mac-idle         | MAC entry's idle time. MAC entry is removed after this value.    | integer | Minimum   | 1440    |
|                      |                                                                   |         | value: 0  |         |
|                      |                                                                   |         | Maximum   |         |
|                      |                                                                   |         | value: 10080|       |
| iot-scan-interval    | IoT scan interval.                                               | integer | Minimum   | 60      |
|                      |                                                                   |         | value: 2  |         |
|                      |                                                                   |         | Maximum   |         |
|                      |                                                                   |         | value: 10080|       |
| iot-weight-threshold  | MAC entry's confidence value. Value is re-queried when below this value. | integer | Minimum   | 1       |
|                      |                                                                   |         | value: 0  |         |
|                      |                                                                   |         | Maximum   |         |
|                      |                                                                   |         | value: 255|         |
| nac-periodic-interval | Periodic time interval to run NAC engine.                       | integer | Minimum   | 60      |
|                      |                                                                   |         | value: 5  |         |
|                      |                                                                   |         | Maximum   |         |
|                      |                                                                   |         | value: 180|         |

```markdown
# FortiOS 7.4.5 CLI Reference

## Parameters

| Parameter                | Description                                           | Type    | Size    | Default  |
|--------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------|---------|---------|----------|
| `parallel-process`       | Maximum number of parallel processes.                 | integer | Minimum | 1        |
|                          |                                                       |         |         | Maximum  |
|                          |                                                       |         |         | value: 128 |
| `parallel-process-override` | Enable/disable parallel process override.          | option  | -       | disable  |

### Options for `parallel-process-override`

| Option   | Description                                                                 |
|----------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| disable  | Disable maximum parallel process override.                                   |
| enable   | Enable maximum parallel process override.                                    |

| Parameter        | Description                                           | Type    | Size | Default    |
|------------------|-------------------------------------------------------|---------|------|------------|
| `tunnel-mode`    | Compatible/strict tunnel mode.                         | option  | -    | compatible |

### Options for `tunnel-mode`

| Option      | Description                                                                 |
|-------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| compatible  | Least restrictive. Supports the widest variety of hardware and software versions. |
| moderate    | Moderate level of security. Supports recent generations of hardware and latest software versions. |
| strict      | Highest level of security. Supports only the latest generation of hardware and latest software version. |

**Note:** Values may differ between models.

config switch-controller traffic-policy

#### Description

Configure FortiSwitch traffic policy.

```bash
edit <name>

set description {string}
set guaranteed-bandwidth {integer}

end

### Command Structure
```plaintext
config switch-controller traffic-sniffer
set erspan-ip {ipv4-address}
set mode [erspan-auto|rspan|...]
config target-ip
Description: Sniffer IPs to filter.
edit <ip>
set description {string}
next
end
config target-mac
Description: Sniffer MACs to filter.
edit <mac>
set description {string}
next
end
config target-port
Description: Sniffer ports to filter.
edit <switch-id>
set description {string}
set in-ports <name1>, <name2>, ...
set out-ports <name1>, <name2>, ...
next
end
```

# FortiOS 7.4.5 CLI Reference

## Configuration Commands

### Switch Controller Traffic Sniffer

#### Parameters

| Parameter   | Description                                           | Type         | Size          | Default   |
|-------------|-------------------------------------------------------|--------------|---------------|-----------|
| erspan-ip   | Configure ERSPAN collector IP address.                | ipv4-address | Not Specified | 0.0.0.0   |
| mode        | Configure traffic sniffer mode.                       | option       | -             | erspan-auto |

#### Options

| Option        | Description                                      |
|---------------|--------------------------------------------------|
| erspan-auto   | Mirror traffic using a GRE tunnel.               |
| rspan         | Mirror traffic on a layer2 VLAN.                 |
| none          | Disable traffic mirroring (sniffer).             |

### Target IP Configuration

#### Parameters

| Parameter   | Description                                           | Type         | Size          | Default   |
|-------------|-------------------------------------------------------|--------------|---------------|-----------|
| description | Description for the sniffer IP.                       | string       | Maximum length: 63 | |

### Target MAC Configuration

#### Parameters

| Parameter   | Description                                           | Type         | Size          | Default   |
|-------------|-------------------------------------------------------|--------------|---------------|-----------|
| description | Description for the sniffer MAC.                      | string       | Maximum length: 63 | |

### Target Port Configuration

#### Parameters

| Parameter   | Description                                           | Type         | Size          | Default   |
|-------------|-------------------------------------------------------|--------------|---------------|-----------|
| description | Description for the sniffer port entry.              | string       | Maximum length: 63 | |
| in-ports    | Configure source ingress port interfaces.            | string       | Maximum length: 79 | |

#### Configure VLAN Policy

To configure VLAN policy to be applied on the managed FortiSwitch ports through dynamic-port-policy:

```plaintext
config switch-controller vlan-policy
edit <name>
set allowed-vlans <vlan-name1>, <vlan-name2>, ...
set allowed-vlans-all [enable|disable]
set description {string}
set discard-mode [none|all-untagged|...]
set fortilink {string}
set untagged-vlans <vlan-name1>, <vlan-name2>, ...
set vlan {string}
```

# FortiOS 7.4.5 CLI Reference

## VLAN Policy Configuration

### Command: `config switch-controller vlan-policy`

#### Parameters

| Parameter          | Description                                                             | Type   | Size                | Default  | |
|--------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------|---------------------|----------|---|
| allowed-vlans      | Allowed VLANs to be applied when using this VLAN policy.                | string | Maximum length: 79  |          | |
| <vlan-name>        | VLAN name.                                                              |        |                     |          | |
| allowed-vlans-all  | Enable/disable all defined VLANs when using this VLAN policy.           | option | -                   | disable  | |
|                    | **Option**       | **Description**                                          |        |                     |          |
|                    | enable           | Enable all defined VLANs.                               |        |                     |          |
|                    | disable          | Disable all defined VLANs.                              |        |                     |          |
| description        | Description for the VLAN policy.                                     | string | Maximum length: 63  |          | |
| discard-mode       | Discard mode to be applied when using this VLAN policy.               | option | -                   | none     | |
|                    | **Option**       | **Description**                                          |        |                     |          |
|                    | none             | Discard disabled.                                       |        |                     |          |
|                    | all-untagged    | Discard all frames that are untagged.                     |        |                     |          |
|                    | all-tagged      | Discard all frames that are tagged.                       |        |                     |          |
| fortilink         | FortiLink interface for which this VLAN policy belongs to.            | string | Maximum length: 15  |          | |
| name               | VLAN policy name.                                                    | string | Maximum length: 63  |          | |
| untagged-vlans    | Untagged VLANs to be applied when using this VLAN policy.             | string | Maximum length: 79  |          | |
| <vlan-name>        | VLAN name.                                                            |        |                     |          | |
| vlan               | Native VLAN to be applied when using this VLAN policy.                | string | Maximum length: 15  |          | |

----

Fortinet Inc.

### Command Syntax

Description: 3G MODEM custom.
edit <id>
set class-id {user}
set init-string {string}

set product-id {user}

next
end

```markdown
# FortiOS 7.4.5 CLI Reference

## Parameters

| Parameter      | Description                                        | Type     | Size     | Default                          |
|----------------|----------------------------------------------------|----------|----------|----------------------------------|
| id             | ID.                                               | integer  | Minimum  | 0                                |
|                |                                                    |          | Maximum  | 4294967295                       |
| init-string    | Init string in hexadecimal format (even length).  | string   | Maximum  | length: 127                      |
| model          | MODEM model name.                                 | string   | Maximum  | length: 35                       |
| modeswitch-string | USB modeswitch arguments. For example: '-v 1410 -p 9030 -V 1410 -P 9032 -u 3'. | string   | Maximum  | length: 127                      |
| product-id     | USB product ID in hexadecimal format (0000-ffff). | user     | Not Specified |                              |

## ACME Client Configuration

### Command: `config system acme`
Configure ACME client.

#### Parameters

| Parameter       | Description                                                       | Type     | Size                | Default   |
|------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------|----------|---------------------|-----------|
| interface        | Interface(s) on which the ACME client will listen for challenges. | string   | Maximum length: 79  |           |
| source-ip        | Source IPv4 address used to connect to the ACME server.          | ipv4-address | Not Specified   | 0.0.0.0  |
| source-ip6       | Source IPv6 address used to connect to the ACME server.          | ipv6-address | Not Specified   | ::       |
| use-ha-direct    | Enable the use of 'ha-mgmt' interface to connect to the ACME server when 'ha-direct' is enabled in HA configuration | option   | -                   | disable   |

#### Options

| Option           | Description         |
|------------------|---------------------|
| read             | Read access.        |
| read-write       | Read/write access.  |
| enable           | Enable setting.     |
| disable          | Disable setting.    |

### Subcommands

#### Command: `config accounts`
Description: ACME accounts list.

- **edit `<id>`**
- `set ca_url {string}`
- `set email {string}`
- `set privatekey {string}`
- `set status {string}`
- `set url {string}`
- **next**
- **end**

### Example Configuration

```bash
config system acme
set interface <interface-name1>, <interface-name2>, ...
set source-ip {ipv4-address}
set source-ip6 {ipv6-address}
set use-ha-direct [enable|disable]
end
```

| accprofile        | Access profile for this administrator. Access profiles control administrator access to FortiGate features. | string  | Maximum length: 35 |         |
| accprofile-override | Enable to use the name of an access profile provided by the remote authentication server to control the FortiGate features that this administrator can access. | option  | -       | disable |
| allow-remove-admin-session | Enable/disable allow admin session to be removed by privileged admin users. | option  | -       | enable  |

#### Options

| Option   | Description                          |
|----------|--------------------------------------|
| enable   | Enable access profile override.      |
| disable  | Disable access profile override.     |
| enable   | Enable allow-remove option.          |
| disable  | Disable allow-remove option.         |

| ip6-trusthost1     | Any IPv6 address from which the administrator can connect to the FortiGate unit. Default allows access from any IPv6 address. | ipv6-prefix  | Not Specified      | ::/0      |
| ip6-trusthost10    | Any IPv6 address from which the administrator can connect to the FortiGate unit. Default allows access from any IPv6 address. | ipv6-prefix  | Not Specified      | ::/0      |
| ip6-trusthost2     | Any IPv6 address from which the administrator can connect to the FortiGate unit. Default allows access from any IPv6 address. | ipv6-prefix  | Not Specified      | ::/0      |
| ip6-trusthost3     | Any IPv6 address from which the administrator can connect to the FortiGate unit. Default allows access from any IPv6 address. | ipv6-prefix  | Not Specified      | ::/0      |
| ip6-trusthost4     | Any IPv6 address from which the administrator can connect to the FortiGate unit. Default allows access from any IPv6 address. | ipv6-prefix  | Not Specified      | ::/0      |

### Options for Force Password Change

| Option   | Description                                      |
|----------|--------------------------------------------------|
| enable   | Enable force password change on next login.      |
| disable  | Disable force password change on next login.     |

### Options for Guest Authentication

| Option   | Description                                      |
|----------|--------------------------------------------------|
| disable  | Disable guest authentication.                     |
| enable   | Enable guest authentication.                      |

### Configure interrupt affinity

```plaintext
config system affinity-interrupt
Description: Configure interrupt affinity.
edit <id>
set affinity-cpumask      {string}
set default-affinity-cpumask {string}
set interrupt {string}
next
end
```

### Parameters

| Parameter                  | Description                                                                 | Type   | Size                     | Default         |
|----------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------|--------------------------|------------------|
| affinity-cpumask           | Affinity setting (64-bit hexadecimal value in the format of 0xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx). | string | Maximum length: 127      |                  |
| default-affinity-cpumask   | Default affinity setting (64-bit hexadecimal value in the format of 0xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx). Read-only. | string | Maximum length: 127      |                  |
```

```markdown
# FortiOS 7.4.5 CLI Reference

## Config System Affinity-Packet-Redistribution

### Parameters

| Parameter     | Description                                             | Type     | Size     | Default  |
|---------------|---------------------------------------------------------|----------|----------|----------|
| affinity-cpumask | Affinity setting for VM throughput (64-bit hexadecimal string value in the format of 0xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx). | string   | Maximum length: 127 |          |
| id            | ID of the packet redistribution setting.                | integer  | Minimum value: 0
Maximum value: 4294967295 |          | | | | |
| interface     | Physical interface name on which to perform packet redistribution. | string   | Maximum length: 15 |          |
| round-robin   | Enable/disable round-robin redistribution to multiple CPUs. | option   | -        | disable  |

#### Round-Robin Options

| Option  | Description                                   |
|---------|-----------------------------------------------|
| enable  | Enable round-robin redistribution.           |
| disable | Disable round-robin redistribution.          |

| rxqid   | ID of the receive queue (when the interface has multiple queues) on which to perform packet redistribution (255 = all queues). | integer  | Minimum value: 0
Maximum value: 255 |          |

## Config System Alarm

Configure alarm.

config system alarm

set admin-auth-lockout-threshold {integer}

set fw-policy-id-threshold {integer}

edit <id>
set dst-ip {ipv4-address}
set dst-port {integer}
set src-ip {ipv4-address}
set src-port {integer}
set threshold {integer}
```
```

# FortiOS 7.4.5 CLI Reference

## Configuration Commands

### Alarm Configuration

```plaintext
config system alarm
set log-full-warning-threshold {integer}
set period {integer}
set replay-attempt-threshold {integer}
set self-test-failure-threshold {integer}
set user-auth-failure-threshold {integer}
set user-auth-lockout-threshold {integer}
end
```

#### Parameters

| Parameter                               | Description                                        | Type    | Size | Default |
|-----------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------|---------|------|---------|
| audible                                 | Enable/disable audible alarm.                      | option  | -    | disable |
| status                                  | Enable/disable alarm.                              | option  | -    | disable |

**Options for `audible`:**
- `enable`: Enable audible alarm.
- `disable`: Disable audible alarm.

**Options for `status`:**
- `enable`: Enable alarm.
- `disable`: Disable alarm.

|                                         |                                                    |         | Maximum value: 1024 |         |

## Configuration of System Alias

### Command Syntax
```plaintext
config system alias
```

### Description
Configure alias command.

### Command Structure
```plaintext
config system alias
edit <name>
set command {var-string}
next
end
```

### Parameters

| Parameter | Description                                   | Type        | Size                     | Default         |
|-----------|-----------------------------------------------|-------------|--------------------------|------------------|
| command   | Command list to execute.                      | var-string  | Maximum length: 255      |                  |
| name      | Alias command name.                           | string      | Maximum length: 35       |                  |

# FortiOS 7.4.5 CLI Reference

## Configuring API Users

### Command Overview

The `config system api-user` command is used to configure API users.

```plaintext
config system api-user
```

#### Description

Configure API users.

### Editing an API User

To edit an existing API user, use the following command:

```plaintext
edit <name>
```

#### Parameters

- `set accprofile {string}`: Admin user access profile.
- `set api-key {password-2}`: Admin user password.
- `set comments {var-string}`: Comment.
- `set cors-allow-origin {string}`: Value for Access-Control-Allow-Origin on API responses. Avoid using '*' if possible.
- `set peer-auth [enable|disable]`: Enable/disable peer authentication.
- `set peer-group {string}`: Peer group name.
- `set schedule {string}`: Schedule for the API user.
- `config trusthost`: Configure trusted hosts.

### Configuring Trusted Hosts

To configure trusted hosts, use the following command:

```plaintext
config trusthost
```

#### Description

Trusthost configuration.

##### Editing a Trusted Host

To edit a trusted host, use the following command:

```plaintext
edit <id>
```

###### Parameters

- `set ipv4-trusthost {ipv4-classnet}`: Set the IPv4 trusted host.
- `set ipv6-trusthost {ipv6-prefix}`: Set the IPv6 trusted host.
- `set type [ipv4-trusthost|ipv6-trusthost]`: Specify the type of trusted host.

```plaintext
next
end
```

### Additional Parameters

```plaintext
set vdom <name1>, <name2>, ...
```

### API User Parameters Table

| Parameter         | Description                                               | Type        | Size                | Default      |
|-------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------|-------------|---------------------|--------------|
| accprofile        | Admin user access profile.                                | string      | Maximum length: 35  |              |
| api-key           | Admin user password.                                      | password-2  | Not Specified       |              |
| comments          | Comment.                                                 | var-string  | Maximum length: 255 |              |
| cors-allow-origin  | Value for Access-Control-Allow-Origin on API responses.  | string      | Maximum length: 269 |              |
| name              | User name.                                              | string      | Maximum length: 35  |              |
| peer-auth         | Enable/disable peer authentication.                       | option      | -                   | disable      |

| disable  | Disable peer. |

### Command Syntax

To configure system auto-scaling, use the following command:

```bash
config system auto-scale
```

### Parameters

| Parameter      | Description                                          | Type         | Size          | Default         | |
|----------------|------------------------------------------------------|--------------|---------------|------------------|---|
| callback-url   | Callback URL.                                        | var-string   | Maximum length: 4095 |                  | |
| cloud-mode     | Cloud mode setting.                                  | string       |               |                  | |
| hb-interval     | Heartbeat interval.                                  | integer      |               |                  | |
| primary-ip     | Primary IP address.                                 | ipv4-address-any |           |                  | |
| psksecret      | Pre-shared key secret.                              | password-3   |               |                  | |
| role           | Role of the instance.                               | [primary|secondary] |         |                  |
| status         | Enable or disable the auto-scaling.                 | [enable|disable] |           |                  |
| sync-interface | Interface for synchronization.                       | string       |               |                  | |

### End Command

```bash
end
```

This documentation provides a comprehensive overview of the `config system auto-scale` command and its parameters for configuring auto-scaling in FortiGate devices.

## Configuration of System Automation Stitch

Automation stitches are configured using the following commands:

```plaintext
config system automation-stitch
Description: Automation stitches.
edit <name>
config actions
Description: Configure stitch actions.
edit <id>
set action {string}
set delay {integer}
set required [enable|disable]
next
end
set description {var-string}
set destination <name1>, <name2>, ...
set status [enable|disable]
set trigger {string}
next
end
```

|              | Option         | Description                          |             |                     |         |

|              | disable       | Disable stitch.                      |             |                     |         |

## Configuring System Auto-update Schedule

| Option      | Description                                           |
|-------------|-------------------------------------------------------|

### Command Syntax

To configure system bypass, use the following command:

```bash
config system bypass
```

### Parameters

| Parameter        | Description                                          | Type   | Size | Default |
|------------------|------------------------------------------------------|--------|------|---------|
| auto-recover     | Automatically recover from bypass mode after system reboot. | option | -    | enable  |

#### Options

- **enable**: Recover interfaces from bypass mode. The actual mode is determined by the `poweron-bypass` setting.
- **disable**: Keep interfaces in bypass mode if bypass was previously triggered.

### Example Configuration

```bash
config system bypass
set auto-recover [enable|disable]
set bypass-timeout [2|4|...]
set bypass-watchdog [enable|disable]
set poweroff-bypass [enable|disable]
end
```

This concludes the configuration for system bypass in FortiOS 7.4.5.

| interface-select-method   | Specify how to select outgoing interface to reach server.         | option | -               | auto    |

### Options for `interface-select-method`

| Option   | Description                                                                 |
|----------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| auto     | Set outgoing interface automatically.                                       |
| sdwan    | Set outgoing interface by SD-WAN or policy routing rules.                  |
| specify   | Set outgoing interface manually.                                           |

| Parameter                | Description                                                        | Type   | Size            | Default |
|--------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------|--------|-----------------|---------|
| local-cert               | Certificate to be used by FGFM protocol.                           | string | Maximum length: 35 |         |
| ltefw-upgrade-frequency* | Set LTE firmware auto pushdown frequency.                          | option | -               |         |

### Options for `ltefw-upgrade-frequency`

| Option         | Description                                                   |
|----------------|---------------------------------------------------------------|
| everyHour      | Auto check and pushdown LTE firmware every hour.             |
| every12hour    | Auto check and pushdown LTE firmware every 12 hours.         |
| everyDay       | Auto check and pushdown LTE firmware every day.              |
| everyWeek      | Auto check and pushdown LTE firmware every week.             |

| Parameter                | Description                                                        | Type   | Size            | Default |
|--------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------|--------|-----------------|---------|
| ltefw-upgrade-time*     | Schedule next LTE firmware upgrade time (Local Time). Format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS | string | Maximum length: 35 |         |

Add this FortiGate to a Security Fabric or set up a new Security Fabric on this FortiGate.

```plaintext
set accept-auth-by-cert [disable|enable]
set authorization-request-type [serial|certificate]

set configuration-sync [default|local]

- **Description**: Fabric connector configuration.

set vdom <name1>, <name2>, ...
next
end
```

## DDNS Configuration

The following parameters are available for configuring the DDNS (Dynamic Domain Name System):

| Parameter        | Description                                                  | Type           | Size             | Default  |
|------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------|----------------|------------------|----------|
| addr-type        | Address type of interface address in DDNS update.           | option         | -                | ipv4     |
|                  | **Option**                                                  |                |                  |          |
|                  | ipv4 - Use IPv4 address of the interface.                  |                |                  |          |
|                  | ipv6 - Use IPv6 address of the interface.                  |                |                  |          |
| bound-ip         | Bound IP address. Read-only.                               | string         | Maximum length: 46 |          |
| clear-text       | Enable/disable use of clear text connections.               | option         | -                | disable  |
|                  | **Option**                                                  |                |                  |          |
|                  | disable - Disable use of clear text connections.           |                |                  |          |
|                  | enable - Enable use of clear text connections.             |                |                  |          |
| ddns-auth        | Enable/disable TSIG authentication for your DDNS server.   | option         | -                | disable  |
|                  | **Option**                                                  |                |                  |          |
|                  | disable - Disable DDNS authentication.                     |                |                  |          |
|                  | tsig - Enable TSIG authentication based on RFC2845.       |                |                  |          |
| ddns-domain      | Your fully qualified domain name. For example, yourname.ddns.com. | string         | Maximum length: 64 |          |
| ddns-key         | DDNS update key (base 64 encoding).                        | password_      | Not Specified    |          |
| ddns-keyname     | DDNS update key name.                                      | string         | Maximum length: 64 |          |
| ddns-password     | DDNS password.                                            | password       | Not Specified    |          |
| ddns-server      | Select a DDNS service provider.                            | option         | -                |          |
|                  | **Option**                                                  |                |                  |          |
|                  | dyndns.org - members.dyndns.org and dnsalias.com         |                |                  |          |
|                  | dyns.net - www.dyns.net                                   |                |                  |          |
|                  | tzo.com - rh.tzo.com                                      |                |                  |          |
|                  | vavic.com - Peanut Hull                                   |                |                  |          |

## Parameters

Maximum value: 10080 | 15             | | | | |
