### Status Options

| Option            | Description                                                                 |
|-------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| disabled          | No federated upgrade has been configured.                                   |
| initialized       | The upgrade has been configured.                                           |
| downloading       | The image is downloading in preparation for the upgrade.                   |
| device-disconnected| The image downloads are complete, but one or more devices have disconnected.|
| ready             | The image download finished and the upgrade is pending.                    |
| coordinating      | The upgrade is coordinating with other running upgrades.                   |
| staging           | The upgrade is confirmed and images are being staged.                      |
| final-check       | The upgrade is ready and final checks are in progress.                     |
| upgrade-devices   | The upgrade is ready and devices are being rebooted.                      |
| cancelled         | The upgrade was cancelled due to the tree not being ready.                 |
| confirmed         | The upgrade was confirmed and reboots are running.                         |
| done              | The upgrade completed successfully.                                        |
| failed            | The upgrade failed due to a local issue.                                   |

| Parameter        | Description                                           | Type    | Size          | Default        |
|------------------|-------------------------------------------------------|---------|---------------|----------------|
| time             | Scheduled upgrade execution time in UTC (hh:mm yyyy/mm/dd UTC). | user    | Not Specified |                |
| timing           | Run immediately or at a scheduled time.               | option  | -             | immediate      |

### Timing Options

| Option            | Description                                                                 |
|-------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| immediate         | Begin the upgrade immediately.                                             |
| scheduled         | Begin the upgrade at a configured time.                                    |

| Parameter        | Description                                           | Type    | Size          | Default        |

## Parameters

### vci-match
Enable/disable vendor class identifier (VCI) matching. When enabled, only DHCP requests with a matching VCI are served.

| Option  | Description                                           |
|---------|-------------------------------------------------------|
| disable | Disable VCI matching.                                 |
| enable  | Enable VCI matching.                                  |

### vci-string
One or more VCI strings in quotes separated by spaces.

- **Type**: string
- **Size**: Maximum length: 255

### wifi-ac-service
Options for assigning WiFi access controllers to DHCP clients.

| Option  | Description                                                                                     |
|---------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| specify | Specify up to 3 WiFi Access Controllers in the DHCP server configuration.                      |

### Command Syntax

To configure DNP3 proxy settings, use the following command:

```plaintext
config system dnp3-proxy
```

#### Parameters

- **Description**: Configure DNP3 proxy settings.
- **Commands**:
- `set port {integer}`
- `set status [enable|disable]`
- `set term-baudrate [9600|19200|...]`
- `set term-databits {integer}`
- `set term-flowcontrol [none|xon_xoff|...]`
- `set term-parity [none|odd|...]`
- `set term-stopbits {integer}`

```plaintext
end
```

### Parameter Details

| Parameter       | Description                                   | Type     | Size      | Default |
|------------------|-----------------------------------------------|----------|-----------|---------|
| port             | DNP3 TCPServer Port.                          | integer  | Minimum value: 1 | 20000   |
|                  |                                               |          | Maximum value: 65535 |         |
```

# FortiOS 7.4.5 CLI Reference

## Configuring DNS Databases

The following commands are used to configure DNS databases.

### Command Structure

```plaintext
config system dns-database
```

#### Description

Configure DNS databases.

### Edit DNS Database

```plaintext
edit <name>
```

#### Parameters

- `allow-transfer {user}`: DNS zone transfer IP address list.
- `authoritative [enable|disable]`: Enable or disable authoritative zone.
- `contact {string}`: Contact information for the DNS database.

### Configuring DNS Entries

```plaintext
config dns-entry
```

#### Description

DNS entry configuration.

### Edit DNS Entry

```plaintext
edit <id>
```

#### Parameters

- `canonical-name {string}`: The canonical name for the DNS entry.
- `hostname {string}`: The hostname associated with the DNS entry.
- `ip {ipv4-address-any}`: The IPv4 address for the DNS entry.
- `ipv6 {ipv6-address}`: The IPv6 address for the DNS entry.
- `preference {integer}`: Preference value for the DNS entry.
- `status [enable|disable]`: Enable or disable the DNS entry.
- `ttl {integer}`: Time to live for the DNS entry.
- `type [A|NS|...]`: Type of DNS record.

### Next and End Commands

```plaintext
next
end
```

### Additional Parameters for DNS Database

```plaintext
set domain {string}
set forwarder {user}
set forwarder6 {ipv6-address}
set ip-primary {ipv4-address-any}
set primary-name {string}
set rr-max {integer}
set source-ip {ipv4-address}
set source-ip6 {ipv6-address}
set status [enable|disable]
set ttl {integer}
set type [primary|secondary]
set view [shadow|public|...]
```

### DNS Database Parameters Overview

| Parameter        | Description                                   | Type   | Size          | Default      |
|------------------|-----------------------------------------------|--------|---------------|--------------|
| allow-transfer    | DNS zone transfer IP address list.           | user   | Not Specified |              |
| authoritative     | Enable/disable authoritative zone.           | option | -             | enable       |

#### Option Descriptions

- `enable`: Enable authoritative zone.
- `disable`: Disable authoritative zone.
```

#### Option Descriptions

| Option  | Description                                                        |

| enable  | Enable cache NOTFOUND responses from DNS server.                   |

## Email Server Configuration

To configure the email server settings, use the following commands:

```plaintext
set type {option}

### Parameters

| Parameter         | Description                                               | Type     | Size          | Default       | |
|-------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------|----------|---------------|---------------|---|
| authenticate      | Enable/disable authentication.                            | option   | -             | disable       | |
|                   | **Option**          | **Description**                       |          |               |               |
|                   | enable              | Enable authentication.               |          |               |               |
|                   | disable             | Disable authentication.              |          |               |               |
| interface         | Specify outgoing interface to reach server.              | string   | Maximum length: 15 |               | |
| interface-select-method | Specify how to select outgoing interface to reach server. | option   | -             | auto          | |
|                   | **Option**          | **Description**                       |          |               |               |
|                   | auto                | Set outgoing interface automatically. |          |               |               |
|                   | sdwan               | Set outgoing interface by SD-WAN or policy routing rules. |          |               |               |
|                   | specify             | Set outgoing interface manually.     |          |               |               |

|                   | none                | None.                                 |          |               |               |
|                   | starttls           | STARTTLS.                             |          |               |               |
|                   | smtps              | SSL/TLS.                             |          |               |               |
| server            | SMTP server IP address or hostname.                     | string   | Maximum length: 63 |               | |

## Configuration Commands

### External Resource Configuration

To configure an external resource, use the following commands:

Maximum value: 192 |               | | | | | |

| interface          | Specify outgoing interface to reach server.        | string      | Maximum length: 15 |               | |
| interface-select-method | Specify how to select outgoing interface to reach server. | option | - | auto          | |
|                    | Option          | Description                                   |             |               |               |

|                    | sdwan           | Set outgoing interface by SD-WAN or policy routing rules. | | |               |
|                    | specify         | Set outgoing interface manually.              |             |               |               |
| name               | External resource name.                           | string      | Maximum length: 35 |               | |
| password           | HTTP basic authentication password.               | password    | Not Specified |               | |

Maximum value: 43200 |               | | | | |

# FortiOS 7.4.5 CLI Reference

## Configuring System Fabric VPN

### Overview
Setup for self orchestrated fabric auto discovery VPN.

### Configuration Commands

```plaintext
config system fabric-vpn
Description: Setup for self orchestrated fabric auto discovery VPN.
```

#### Advertised Subnets

```plaintext
config advertised-subnets
Description: Local advertised subnets.
edit <id>
set access [inbound|bidirectional]
set bgp-network {integer}
set firewall-address {string}
set policies {integer}
set prefix {ipv4-classnet}
next
end
```

#### Main Configuration

```plaintext
set bgp-as {integer}
set branch-name {string}
set health-checks {string}
set loopback-address-block {ipv4-classnet-host}
set loopback-advertised-subnet {integer}
set loopback-interface {string}
```

#### Overlays Configuration

```plaintext
config overlays
Description: Local overlay interfaces table.
edit <name>
set bgp-neighbor {string}
set bgp-neighbor-group {string}
set bgp-neighbor-range {integer}
set bgp-network {integer}
set interface {string}
set ipsec-phase1 {string}
set overlay-policy {integer}
set overlay-tunnel-block {ipv4-classnet-host}
set remote-gw {ipv4-address-any}
set route-policy {integer}
set sdwan-member {integer}
next
end
```

#### Additional Settings

```plaintext
set policy-rule [health-check|manual|...]
set psksecret {password-3}
set sdwan-zone {string}
set status [enable|disable]
set sync-mode [enable|disable]
set vpn-role [hub|spoke]
```

# FortiOS 7.4.5 CLI Reference

## Configuration Commands

### config system federated-upgrade

Coordinate federated upgrades within the Security Fabric.

#### Parameters

| Parameter         | Description                                           | Type    | Size                     | Default | | |
|-------------------|-------------------------------------------------------|---------|--------------------------|---------|---|---|
| sdwan-member      | Reference to SD-WAN member entry.                    | integer | Minimum value: 0        |         | | |
|                   |                                                       |         | Maximum value: 4294967295|         | | |
| failure-device     | Serial number of the node to include.                | string  | Maximum length: 79      |         | | |
| failure-reason     | Reason for upgrade failure.                           | option  | -                        | none    | | |
| next-path-index    | Index for the next path.                             | integer |                          |         | | |
| source             | Source of the upgrade.                               | option  | [user|auto-firmware-upgrade] |     | |
| status             | Status of the upgrade.                               | option  | [disabled|initialized|...] |     |
| upgrade-id        | Unique identifier for the upgrade.                   | integer |                          |         | | |

#### Commands

```plaintext
set failure-device {string}
set failure-reason [none|internal|...]
set ha-reboot-controller {string}
```

##### config known-ha-members

Known members of the HA cluster. If a member is missing at upgrade time, the upgrade will be cancelled.

```plaintext
edit <serial>
next
end
```

##### config node-list

Nodes which will be included in the upgrade.

```plaintext
edit <serial>
set coordinating-fortigate {string}
set device-type [fortigate|fortiswitch|...]
set maximum-minutes {integer}
set setup-time {user}
set time {user}
set timing [immediate|scheduled]
set upgrade-path {user}
next
end
```

### End of Configuration

```plaintext
end
```

# FortiOS 7.4.5 CLI Reference

## Parameters

| Parameter                | Description                                                                 | Type     | Size                | Default   |
|--------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------|---------------------|-----------|
| none                     | No failure.                                                                |          |                     |           |
| internal                 | An internal error occurred.                                                |          |                     |           |
| timeout                  | The upgrade timed out.                                                    |          |                     |           |
| device-type-unsupported  | The device type was not supported by the FortiGate.                       |          |                     |           |
| download-failed          | The image could not be downloaded.                                        |          |                     |           |
| device-missing           | The device was disconnected from the FortiGate.                           |          |                     |           |
| version-unavailable      | An image matching the device and version could not be found.              |          |                     |           |
| staging-failed           | The image could not be pushed to the device.                              |          |                     |           |
| reboot-failed            | The device could not be rebooted.                                         |          |                     |           |
| device-not-reconnected   | The device did not reconnect after rebooting.                             |          |                     |           |
| node-not-ready           | A device in the Security Fabric tree was not ready.                      |          |                     |           |
| no-final-confirmation    | The coordinating FortiGate did not confirm the upgrade.                   |          |                     |           |
| no-confirmation-query    | A downstream FortiGate did not initiate final confirmation.               |          |                     |           |
| config-error-log-nonempty| Configuration errors encountered during the upgrade.                      |          |                     |           |
| csf-tree-not-supported   | The Security Fabric is disabled on the root FortiGate.                   |          |                     |           |
| node-failed              | A device in the Security Fabric tree failed.                              |          |                     |           |
| ha-reboot-controller      | Serial number of the FortiGate unit that will control the reboot process for the federated upgrade of the HA cluster. | string   | Maximum length: 79 |           |
| next-path-index          | The index of the next image to upgrade to.                                | integer  | Minimum value: 0    | Maximum value: 10 |
| source                   | Source that set up the federated upgrade config.                          | option   | -                   | user      |

# FortiOS 7.4.5 CLI Reference

## Upgrade Parameters

| Parameter          | Description                                                                 | Type     | Size                | Default  |
|--------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------|---------------------|----------|
| user               | Upgrade configured based on user input.                                    | option   | -                   |          |
| auto-firmware-upgrade | Upgrade configured by the FortiGuard auto-firmware-upgrade feature.      | option   | -                   |          |
| status             | Current status of the upgrade.                                             | option   | -                   | disabled |
| upgrade-id         | Unique identifier for this upgrade.                                        | integer  | Minimum value: 0    |          |
|                    |                                                                             |          | Maximum value: 4294967295 |          |

### Status Options

| Option             | Description                                                                 |
|--------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| disabled           | No federated upgrade has been configured.                                   |
| initialized        | The upgrade has been configured.                                            |
| downloading        | The image is downloading in preparation for the upgrade.                   |
| device-disconnected | The image downloads are complete, but one or more devices have disconnected.|
| ready              | The image download finished and the upgrade is pending.                    |
| coordinating       | The upgrade is coordinating with other running upgrades.                   |
| staging            | The upgrade is confirmed and images are being staged.                      |
| final-check        | The upgrade is ready and final checks are in progress.                     |
| upgrade-devices    | The upgrade is ready and devices are being rebooted.                      |
| cancelled          | The upgrade was cancelled due to the tree not being ready.                 |
| confirmed          | The upgrade was confirmed and reboots are running.                         |
| done               | The upgrade completed successfully.                                         |
| failed             | The upgrade failed due to a local issue.                                   |

## Config Known-HA-Members

| Parameter          | Description                                            | Type   | Size                | Default  |
|--------------------|-------------------------------------------------------|--------|---------------------|----------|
| serial             | Serial number of HA member                             | string | Maximum length: 79  |          |

## Automatic Firmware Upgrade Parameters

| Parameter                | Description                                                                 | Type    | Size   | Default |
|--------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|---------|--------|---------|
| auto-firmware-upgrade     | Enable/disable automatic patch-level firmware upgrade from FortiGuard. The FortiGate unit searches for new patches only in the same major and minor version. Enabled by default for entry-level FortiGates; see Automatic firmware updates. | option  | -      | enable  |
| auto-firmware-upgrade-day | Allowed day. Disallow any day of the week to use auto-firmware-upgrade-delay instead, which waits for designated days before installing an automatic patch-level firmware upgrade. | option  | -      | -       |
|                          | **Option**   | **Description**  | | |
|                          | sunday       | Sunday.         | | |
|                          | monday       | Monday.         | | |
|                          | tuesday      | Tuesday.        | | |
|                          | wednesday    | Wednesday.      | | |
|                          | thursday     | Thursday.       | | |
|                          | friday       | Friday.         | | |
|                          | saturday     | Saturday.       | | |
| auto-firmware-upgrade-delay | Delay of day of the week for installing an automatic patch-level firmware upgrade. | integer | Minimum value: 0 | Maximum value: 14 |
| auto-firmware-upgrade-end-hour | End time in the designated time window for automatic patch-level firmware upgrade from FortiGuard in 24 hour time. When the end time is smaller than the start time, the end time is interpreted as the next day. The actual upgrade time is selected randomly within the time window. | integer | Minimum value: 0 | Maximum value: 23 |
| auto-firmware-upgrade-start-hour | Start time in the designated time window for automatic patch-level firmware upgrade from FortiGuard in 24 hour time. The actual upgrade time is selected randomly within the time window. | integer | Minimum value: 0 | Maximum value: 23 |
```

### Command Syntax

To configure the Gi Firewall Gatekeeper, use the following command:

```plaintext
config system gi-gk
```

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Description                                          | Type    | Size     | Default |
|-----------|------------------------------------------------------|---------|----------|---------|
| context   | Context ID                                           | integer | Minimum value: 0
Maximum value: 4294967295 | 696     |
| port      | UDP port to listen, range 0-65535.                  | integer | Minimum value: 0
Maximum value: 65535 | 21123   |

### Example Configuration

```plaintext
config system gi-gk
set context {integer}
set port {integer}
end
```

This concludes the configuration for the Gi Firewall Gatekeeper in FortiOS 7.4.5.

```markdown
# FortiOS 7.4.5 CLI Reference

## Parameters

### admin-https-ssl-ciphersuites
Select one or more TLS 1.3 ciphersuites to enable. Does not affect ciphers in TLS 1.2 and below. At least one must be enabled. To disable all, remove TLS1.3 from `admin-https-ssl-versions`.

| Option                  | Description                                                  |
|-------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------|
| TLS-AES-128-GCM-SHA256  | Enable TLS-AES-128-GCM-SHA256 in TLS 1.3.                  |
| TLS-AES-256-GCM-SHA384  | Enable TLS-AES-256-GCM-SHA384 in TLS 1.3.                  |
| TLS-CHACHA20-POLY1305-SHA256 | Enable TLS-CHACHA20-POLY1305-SHA256 in TLS 1.3.        |
| TLS-AES-128-CCM-SHA256  | Enable TLS-AES-128-CCM-SHA256 in TLS 1.3.                  |
| TLS-AES-128-CCM-8-SHA256 | Enable TLS-AES-128-CCM-8-SHA256 in TLS 1.3.               |

### admin-https-ssl-versions
Allowed TLS versions for web administration.

| Option   | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| tlsv1-1  | TLS 1.1.   |
| tlsv1-2  | TLS 1.2.   |
| tlsv1-3  | TLS 1.3.   |

### admin-lockout-duration
Amount of time in seconds that an administrator account is locked out after reaching the `admin-lockout-threshold` for repeated failed login attempts.

- **Type:** integer
- **Minimum value:** 1
- **Maximum value:** 2147483647
- **Default:** 60

### admin-lockout-threshold
Number of failed login attempts before an administrator account is locked out for the `admin-lockout-duration`.

- **Type:** integer
- **Minimum value:** 1
- **Maximum value:** 10
- **Default:** 3
```

# FortiOS 7.4.5 CLI Reference

## Parameters

| Parameter                     | Description                                                  | Type    | Size   | Default  |
|-------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------|---------|--------|----------|
| fortiextender-discovery-lockdown | Enable/disable FortiExtender CAPWAP lockdown.              | option  | -      | disable  |

| fortiextender-vlan-mode *    | Enable/disable FortiExtender VLAN mode.                     | option  | -      | disable  |
| fortigslb-integration         | Enable/disable integration with the FortiGSLB cloud service. | option  | -      | disable  |
| fortiservice-port             | FortiService port. Used by FortiClient endpoint compliance. Older versions of FortiClient used a different port. | integer | Minimum value: 1 | 8013 |
|                               |                                                              |         | Maximum value: 65535 |          |
| fortitoken-cloud              | Enable/disable FortiToken Cloud service.                     | option  | -      | enable   |

### Option Descriptions

#### fortiextender-discovery-lockdown
- **disable**: Unlock down new FortiExtender device discovery.
- **enable**: Lock down new FortiExtender device discovery.

#### fortiextender-provision-on-authorization
- **enable**: Enable FortiExtender firmware provision on authorization.
- **disable**: Disable FortiExtender firmware provision on authorization.

#### fortiextender-vlan-mode
- **enable**: Enable FortiExtender VLAN mode.
- **disable**: Disable FortiExtender VLAN mode.

#### fortigslb-integration
- **disable**: Disable VIP and ZTNA server integration with the FortiGSLB cloud service.
- **enable**: Enable VIP and ZTNA server integration with the FortiGSLB cloud service.

#### fortitoken-cloud
- **enable**: Enable FortiToken Cloud service.
- **disable**: Disable FortiToken Cloud service.
```

### config system gre-tunnel

Configure GRE tunnel.

- **edit \<name>**:

- `set key-outbound {integer}`
- `set local-gw {ipv4-address-any}`
- `set local-gw6 {ipv6-address}`
- `set remote-gw {ipv4-address}`
- `set remote-gw6 {ipv6-address}`
- `set sequence-number-reception [disable|enable]`
- `set sequence-number-transmission [disable|enable]`
- `set use-sdwan [disable|enable]`
- **next**
- **end**

```markdown
# FortiOS 7.4.5 CLI Reference

## GRE Tunnel Configuration

The following parameters can be configured for GRE tunnels:

| Parameter            | Description                                            | Type   | Size             | Default  |
|----------------------|-------------------------------------------------------|--------|------------------|----------|
| auto-asic-offload    | Enable/disable automatic ASIC offloading.            | option | -                | enable   |
| checksum-reception    | Enable/disable validating checksums in received GRE packets. | option | -                | disable  |
| checksum-transmission | Enable/disable including checksums in transmitted GRE packets. | option | -                | disable  |
| diffservcode         | DiffServ setting to be applied to GRE tunnel outer IP header. | user   | Not Specified    |          |
| dscp-copying         | Enable/disable DSCP copying.                         | option | -                | disable  |
| interface            | Interface name.                                      | string | Maximum length: 15 |          |
| ip-version           | IP version to use for VPN interface.                 | option | -                | 4        |

### Options for Parameters

#### auto-asic-offload
| Option   | Description                                   |
|----------|-----------------------------------------------|
| enable   | Enable automatic ASIC offloading.            |
| disable  | Disable automatic ASIC offloading.           |

#### checksum-reception
| Option   | Description                                   |
|----------|-----------------------------------------------|
| enable   | Validate checksums in received GRE packets.  |
| disable  | Do not validate checksums in received GRE packets. |

#### checksum-transmission
| Option   | Description                                   |
|----------|-----------------------------------------------|
| enable   | Include checksums in transmitted GRE packets.|
| disable  | Do not include checksums in transmitted GRE packets. |

#### dscp-copying
| Option   | Description                                   |
|----------|-----------------------------------------------|
| enable   | Enable DSCP copying.                          |
| disable  | Disable DSCP copying.                         |

#### ip-version
| Option | Description                                   |
|--------|-----------------------------------------------|
| 4      | Use IPv4 addressing for gateways.            |
| 6      | Use IPv6 addressing for gateways.            |
```

### Parameters

| Parameter            | Description                                             | Type    | Size   | Default |

|                      | Hellman group (per-worker).                            |         | value: 0|         |
|                      |                                                      |         | Maximum| 50000   |
| dh-keypair-throttle  | Enable/disable Diffie-Hellman key pair cache CPU      | option  | -      | enable  |
|                      | throttling.                                           |         |        |         |
|                      | **Options**                                            |         |        |         |
|                      | enable - Enable Diffie-Hellman key pair cache CPU    |         |        |         |
|                      | throttling.                                          |         |        |         |
|                      | disable - Disable Diffie-Hellman key pair cache CPU  |         |        |         |
|                      | throttling.                                          |         |        |         |
| dh-mode              | Use software (CPU) or hardware (CPX) to perform       | option  | -      | hardware ** |
|                      | Diffie-Hellman calculations.                          |         |        |         |
|                      | **Options**                                            |         |        |         |
|                      | software - Prefer CPU to perform Diffie-Hellman      |         |        |         |
|                      | calculations.                                        |         |        |         |
|                      | hardware - Prefer CPX to perform Diffie-Hellman      |         |        |         |
|                      | calculations.                                        |         |        |         |

|                      |                                                      |         | value: 1|         |
|                      |                                                      |         | Maximum| 8 **    |

|                      |                                                      |         | Maximum| 20000   |

| Option   | Description                                                  |
|----------|--------------------------------------------------------------|
| global   | Use global Diffie-Hellman key pair cache setting.           |
| custom   | Use custom Diffie-Hellman key pair cache setting.           |

| Parameter        | Description                                                       | Type    | Size    | Default       |
|------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------|---------|---------|---------------|
| keypair-count    | Number of key pairs to pre-generate for this Diffie-Hellman group (per-worker). | integer | Minimum | 0             |
|                  |                                                                   |         | Maximum | 50000         |
| mode             | Use software (CPU) or hardware (CPX) to perform calculations for this Diffie-Hellman group. | option  | -       | global        |

#### Mode Options

| Option   | Description                                                  |
|----------|--------------------------------------------------------------|
| software | Prefer CPU to perform Diffie-Hellman calculations.          |
| hardware | Prefer CPX to perform Diffie-Hellman calculations.          |
| global   | Use global dh-mode setting.                                  |
```

```markdown
# FortiOS 7.4.5 CLI Reference

## Configuring IP Address Management (IPAM)

### Command Overview
The `config system ipam` command is used to configure IP address management services.

### Configuration Steps

#### 1. Configure IPAM
```plaintext
config system ipam
```
- **Description**: Configure IP address management services.

#### 2. Set Parameters
```plaintext
set automatic-conflict-resolution [disable|enable]
set manage-lan-addresses [disable|enable]
set manage-lan-extension-addresses [disable|enable]
set manage-ssid-addresses [disable|enable]
```

#### 3. Configure Pools
```plaintext
config pools
```
- **Description**: Configure IPAM pools.

##### Edit Pool
```plaintext
edit <name>
```
- **Set Description**:
```plaintext
set description {string}
```

###### Configure Exclude
```plaintext
config exclude
```
- **Description**: Configure pool exclude subnets.

###### Edit Exclude Subnet
```plaintext
edit <ID>
set exclude-subnet {ipv4-classnet}
next
end
```

- **Set Subnet**:
```plaintext
set subnet {ipv4-classnet}
```
- **Next Pool**:
```plaintext
next
end
```

#### 4. Additional Parameters
```plaintext
set require-subnet-size-match [disable|enable]
```

### Configure Rules
```plaintext
config rules
```
- **Description**: Configure IPAM allocation rules.

#### Edit Rule
```plaintext
edit <name>
```
- **Set Description**:
```plaintext
set description {string}
```
- **Set Device**:
```plaintext
set device <name1>, <name2>, ...
```
- **Set DHCP**:
```plaintext
set dhcp [enable|disable]
```
- **Set Interface**:
```plaintext
set interface <name1>, <name2>, ...
```
- **Set Pool**:
```plaintext
set pool <name1>, <name2>, ...
```
- **Set Role**:
```plaintext
set role [any|lan|...]
```
- **Next Rule**:
```plaintext
next
end
```

### Server Type and Status
```plaintext
set server-type {option}
set status [enable|disable]
end
```

### Parameter Descriptions
| Parameter                       | Description                                    | Type   | Size | Default |
|---------------------------------|------------------------------------------------|--------|------|---------|
| automatic-conflict-resolution    | Enable/disable automatic conflict resolution.  | option | -    | disable |

#### Options for Automatic Conflict Resolution
| Option   | Description                               |
|----------|-------------------------------------------|
| disable  | Disable automatic conflict resolution.     |
| enable   | Enable automatic conflict resolution.      |
```

## Configuration Commands

### `config system ipip-tunnel`

Configure IP in IP Tunneling.

```plaintext
config system ipip-tunnel
Description: Configure IP in IP Tunneling.
edit <name>
set auto-asic-offload [enable|disable]
set interface {string}
set local-gw {ipv4-address-any}
set remote-gw {ipv4-address}
set use-sdwan [disable|enable]
next
end
```

### Parameters for `config system ipip-tunnel`

| Parameter          | Description                                          | Type         | Size                | Default          |
|--------------------|------------------------------------------------------|--------------|---------------------|------------------|
| auto-asic-offload  | Enable/disable tunnel ASIC offloading.               | option       | -                   | enable           |

#### Auto ASIC Offload Options

| Option   | Description                        |
|----------|------------------------------------|
| enable   | Enable auto ASIC offloading.      |
| disable  | Disable ASIC offloading.          |

| Parameter      | Description                                          | Type         | Size                | Default          |
|----------------|------------------------------------------------------|--------------|---------------------|------------------|

Configure an aggregate of IPsec tunnels.

next

#### Options

| Option              | Description                                           |
|---------------------|-------------------------------------------------------|
| L3                  | Use layer 3 address for distribution.                 |
| L4                  | Use layer 4 information for distribution.             |

# FortiOS 7.4.5 CLI Reference

## Parameters

### burst-bps-granularity
Burst granularity based on bytes per second.

| Option       | Description                          | Type   | Size | Default  |
|--------------|--------------------------------------|--------|------|----------|
| disable      | Disable burst control.               | option | -    | disable  |
| 512-bytes    | 512 bytes.                           | option | -    |          |
| 1k-bytes     | 1K bytes.                           | option | -    |          |
| 2k-bytes     | 2K bytes.                           | option | -    |          |
| 4k-bytes     | 4K bytes.                           | option | -    |          |
| 8k-bytes     | 8K bytes.                           | option | -    |          |
| 16k-bytes    | 16K bytes.                          | option | -    |          |
| 32k-bytes    | 32K bytes.                          | option | -    |          |

### burst-pps-granularity
Burst granularity based on packets per second.

| Option       | Description                          | Type   | Size | Default  |
|--------------|--------------------------------------|--------|------|----------|
| disable      | Disable burst control.               | option | -    | disable  |
| half-packet  | One burst unit equals two time slots in which one packet is sent. | option | - |          |
| 1-packet     | 1 packet.                            | option | -    |          |
| 2-packets    | 2 packets.                           | option | -    |          |
| 4-packets    | 4 packets.                           | option | -    |          |
| 16-packets   | 16 packets.                          | option | -    |          |
| 65-packets   | 65 packets.                          | option | -    |          |
| 262-packets  | 262 packets.                         | option | -    |          |

### guaranteed-bandwidth
Guaranteed bandwidth.

| Parameter    | Description                          | Type    | Size        | Default |
|--------------|--------------------------------------|---------|-------------|---------|
| integer      | Minimum value: 0                     | integer | Minimum     | 0       |
|              | Maximum value: 1000000000            | integer | Maximum     |         |
```

## Link Health Monitor Configuration

### Parameters

| Parameter        | Description                                   | Type    | Size                | Default                |

### Command Structure

To configure the Link Health Monitor, use the following command structure:

```plaintext
config system link-monitor
```

#### Description

Configure Link Health Monitor.

```plaintext
config system link-monitor
edit <name>
set addr-mode [ipv4|ipv6]
set class-id {integer}
set diffservcode {user}
set fail-weight  {integer}
set failtime {integer}
set gateway-ip  {ipv4-address-any}
set gateway-ip6  {ipv6-address}
set ha-priority  {integer}
set http-agent  {string}
set http-get {string}
set http-match  {string}
set interval {integer}
set packet-size  {integer}
set password {password}
set port {integer}
set probe-count  {integer}
set probe-timeout {integer}
set protocol {option1}, {option2}, ...
set recoverytime {integer}
set route <subnet1>, <subnet2>, ...
set security-mode [none|authentication]
set server <address1>, <address2>, ...
set server-config [default|individual]
config server-list
edit <id>
set dst   {string}
set port {integer}
set protocol  {option1}, {option2}, ...
set weight  {integer}
next
end
set server-type  [static|dynamic]
set service-detection [enable|disable]
set source-ip {ipv4-address-any}
set source-ip6 {ipv6-address}
```

# FortiOS 7.4.5 CLI Reference

## Configuring System Link Monitor

To configure the system link monitor, use the following commands:

```plaintext
set srcintf {string}
set status [enable|disable]
set update-cascade-interface [enable|disable]
set update-policy-route [enable|disable]
set update-static-route [enable|disable]
next
end
```

## Parameters Description

| Parameter                | Description                                                        | Type          | Size             | Default       |
|--------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------|---------------|------------------|---------------|
| addr-mode                | Address mode (IPv4 or IPv6).                                      | option        | -                | ipv4          |
|                          | **Option**                                                        |               |                  |               |
|                          | ipv4 - IPv4 mode.                                                |               |                  |               |
|                          | ipv6 - IPv6 mode.                                                |               |                  |               |
| class-id                 | Traffic class ID.                                                 | integer       | Minimum value: 0 | 0             |
|                          | Maximum value: 4294967295                                         |               |                  |               |
| diffservcode             | Differentiated services code point (DSCP) in the IP header of the probe packet. | user          | Not Specified    |               |
| fail-weight              | Threshold weight to trigger link failure alert.                   | integer       | Minimum value: 0 | 0             |
|                          | Maximum value: 255                                               |               |                  |               |
| failtime                 | Number of retry attempts before the server is considered down.    | integer       | Minimum value: 1 | 5             |
|                          | Maximum value: 3600                                              |               |                  |               |
| gateway-ip               | Gateway IP address used to probe the server.                      | ipv4-address  | Not Specified    | 0.0.0.0      |
| gateway-ip6              | Gateway IPv6 address used to probe the server.                    | ipv6-address  | Not Specified    | ::            |
| ha-priority              | HA election priority.                                             | integer       | Minimum value: 1 | 1             |
|                          | Maximum value: 50                                                |               |                  |               |
| http-agent               | String in the http-agent field in the HTTP header.                | string        | Maximum length: 1024 | Chrome/Safari |
```

set priority {integer}
set status [disable|enable]

set vlan {integer}

### Configure USB LTE/WIMAX devices

```plaintext
config system lte-modem
Description: Configure USB LTE/WIMAX devices.
set allow-modify-mtu-size [enable|disable]
set allow-modify-wireless-profile-table [enable|disable]
set apn {string}
set authtype [none|pap|...]
set auto-connect [enable|disable]
set band-restrictions {string}
config data-plan
Description: Configure data plan.
edit <name>
set billing-date {integer}
set billing-hour {integer}
set billing-period [monthly|weekly|...]
set billing-weekday [sunday|monday|...]
set data-limit {integer}
set data-limit-alert {integer}
set delay-switch-time {string}
set iccid {string}
set overage [enable|disable]
set target-sim-slot [SIM-slot-1|SIM-slot-2]
next
end
```

set link-monitor {string}

## System LTE Modem Configuration
```plaintext
config system lte-modem
```

| Parameter            | Description                                                  | Type   | Size | Default | |
|----------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------|--------|------|---------|---|
| allow-modify-        | Allow FortiGate to modify the wireless WAN interface         | option | -    | enable  | |
| mtu-size *           | MTU size.                                                   |        |      |         | |
|                      | Option     | Description                                   |        |      |         |
|                      | enable     | Allow LTE daemon to modify wireless profile table. |        |      |         |
|                      | disable    | Do not allow LTE daemon to modify wireless profile table. |        |      |         |
| allow-modify-        | Allow FortiGate to modify the wireless profile table if    | option | -    | enable  | |
| wireless-            | the internal LTE modem is running the GENERIC modem firmware. |        |      |         | |
| profile-table *      | Option     | Description                                   |        |      |         |
|                      | enable     | Allow LTE daemon to modify wireless profile table. |        |      |         |
```

- **Size**:
- Minimum value: 1
- Maximum value: 31

### billing-hour
- **Description**: LTE MODEM billing hour.
- **Type**: integer
- **Size**:
- Minimum value: 0
- Maximum value: 23

### billing-period
- **Description**: <MONTH, WEEK, DAY>
- **Type**: option

| Option   | Description  |

| monthly  | 1-31 (day)   |
| weekly   | Mon to Sun   |
| daily    | 1-24 (hour)  |

### billing-weekday
- **Description**: LTE MODEM billing weekday (Mon - Sun).
- **Type**: option
- **Size**: -

#### Options
| Option   | Description  |
|----------|--------------|
| sunday   | Sunday       |
| monday   | Monday       |
| tuesday  | Tuesday      |

## Configuration Commands

### config system mac-address-table
Configure MAC address tables.

```plaintext
config system mac-address-table
Description: Configure MAC address tables.
edit <mac>
set interface {string}
set reply-substitute {mac-address}
next
end
```

#### Parameters
| Parameter   | Description                             | Type   | Size                | Default                |
|-------------|-----------------------------------------|--------|---------------------|------------------------|
| interface   | Interface name.                         | string | Maximum length: 35  |                        |
| mac         | MAC address.                            | mac-   | Not Specified       | 00:00:00:00:00:00      |
|             | address                                 |        |                     |                        |
| reply-      | New MAC for reply traffic.             | mac-   | Not Specified       | 00:00:00:00:00:00      |
| substitute  | address                                 |        |                     |                        |

### config system management-tunnel
Management tunnel configuration.

```plaintext
config system management-tunnel
Description: Management tunnel configuration.
set allow-collect-statistics [enable|disable]
set allow-config-restore [enable|disable]
set allow-push-configuration [enable|disable]
set allow-push-firmware [enable|disable]
set authorized-manager-only [enable|disable]
set serial-number {user}
```
```

## Configuration Commands

### Management Tunnel Configuration

To set the status of the management tunnel, use the following command:

```plaintext
set status [enable|disable]
end
```

### Parameters

| Parameter                | Description                                             | Type   | Size | Default |
|--------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------|--------|------|---------|
| allow-collect-statistics  | Enable/disable collection of run time statistics.     | option | -    | enable  |
| allow-config-restore      | Enable/disable allow config restore.                  | option | -    | enable  |
| allow-push-configuration   | Enable/disable push configuration.                    | option | -    | enable  |
| allow-push-firmware       | Enable/disable push firmware.                         | option | -    | enable  |
| authorized-manager-only    | Enable/disable restriction of authorized manager only.| option | -    | enable  |
| serial-number             | Serial number.                                        | user   | Not  | Specified |

### Options

#### allow-collect-statistics
- **enable**: Enable collection of run time statistics.
- **disable**: Disable collection of run time statistics.

#### allow-config-restore
- **enable**: Enable allow config restore.
- **disable**: Disable allow config restore.

#### allow-push-configuration
- **enable**: Enable push configuration.
- **disable**: Disable push configuration.

#### allow-push-firmware
- **enable**: Enable push firmware.
- **disable**: Disable push firmware.

#### authorized-manager-only
- **enable**: Enable restriction of authorized manager only.
- **disable**: Disable restriction of authorized manager only.

# FortiOS 7.4.5 CLI Reference

## Mobile Tunnel Configuration

### Parameter Description

| Parameter | Description                                   | Type   | Size | Default |
|-----------|-----------------------------------------------|--------|------|---------|
| status    | Enable/disable FGFM tunnel.                   | option | -    | enable  |

#### Option Descriptions

| Option   | Description                        |
|----------|------------------------------------|
| enable   | Enable management tunnel.          |
| disable  | Disable management tunnel.         |

### Command Structure

```plaintext
config system mobile-tunnel
Configure Mobile tunnels, an implementation of Network Mobility (NEMO) extensions for Mobile IPv4 RFC5177.
config system mobile-tunnel
Description: Configure Mobile tunnels, an implementation of Network Mobility (NEMO) extensions for Mobile IPv4 RFC5177.
edit <name>
set hash-algorithm {option}
set home-address {ipv4-address}
set home-agent {ipv4-address}
set lifetime {integer}
set n-mhae-key {password_aes256}
set n-mhae-key-type [ascii|base64]
set n-mhae-spi {integer}
config network
Description: NEMO network configuration.
edit <id>
set interface {string}
set prefix {ipv4-classnet}
next
end
set reg-interval {integer}
set reg-retry {integer}
set renew-interval {integer}
set roaming-interface {string}
set status [disable|enable]
set tunnel-mode {option}
next
end
```

### Additional Parameters

| Parameter         | Description                          | Type   | Size | Default   |
|-------------------|--------------------------------------|--------|------|-----------|
| hash-algorithm    | Hash Algorithm (Keyed MD5).         | option | -    | hmac-md5  |

#### Hash Algorithm Options

| Option   | Description  |
|----------|--------------|
| hmac-md5 | Keyed MD5.   |
```

- **set extra-init3**: `{string}`

- **set idle-timer**: `{integer}`
- **set interface**: `{string}`

# FortiOS 7.4.5 CLI Reference

## Configuring NetFlow

### Command Overview
The following commands are used to configure NetFlow on the system.

```plaintext
config system netflow
Configure NetFlow.
```

### Configuration Steps

1. **Enter NetFlow Configuration Mode**
```plaintext
config system netflow
```

2. **Set Active Flow Timeout**
```plaintext
set active-flow-timeout {integer}
```

3. **Configure Collectors**
```plaintext
config collectors
Description: Netflow collectors.
edit <id>
set collector-ip {string}
set collector-port {integer}
set interface {string}
set interface-select-method [auto|sdwan|...]
set source-ip {string}
next
end
```

4. **Set Inactive Flow Timeout**
```plaintext
set inactive-flow-timeout {integer}
```

5. **Set Template Transmission Parameters**
```plaintext
set template-tx-counter {integer}
set template-tx-timeout {integer}
end
```

### Parameters Description

| Parameter              | Description                                             | Type     | Size     | Default   |
|------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------|----------|----------|-----------|
| active-flow-timeout    | Timeout to report active flows.                         | integer  | Minimum  | 1800      |
|                        |                                                         |          | value: 60| Maximum   |
|                        |                                                         |          | value: 3600|          |
| inactive-flow-timeout  | Timeout for periodic report of finished flows.          | integer  | Minimum  | 15        |
|                        |                                                         |          | value: 10| Maximum   |
|                        |                                                         |          | value: 600|          |
| template-tx-counter    | Counter of flowset records before resending a template  | integer  | Minimum  | 20        |
|                        | flowset record.                                        |          | value: 10| Maximum   |
|                        |                                                         |          | value: 6000|         |
| template-tx-timeout    | Timeout for periodic template flowset transmission.     | integer  | Minimum  | 1800      |
|                        |                                                         |          | value: 60| Maximum   |
|                        |                                                         |          | value: 86400|        |
```

# FortiOS 7.4.5 CLI Reference

## ICMP Anomalies

### icmp-invalid-checksum
Layer 3 invalid ICMP checksum anomalies.

| Option          | Description                                               | Type   | Size | Default       |
|-----------------|-----------------------------------------------------------|--------|------|---------------|
| drop            | Drop IPv4 invalid ICMP checksum.                          | option | -    |               |
| trap-to-host    | Forward IPv4 invalid ICMP checksum to main CPU for processing. | option | -    |               |

### icmp-frag
Layer 3 fragmented packets that could be part of layer 4 ICMP anomalies.

| Option          | Description                                               | Type   | Size | Default       |
|-----------------|-----------------------------------------------------------|--------|------|---------------|
| allow           | Allow L3 fragment packet with L4 protocol as ICMP attack to pass. | option | -    | allow         |
| drop            | Drop L3 fragment packet with L4 protocol as ICMP attack. | option | -    |               |
| trap-to-host    | Forward L3 fragment packet with L4 protocol as ICMP attack to FortiOS. | option | -    |               |

### icmp-land
ICMP land anomalies.

| Option          | Description                                               | Type   | Size | Default       |
|-----------------|-----------------------------------------------------------|--------|------|---------------|
| allow           | Allow ICMP land attack to pass.                           | option | -    |               |
| drop            | Drop ICMP land attack.                                   | option | -    |               |
| trap-to-host    | Forward ICMP land attack to FortiOS.                     | option | -    | trap-to-host  |

## IPv4 Anomalies

### ipv4-csum-err
Invalid IPv4 IP checksum anomalies.

| Option          | Description                                               | Type   | Size | Default       |
|-----------------|-----------------------------------------------------------|--------|------|---------------|
| drop            | Drop IPv4 invalid IP checksum.                            | option | -    |               |
| trap-to-host    | Forward IPv4 invalid IP checksum to main CPU for processing. | option | -    |               |

### ipv4-land
Land anomalies.

| Option          | Description                                               | Type   | Size | Default       |
|-----------------|-----------------------------------------------------------|--------|------|---------------|
| allow           | Allow IPv4 land attack to pass.                           | option | -    |               |
| drop            | Drop IPv4 land attack.                                   | option | -    |               |
| trap-to-host    | Forward IPv4 land attack to FortiOS.                     | option | -    | trap-to-host  |

### ipv4-optlsrr
Loose source record route option anomalies.

| Option          | Description                                               | Type   | Size | Default       |
|-----------------|-----------------------------------------------------------|--------|------|---------------|
| allow           | Allow IPv4 with loose source record route option to pass. | option | -    |               |
| drop            | Drop IPv4 with loose source record route option.         | option | -    |               |
| trap-to-host    | Forward IPv4 with loose source record route option to FortiOS. | option | -    | trap-to-host  |
```

```markdown
# NP6XLITE Configuration

## Description
Configure NP6XLITE attributes.

### Edit Command
```plaintext
edit <name>
```

### Congestion Handling Mode
```plaintext
set congestion-handling-mode [flow-control|head-of-line]
```

### Fastpath Configuration
```plaintext
set fastpath [disable|enable]
```

## FP Anomaly Configuration
### Description
NP6XLITE IPv4 anomaly protection. The trap-to-host forwards anomaly sessions to the CPU.

```plaintext
config fp-anomaly
```

#### ICMP Configuration
```plaintext
set icmp-csum-err [drop|trap-to-host]
set icmp-frag [allow|drop|...]
set icmp-land [allow|drop|...]
```

#### IPv4 Configuration
```plaintext
set ipv4-csum-err [drop|trap-to-host]
set ipv4-land [allow|drop|...]
set ipv4-optlsrr [allow|drop|...]
set ipv4-optrr [allow|drop|...]
set ipv4-optsecurity [allow|drop|...]
set ipv4-optssrr [allow|drop|...]
set ipv4-optstream [allow|drop|...]
set ipv4-opttimestamp [allow|drop|...]
set ipv4-proto-err [allow|drop|...]
set ipv4-unknopt [allow|drop|...]
```

#### IPv6 Configuration
```plaintext
set ipv6-daddr-err [allow|drop|...]
set ipv6-land [allow|drop|...]
set ipv6-optendpid [allow|drop|...]
set ipv6-opthomeaddr [allow|drop|...]
set ipv6-optinvld [allow|drop|...]
set ipv6-optjumbo [allow|drop|...]
set ipv6-optnsap [allow|drop|...]
set ipv6-optralert [allow|drop|...]
set ipv6-opttunnel [allow|drop|...]
set ipv6-proto-err [allow|drop|...]
set ipv6-saddr-err [allow|drop|...]
set ipv6-unknopt [allow|drop|...]
```

#### TCP Configuration
```plaintext
set tcp-csum-err [drop|trap-to-host]
set tcp-fin-noack [allow|drop|...]
set tcp-fin-only [allow|drop|...]
set tcp-land [allow|drop|...]
set tcp-no-flag [allow|drop|...]
set tcp-syn-data [allow|drop|...]
set tcp-syn-fin [allow|drop|...]
set tcp-winnuke [allow|drop|...]
```

#### UDP Configuration
```plaintext
set udp-csum-err [drop|trap-to-host]
set udp-land [allow|drop|...]
```

### Garbage Session Collector
```plaintext
set garbage-session-collector [disable|enable]
```

## HPE Configuration
### Description
HPE configuration.

```plaintext
config hpe
```

#### HPE Settings
```plaintext
set arp-max {integer}
set enable-shaper [disable|enable]
set esp-max {integer}
set icmp-max {integer}
set ip-frag-max {integer}
set ip-others-max {integer}
set l2-others-max {integer}
set pri-type-max {integer}
set sctp-max {integer}
```
```

```markdown
# FortiOS 7.4.5 CLI Reference

## Configuration Commands

### System NP6XLite Configuration

```plaintext
set tcp-others-max {integer}
set tcpfin-rst-max {integer}
set tcpsyn-ack-max {integer}
set tcpsyn-max {integer}
set udp-max {integer}
end
set ipsec-inner-fragment [disable|enable]
set ipsec-sts-timeout [1|2|...]
set ipsec-throughput-msg-frequency [disable|32kb|...]
set per-session-accounting [disable|traffic-log-only|...]
set session-collector-interval {integer}
set session-timeout-fixed [disable|enable]
set session-timeout-interval {integer}
set session-timeout-random-range {integer}
next
end
```

### Parameters

| Parameter                | Description                                           | Type   | Size | Default          |
|--------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------|--------|------|------------------|
| congestion-handling-mode | Configure Marvell switch packet congestion handling.  | option | -    | head-of-line     |

#### Options for Congestion Handling Mode

| Option         | Description                                                        |
|----------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------|
| flow-control    | Pause peer sending additional traffic until congestion is resolved. |
| head-of-line    | Drop excessive traffic until congestion is resolved.                |

| Parameter                | Description                                           | Type   | Size | Default          |
|--------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------|--------|------|------------------|
| fastpath                 | Enable/disable NP6XLITE offloading (also called fast path). | option | -    | enable           |

#### Options for Fastpath

| Option         | Description                                                        |
|----------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------|
| disable        | Disable NP6XLITE offloading (fast path).                           |
| enable         | Enable NP6XLITE offloading (fast path).                            |

| Parameter                | Description                                           | Type   | Size | Default          |
|--------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------|--------|------|------------------|
| garbage-session-collector | Enable/disable garbage session collector.             | option | -    | disable          |

#### Options for Garbage Session Collector

| Option         | Description                                                        |
|----------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------|
| disable        | Disable garbage session collector.                                 |
| enable         | Enable garbage session collector.                                  |

| Parameter                | Description                                           | Type   | Size | Default          |
|--------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------|--------|------|------------------|
| ipsec-inner-fragment     | Enable/disable NP6XLite IPsec fragmentation type: inner. | option | -    | disable          |
```

config system npu-post
```

#### Description

Configure NPU attributes after interface initialization.

### Parameters

| Parameter                     | Description                                                                 | Type    | Size         | Default Value |
|-------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|---------|--------------|---------------|
| npu-group-effective-scope     | Defines under which npu-group commands such as list/purge will be executed. Default scope is for all four HS-ok groups. | integer | Minimum: 0   | Maximum: 255  |

### Configuration Example

```plaintext
config system npu-post
set npu-group-effective-scope {integer}
config port-npu-map
edit <interface>
set npu-group <group-name1>, <group-name2>, ...
next
end
end
```

This concludes the configuration details for the NPU post settings in FortiOS 7.4.5.

set dscp9   [queue0|queue1|...]
set type    [cos|dscp]
```

### Parameters

- **dscpX**: Represents the DSCP value for the specified queue.
- **queueX**: Indicates the queue number (e.g., queue0, queue1).
- **type**: Specifies the type of configuration, which can be either `cos` or `dscp`.

## Notes

- Ensure that the correct queue numbers and DSCP values are used to avoid misconfiguration.
- Refer to the FortiOS documentation for additional details on DSCP and queue management.

## Configuration Commands

set tpeid-v [enable|disable]

### End Command

```plaintext
end
```

### Type Command

```plaintext
set type [L2_src_tc|L2_tgt_tc|...]

```

### Next Command

```plaintext
next
```

### Per-Policy Accounting

```plaintext
set per-policy-accounting [disable|enable]
```

### Per-Session Accounting

```plaintext
set per-session-accounting [traffic-log-only|disable|...]
```

## Port Configuration

### Port CPU Map

#### Description

Configure NPU interface to CPU core mapping.

```plaintext
config port-cpu-map
edit <interface>
set cpu-core {string}
next
end
```

### Port NPU Map

#### Description

Configure port to NPU group mapping.

```plaintext
config port-npu-map
edit <interface>
set npu-group-index {integer}
next
end
```

### Port Path Option

#### Description

Configure port using NPU or Intel-NIC.

```plaintext
config port-path-option
set ports-using-npu <interface-name1>, <interface-name2>, ...
end
```

### Priority Protocol

#### Description

Configure NPU priority protocol.

```plaintext
config priority-protocol
set bfd [enable|disable]
set bgp [enable|disable]
set slbc [enable|disable]
end
```

### Quality of Service (QoS)

```plaintext
set qos-mode [disable|priority|...]
set qtm-buf-mode [6ch|4ch]
set rdp-offload [enable|disable]
set session-acct-interval {integer}
set session-denied-offload [disable|enable]
set shaping-stats [disable|enable]
set split-ipsec-engines [disable|enable]
set sse-backpressure [enable|disable]
set strip-clear-text-padding [enable|disable]
set strip-esp-padding [enable|disable]
```

config sw-eh-hash
set computation [xor16|xor8|...]
set destination-ip-lower-16 [include|exclude]
set destination-ip-upper-16 [include|exclude]
set destination-port [include|exclude]
```

# FortiOS 7.4.5 CLI Reference

## Parameters

### uesp-offload *
Enable/disable UDP-encapsulated ESP offload.

| Option  | Description                                           |
|---------|-------------------------------------------------------|
| enable  | Enable UDP-encapsulated ESP traffic offload.        |
| disable | Disable UDP-encapsulated ESP traffic offload.       |

### ull-port-mode *
Set ULL port's speed to 10G/25G.

| Option | Description                                      |
|--------|--------------------------------------------------|
| 10G    | 10G speed setting for ULL ports.                |
| 25G    | 25G speed setting for ULL ports.                |

### vlan-lookup-cache *
Enable/disable VLAN lookup cache.

| Option  | Description                                   |
|---------|-----------------------------------------------|
| enable  | Enable VLAN lookup cache.                     |
| disable | Disable VLAN lookup cache.                    |

### vxlan-offload *
Enable/disable offloading Vxlan.

| Option  | Description                                   |
|---------|-----------------------------------------------|
| enable  | Enable Vxlan offload.                        |
| disable | Disable Vxlan offload.                       |

* This parameter may not exist in some models.

## config dos-options

### npu-dos-meter-mode
Set DoS meter NPU offloading mode.

| Option  | Description                                           |
|---------|-------------------------------------------------------|
| global  | Install DoS meter to all NPs.                        |
| local   | Install DoS meter only to the NP assigned to the traffic. |

### npu-dos-tpe-mode
Enable/disable insertion of DoS meter ID to session table.

### config port-npu-map

| Parameter      | Description                                          | Type    | Size              | Default  |

| npu-group-index| Mapping NPU group index.                            | integer | Minimum value: 0
Maximum value: 4294967295 | 0        |

### config port-path-option

| Parameter          | Description                                             | Type   | Size          | Default  |
|--------------------|-------------------------------------------------------|--------|---------------|----------|
| ports-using-npu    | Set ha/aux ports to handle traffic with NPU (otherwise traffic goes to Intel-NIC and then CPU). | string | Maximum length: 15 |          |
| <interface-name>   | Available interfaces for NPU path.                    |        |               |          |

### config system ntp

Configure system NTP information.

#### config system ntp

- **Description**: Configure system NTP information.

```plaintext
set authentication [enable|disable]
set interface <interface-name1>, <interface-name2>, ...
set key {password}
set key-id {integer}
set key-type [MD5|SHA1|...]
```

#### config ntpserver

- **Description**: Configure the FortiGate to connect to any available third-party NTP server.

```plaintext
edit <id>
set authentication [enable|disable]
set interface {string}
set interface-select-method [auto|sdwan|...]
set ip-type [IPv6|IPv4|...]
set key {password}
set key-id {integer}
set key-type [MD5|SHA1|...]
set ntpv3 [enable|disable]
set server {string}
next
end
```

- **Additional settings**:
```plaintext
set ntpsync [enable|disable]
set server-mode [enable|disable]
set source-ip {ipv4-address}
set source-ip6 {ipv6-address}
set syncinterval {integer}
set type [fortiguard|custom]
```
```

```markdown
# FortiOS 7.4.5 CLI Reference

## Configuring Password Policy for Guest Administrators

To configure the password policy for guest administrators, use the following command:

```plaintext
config system password-policy-guest-admin
```

### Parameters

| Parameter              | Description                                                        | Type    | Size     | Default        |
|-----------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------|---------|----------|----------------|
| apply-to              | Guest administrator to which this password policy applies.         | option  | -        | guest-admin    |
|                       | **Option**                | **Description**                       | | |
|                       | guest-admin-password      | Apply to guest administrator password. | | |
| expire-day            | Number of days after which passwords expire.                      | integer | Minimum value: 1
Maximum value: 999 | 90             | | | | |
| expire-status         | Enable/disable password expiration.                                | option  | -        | disable        |
|                       | **Option**                | **Description**                       | | |
|                       | enable                    | Passwords expire after expire-day days. | | |
|                       | disable                   | Passwords do not expire.              | | |
| min-change-characters | Minimum number of unique characters in new password which do not exist in old password. | integer | Minimum value: 0
Maximum value: 128 | 0              |
| min-lower-case-letter | Minimum number of lowercase characters in password.               | integer | Minimum value: 0
Maximum value: 128 | 0              |
| min-non-alphanumeric  | Minimum number of non-alphanumeric characters in password.        | integer | Minimum value: 0
Maximum value: 128 | 0              |
| min-number            | Minimum number of numeric characters in password.                 | integer | Minimum value: 0
Maximum value: 128 | 0              |
| min-upper-case-letter | Minimum number of uppercase characters in password.               | integer | Minimum value: 0
Maximum value: 128 | 0              |
| minimum-length        | Minimum length of the password.                                   | integer | Minimum value: 1
Maximum value: 128 | 8              | | | | |
| reuse-password        | Enable/disable password reuse.                                    | option  | -        | disable        |
|                       | **Option**                | **Description**                       | | |
|                       | enable                    | Passwords can be reused.              | | |
|                       | disable                   | Passwords cannot be reused.           | | |
| status                | Enable/disable the password policy.                               | option  | -        | enable         |

### End Configuration

To end the configuration, use the following command:

```plaintext
end
```
```

## CLI Command

To configure the password policy for locally defined administrator passwords and IPsec VPN pre-shared keys, use the following command:

```bash
config system password-policy
```

### Description

Configure password policy for locally defined administrator passwords and IPsec VPN pre-shared keys.

### Command Options

- `set apply-to {option1}, {option2}, ...`
- `set expire-day {integer}`
- `set expire-status [enable|disable]`
- `set min-change-characters {integer}`
- `set min-lower-case-letter {integer}`
```

| min-non-alphanumeric | Minimum number of non-alphanumeric characters in password.              | integer | Minimum value: 0 | Maximum value: 128 | 0                |

# FortiOS 7.4.5 CLI Reference

## PPPoE Interface Configuration

### Overview
Configure the PPPoE interfaces.

### Command Structure
```plaintext
config system pppoe-interface
edit <name>
set ac-name {string}
set auth-type [auto|pap|...]
set device {string}
set dial-on-demand [enable|disable]
set disc-retry-timeout {integer}
set idle-timeout {integer}
set ipunnumbered {ipv4-address}
set ipv6 [enable|disable]
set lcp-echo-interval {integer}
set lcp-max-echo-fails {integer}
set padt-retry-timeout {integer}
set password {password}
set pppoe-egress-cos [cos0|cos1|...]
set pppoe-unnumbered-negotiate [enable|disable]
set service-name {string}
set username {string}
next
end
```

### Parameters

| Parameter      | Description                                      | Type    | Size         | Default         |
|----------------|--------------------------------------------------|---------|--------------|------------------|
| age-val        | Layer 2 table age timer value.                  | integer | Minimum value: 0
Maximum value: 4294967295 | 3158067         | | | | |
| name           | Name.                                           | string  | Maximum length: 15 |                  |
| ac-name        | PPPoE AC name.                                  | string  | Maximum length: 63 |                  |
| auth-type      | PPP authentication type to use.                 | option  | -            | auto             |
|                |                                                  |         |              |                  |
|                | **Option**                                      | **Description**                          | | |
|                | auto                                            | Automatically choose the authentication method. | | |
|                | pap                                             | PAP authentication.                      | | |

### Additional Configuration Options
- `set dial-on-demand [enable|disable]`
- `set disc-retry-timeout {integer}`
- `set idle-timeout {integer}`
- `set ipunnumbered {ipv4-address}`
- `set ipv6 [enable|disable]`
- `set lcp-echo-interval {integer}`
- `set lcp-max-echo-fails {integer}`
- `set padt-retry-timeout {integer}`
- `set password {password}`
- `set pppoe-egress-cos [cos0|cos1|...]`
- `set pppoe-unnumbered-negotiate [enable|disable]`
- `set service-name {string}`
- `set username {string}`
```

|                  | none                | Disable probe.                                   |           |              |          |
|                  | http-probe         | HTTP probe.                                      |           |              |          |
|                  | twamp              | Two way active measurement protocol.            |           |              |          |
| password         | TWAMP responder password in authentication mode.        | password  | Not Specified|          | |
| port             | Port number to respond.                                 | integer   | Minimum value: 1
Maximum value: 65535 | 8008     | | | | | |
| security-mode    | TWAMP responder security mode.                          | option    | -            | none     |---|
|                  | **Option**          | **Description**                                   |           |              |          |
|                  | none                | Unauthenticated mode.                            |           |              |          |
|                  | authentication      | Authenticated mode.                              |           |              |          |
| timeout          | An inactivity timer for a TWAMP test session.          | integer   | Minimum value: 10
Maximum value: 3600 | 300      |
